paper.title: Decoupled Contrastive Decoding via Expert-Aligned Drafting
paper.abstract: Contrastive Decoding (CD) improves generation quality, but its amateur-model pass makes decoding expensive. Accelerating CD with speculative decoding raises a proposal-alignment question: should the contrastive signal shape the drafter, or should it remain only in verification? We study this question in the lightweight feature-level drafter regime. Two controlled diagnostics, matched Cross-alpha training and an Approximate Dual-Drafter decomposition, give the same diagnosis: contrastive-aware dr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 contrastive decoding 的一个实际瓶颈：标准 CD 需要额外跑 amateur model，质量有提升但解码代价高；若再用 speculative decoding 加速，就会遇到 drafter 应该对齐 expert 还是对齐 contrastive objective 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理机制分析加解码系统改进。对预训练研究员不是核心必读，但它给出一个很干净的结论：在轻量 drafter 场景里，把 drafter 训练成“contrastive-aware”未必值得，说明很多复杂联合目标在推理近似里并不稳定转化为收益。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先做两个诊断：matched Cross-alpha training 和 Approximate Dual-Drafter decomposition，结论都是 contrastive-aware drafting 不稳定优于 expert-aligned drafting，因为 contrastive correction 通常弱于 drafter 自身误差，而 reconstruction 还会放大误差。基于此提出 DCD：draft 阶段只用 expert-aligned 的轻量 proposer，amateur model 仅保留在原始 CD verification 中；再配合标准 speculative verification，理论上保持 vanilla CD 的输出分布不变。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的主结果是在 8B 设定下，基于 EAGLE3 的 DCD 在 greedy decoding 上取得平均 2.44× 加速，同时保持与 vanilla CD 一致的输出分布。论文还提到做了 controlled diagnostics，但摘要未给出完整 baseline、任务集和质量指标细节；从表述看，重点是速度-质量折中优于把 contrastive 信号塞进 drafter 的方案。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自上海交通大学与上海人工智能实验室。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical bottleneck in contrastive decoding: standard CD improves quality but is expensive because it requires an amateur-model pass; once speculative decoding is added, a key question appears—should the drafter align with the expert or with the contrastive objective.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-method paper with a useful mechanistic diagnosis. It is not central pretraining reading, but it offers a clean lesson: in lightweight drafter regimes, making the drafter contrastive-aware may not be worth it, suggesting that more complicated joint objectives do not always translate into better approximate decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors run two diagnostics—matched Cross-alpha training and an Approximate Dual-Drafter decomposition—and both indicate that contrastive-aware drafting is not consistently better than expert-aligned drafting. The reason is that contrastive correction is usually weaker than drafter error, and reconstruction can amplify that error. They then propose DCD: use an expert-aligned lightweight proposer for drafting, keep the amateur model only in unchanged CD verification, and apply standard speculative verification so the output distribution matches vanilla CD.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result in the abstract is that, in 8B settings, EAGLE3-based DCD achieves an average 2.44× greedy speedup while preserving the vanilla-CD output distribution. The paper also reports controlled diagnostics, though the abstract does not provide full details on baselines, tasks, or quality metrics. The main point is a better speed-quality tradeoff than approaches that inject the contrastive signal into the drafter.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Shanghai Jiao Tong University and the Shanghai AI Laboratory.

recommendation.zh: 这篇的价值在诊断，不在花活：如果你碰过 speculative+CD 的 proposal mismatch，先看两个 diagnostic；结论大概率能省掉一轮复杂 drafter 训练。
recommendation.en: The value here is the diagnosis, not the trick: if you have dealt with speculative decoding plus CD, read the two diagnostics first—they may save you from an unnecessary round of fancy drafter training.

paper.title: DARTree: Speculative Diffusion Decoding with Autoregressive Draft Trees
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding losslessly accelerates autoregressive language models by verifying multiple draft tokens in parallel. Diffusion-based drafters further reduce proposal latency by predicting an entire token block in parallel, but their position-wise distributions are marginal rather than conditioned on tokens selected along each draft path. Existing recurrent correction incorporates causal information along a single draft chain, whereas diffusion-based tree construction broadens candidate cov

summary.core_problem: 基于 diffusion 的 block-parallel drafter 一次前向预测整块 token，提案延迟低，但缺少块内因果条件；causal correction head 能沿单条链补回因果信息，而 draft tree 能拓宽候选覆盖。把两者结合时，path-dependent 的校正分数迫使 tree 构造逐节点串行调用 correction head，成为新的延迟瓶颈。
summary.importance: 属于推理加速方向，对预训练研究的直接启发有限，但对理解 block-parallel/diffusion 式 drafter 与 AR target 之间的分布失配、以及如何在不重新训练的前提下用轻量 correction head 修补因果条件，有一定参考价值。training-free 且复用预训练 correction head 的设计对部署侧有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: DARTree 把预训练的 causal correction head 从单链扩展到树。关键改动是把节点扩展从 best-first heap 的逐节点弹出改为按深度批量展开：每一层固定展开若干节点，一次性 batch 计算它们经 correction 后的子节点分布，从而避免 correction-head 推理与 heap 操作的串行交错。由于加宽层展开几乎不增加延迟，方法先构造一棵较宽的 supertree，再用一个 deferred、简化的 best-first pruning 在固定节点预算下裁出紧凑的验证树。校正仍沿每条分支路径传播，保留了 path-dependent 评分。整个过程 training-free，复用已有 drafter 和 correction head。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上，于七个 math、code、chat benchmark、temperature 0 和 1 共四种配置下评测。DARTree 在四种配置下均取得最高的总体平均 acceptance length 和 speedup。具体加速比数字在提供的片段中未完整给出，Figure 2 汇总了代表性 benchmark 上的 decoding speedup。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看 Introduction 中对 chain correction 与 tree construction 互补性及串行瓶颈的分析（Figure 1），以及方法部分 depth-wise batched expansion 与 deferred pruning 的设计。对做 speculative decoding / serving 的工程师有直接参考价值；对预训练研究员，了解 diffusion drafter 的因果失配如何被轻量校正即可。预计 30–45 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion-based block-parallel drafters predict an entire token block in one forward pass, giving low proposal latency but lacking intra-block causal conditioning. Causal correction heads restore this along a single chain, while draft trees broaden candidate coverage. Combining the two forces path-dependent correction to run node-by-node during best-first tree construction, creating a new latency bottleneck.
summary_en.importance: This is inference-acceleration work with limited direct relevance to pretraining, but it is informative for understanding the distribution mismatch between block-parallel/diffusion drafters and an AR target, and how a lightweight correction head can repair causal conditioning without retraining. The training-free reuse of a pretrained correction head has practical deployment value.
summary_en.technical_approach: DARTree extends a pretrained causal correction head from a single chain to a tree. The key change replaces node-by-node best-first heap expansion with depth-wise batched expansion: at each depth a fixed number of nodes are expanded and their corrected child distributions are computed in one batch, eliminating the interleaving of correction-head inference with heap operations. Because widening a layer adds little latency, the method first builds a wider supertree and then applies a deferred, simplified best-first pruning to obtain a compact verification tree under a fixed node budget. Correction still propagates along each branch path, preserving path-dependent scoring. The entire method is training-free and reuses an existing drafter and correction head.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across seven math, code, and chat benchmarks at temperatures 0 and 1 (four model–temperature configurations). DARTree achieves the highest overall average acceptance length and speedup in all four configurations. Exact speedup numbers are not fully contained in the available text; Figure 2 summarizes decoding speedups on representative benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the Introduction's analysis of how chain correction and tree construction are complementary and where the serial bottleneck arises (Figure 1), and on the method's depth-wise batched expansion plus deferred pruning. Directly useful for engineers working on speculative decoding/serving; for pretraining researchers, the main takeaway is how causal mismatch in diffusion drafters is patched by a lightweight correction head. Estimated 30–45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和实验表即可；若内部已有 speculative decoding 栈，这个 tree 化 AR correction 值得小规模复现。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and tables; if you already run speculative decoding, the tree-based AR correction is worth a small internal replication.

paper.title: SPADE: Speculative Decoding for Precise and Low Cost Distributed Edge Cloud Inference
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in natural language understanding and generation, but their deployment is constrained by high computational demands. Deploying smaller LLMs directly on the edge can circumvent this, but with degraded accuracy. Deploying smaller cloud-based big LLMs preserves performance, but at the cost of expensive per-token computation. We present a distributed inference framework, \our{}, that integrates speculative decoding (SD) across edge and cl

summary.core_problem: 在边缘-云分布式部署场景下，同时降低LLM推理延迟与云端计算成本并保持大模型精度。
summary.importance: 提出边缘-云协同的推测解码框架，属于推理系统工程创新，无需重新训练模型。
summary.technical_approach: 边缘端部署小型草稿模型快速生成候选token，云端部署大模型并行验证；接受的token直接保留，仅拒绝时由云端修正，从而减少云端查询次数。
summary.experiments: 以即插即用方式实现，无需重训练；核心指标为推理延迟降低与云端成本节省，同时保持大模型原始精度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自印度理工学院等学术机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Reduces LLM inference latency and cloud compute cost while preserving large-model accuracy in a distributed edge-cloud deployment setting.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an edge-cloud collaborative speculative decoding framework; inference system engineering innovation requiring no model retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: A compact draft model on the edge generates candidate tokens quickly; a large verifier model on the cloud validates them in parallel. Accepted tokens are retained, and only rejections trigger cloud correction, reducing the number of cloud queries.
summary_en.experiments: Plug-and-play design with no retraining; measured by inference latency reduction, cloud cost savings, and preservation of large-model accuracy.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from academic institutions including IIT.

recommendation.zh: 边缘云协同推测解码的工程实现，思路直接无新理论，对pretrain研究员价值有限，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Engineering implementation of edge-cloud speculative decoding; straightforward idea with no new theory, limited value for pretrain researchers.

paper.title: MemSpec: Memory-Aware Runtime for Adaptive Draft Scheduling in Speculative Decoding on Edge Devices
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to speculate multiple tokens, reducing expensive target model decoding steps. Its effectiveness depends heavily on draft selection, motivating adaptive methods that exploit variation across inputs and generation stages. On memory-constrained edge devices, however, these methods often fail to improve end-to-end throughput due to the overhead of switching between draft models. We

summary.core_problem: 在内存受限的边缘设备上，自适应 speculative decoding 常因草稿模型切换开销而无法提升端到端吞吐。
summary.importance: 指出边缘部署中草稿选择与草稿可用性不匹配的问题，对推理系统和内存调度有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MemSpec，将草稿选择与执行解耦；用轻量预测器根据 prompt 和生成上下文估计草稿效果，并通过内存感知调度器主动管理 resident working set。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、硬件或加速比，主要贡献是运行时设计和问题形式化。

summary_en.core_problem: On memory-constrained edge devices, adaptive speculative decoding often fails to improve end-to-end throughput due to draft-model switching overhead.
summary_en.importance: It identifies the mismatch between draft selection and draft availability under tight memory budgets, which is relevant to inference-system scheduling.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemSpec decouples draft selection from execution, uses a lightweight predictor to estimate draft effectiveness from prompt and generation context, and proactively manages resident working sets with a memory-aware scheduler.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete models, hardware, or speedups; the contribution is primarily the runtime design and problem formulation.

recommendation.zh: 边缘视角有价值：瓶颈在换模和常驻内存而非单纯草稿选择；看调度设计即可，实验细节不足。
recommendation.en: Useful edge perspective: the bottleneck is model switching and resident memory, not just draft selection; read the scheduling design, but experiments are thin.

paper.title: Matryoshka Language Model Suites
paper.abstract: Training a language model suite classically requires training each model separately and serving them independently. We improve both training and inference efficiency by stacking sub-models of increasing size into a single nested architecture trained end-to-end. This Matryoshka training framework reduces the total parameter count of the suite, enables low-cost distillation from the largest to all smaller sub-models at every training step, and is well-suited for speculative decoding as the draft m

summary.core_problem: 传统LLM模型族（面向不同部署场景的一组不同参数量模型）需要为每个尺寸单独训练，总训练成本高、参数冗余度大；小模型通常需在训练完成后从大模型做离线蒸馏，流程割裂；推理时使用推测解码需要单独维护draft模型，带来额外内存开销，且独立训练的draft模型与verifier预测一致性低，token接受率不足，往往难以拿到实际加速。
summary.importance: Matryoshka嵌套训练框架将多个尺寸的子模型整合到单次端到端预训练流程中，总训练成本接近仅训练最大模型的开销，同时解决了训练冗余、蒸馏流程成本、推测解码效率三个生产中的实际问题，对模型族的生产、部署效率有直接实用价值，是参数复用、嵌套架构预训练方向的重要进展。和固定宽度的early exit方案不同，每个子模型拥有适配自身尺寸的宽度和深度，可独立切出部署，设计可直接落地到生产模型工作流。
summary.technical_approach: 架构采用严格的参数嵌套规则：更小的子模型的所有参数都被包含在更大的子模型中，同时每个子模型可以设置独立的隐藏维度（宽度）和层数（深度），实现更灵活的尺寸设计。无参数的连接（junction）机制负责将小子模型的输出传递给更大的子模型：大子模型隐藏状态的前D_m维直接用小子模型的输出初始化，大子模型新增维度的对应位置填入token embedding；通过简单的归一化操作解决Transformer输出和输入embedding的模长不匹配问题，避免训练不稳定。训练目标在每个子模型出口同时计算两项loss：一是标准的下一词预测交叉熵，二是以最大模型的logits为软标签的蒸馏loss，所有子模型的loss加权求和作为总目标，在每一步训练中无额外前向开销地完成从大模型到所有小模型的在线蒸馏。推理阶段，任意子模型都可以被独立切出部署，拥有独立的KV cache占用；做推测解码时，小子模型本身就是大模型的内置组件，二者共享权重和KV cache，无需额外加载draft模型权重，参数共享的特性也会提升跨模型的预测一致性。
summary.experiments: 在35B FineWeb-Edu tokens上训练了包含500M、1.5B、3B三个子模型的Matryoshka套件：1）总训练计算量比单独训练三个同尺寸基线模型低36%，三个尺寸的子模型在验证集困惑度、域外困惑度、标准基准测试上的性能，和独立训练的基线差距均在0.5个平均分以内，基本持平；2）消融实验显示，无参数连接机制、逐出口蒸馏loss两个设计对小模型性能至关重要，移除任意一项都会导致小模型性能明显下降；在50M/100M/200M的小规模套件上的系统消融，明确了宽度、深度拆分方式对子模型性能的影响；3）推测解码场景下，嵌套模型对的token接受率显著高于独立训练的模型对：1.5B嵌套draft搭配3B verifier可以获得实际加速，而同样尺寸的独立训练模型对因为接受率过低，加速效果甚至不如原生自回归推理。项目开源了训练好的checkpoint和HuggingFace Transformers兼容的实现代码。
summary.reading_guide: 需要精读。重点关注三部分内容：一是连接机制的具体设计，尤其是如何在不引入额外参数的情况下处理宽度过渡、解决激活模长不匹配带来的训练不稳定问题；二是训练目标设计，包括逐出口蒸馏loss的作用、不同子模型的loss权重配置逻辑；三是小规模消融中关于宽度/深度配置权衡的结论，这些结论对将方案扩展到更大尺寸模型套件有直接指导意义。另外需要关注推测解码部分的分析，理解参数共享提升跨模型一致性的机制，注意方案目前的已知限制（如不同子模型间训练步分配的平衡、更大参数量级下的scaling表现尚未验证）。阅读时可以结合开源的3B checkpoint和兼容实现，验证实际部署的行为和开销。预计阅读时间45分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional LLM model suites—collections of models at varying parameter scales built for diverse deployment scenarios—require separate training runs for each model size, leading to high total training cost and redundant computation. Smaller models in the suite typically require offline distillation from larger models after training completes, adding pipeline complexity. For speculative decoding, independently trained draft models incur extra memory overhead, and low prediction agreement between separate draft and verifier models often erases potential speedups.
summary_en.importance: The Matryoshka LM framework nests sub-models of increasing scale into a single end-to-end training run, with total training cost comparable to training only the largest model in the suite. It addresses three core pain points in model suite production: redundant training compute, distillation pipeline overhead, and low speculative decoding efficiency. Unlike fixed-width early-exit approaches, each nested sub-model has tailored width and depth and can be served as a standalone model, making the design immediately applicable to production model workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: The architecture enforces strict parameter nesting: all parameters of smaller sub-models are contained within larger sub-models, while each sub-model uses its own hidden dimension (width) and layer count (depth) for flexible size design. A parameter-free junction mechanism connects outputs from smaller sub-models to the inputs of larger sub-models: the first D_m dimensions of the larger sub-model’s hidden state are populated directly from the smaller sub-model’s output, while dimensions added for the larger sub-model are filled with corresponding token embeddings. A simple normalization step resolves activation magnitude mismatch between Transformer outputs and input embeddings that would otherwise destabilize training. The training objective combines standard next-token cross-entropy at every sub-model exit with an in-line distillation loss that uses the largest model’s logits as soft labels for all smaller sub-models, providing per-step distillation with no extra forward pass cost. At inference, any sub-model can be extracted and served independently with its own KV cache footprint. For speculative decoding, smaller sub-models act as draft models natively contained within the verifier, sharing weights and KV cache to eliminate extra memory overhead and improve prediction agreement.
summary_en.experiments: A 3B-parameter suite with 500M, 1.5B, and 3B sub-models is trained on 35B tokens from FineWeb-Edu: (1) Total training compute is 36% lower than training three equivalent independent baseline models, and all sub-models match independent baseline performance within 0.5 average points across standard benchmarks, as well as on in-domain and out-of-domain validation perplexity. (2) Ablations show the parameter-free junction mechanism and per-exit distillation loss are both critical for small sub-model performance; removing either leads to clear quality degradation in smaller models. Small-scale ablations on 50M/100M/200M suites characterize how width and depth partitioning choices affect sub-model performance. (3) For speculative decoding, nested model pairs have substantially higher token acceptance rates than independently trained pairs: a 1.5B nested draft paired with the 3B verifier delivers meaningful speedup, while an equivalently sized independent draft/verifier pair yields no speedup over standard autoregressive decoding due to low agreement. Trained checkpoints and a HuggingFace Transformers-compatible implementation are open-sourced.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read in depth. Focus on three core components: (1) the junction mechanism design, particularly how it handles width transitions and resolves activation magnitude mismatch without additional parameters; (2) the training objective design, including the role of per-exit distillation and loss weighting across sub-models; (3) small-scale ablation results on width/depth configuration tradeoffs, which provide direct guidance for scaling the design to larger model suites. Pay close attention to the speculative decoding analysis on how weight sharing improves cross-model agreement, and note open limitations (e.g., balancing training step allocation across sub-models, untested scaling behavior at larger parameter counts). Pair reading with the open-source 3B checkpoint and compatible implementation to validate deployment behavior. Estimated reading time: 45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现小规模 ablation；它把模型族训练、步内蒸馏和投机解码合成一个 recipe，动作很明确。
recommendation.en: Run a small internal ablation; it turns model-family training, step-wise distillation, and speculative decoding into one actionable recipe.

paper.title: LibraSpec: Dynamic Diffusion-Based Speculative Decoding via Marginal-Gain-Driven Optimization
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens for parallel verification, with efficiency critically determined by the speculative length selected at each decoding round. Existing dynamic speculation methods select the speculation length by estimating how many tokens will be accepted, which is reasonable for autoregressive drafters that generates tokens sequentially. The recent wave of diffusion-based drafters, however, generates candidate blocks in p

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 diffusion-based speculative decoding 里的动态投机长度选择问题。已有方法通常预测“会接受多少 token”，这适合自回归 draft model，因为草稿 token 也是顺序生成的；但 diffusion drafter 可以低成本并行生成一个候选块，真正昂贵的是把多少候选 token 送给 target model 验证。因此问题从 accepted length prediction 变成了 expected speedup optimization。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对大模型推理系统有明确参考价值。它抓住了 diffusion drafter 与 AR drafter 的成本结构差异：draft 成本下降后，验证成本和早拒绝造成的无效计算成为主要约束。这个视角对研究非 AR 语言模型如何嵌入现有 LLM serving pipeline 有启发，尤其是 diffusion LM 作为辅助模型，而不是直接替代主模型的路径。
summary.technical_approach: LibraSpec 把每轮 speculative length 的选择写成期望加速比优化。核心不是先估计最终能接受多少 token，而是判断“再多验证一段候选 token 是否能带来足够的边际收益”。论文定义了 acceptance gain 与 verification cost 的比值，推导出 beneficial adjustment 的必要充分条件，并证明在其速度模型下，expected speedup 关于 speculative length 呈单峰结构。基于这个性质，算法可以从当前长度出发迭代做有益调整，有限步收敛到全局最优长度区间。实现上不训练额外 predictor，而是直接使用 diffusion drafter 输出的 confidence score 来近似验证前不可得的接受概率，因此可以插到现有 diffusion speculative decoding 方法中。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 6 个 LLM、3 种 diffusion-based speculative decoding 方法，并在数学推理、代码生成、聊天任务上测试，同时包含 greedy decoding 和 sampling setting。主要结果是 LibraSpec 相比原有 diffusion speculative decoding 进一步提升端到端加速比约 0.5 到 1.5 倍；相对普通自回归解码最高达到 8.49 倍加速。论文还用 oracle exhaustive search 的最优长度作参照，显示 LibraSpec 能较好跟踪每个 decoding round 的最优投机长度变化。关键消融点在于：仅预测接受长度不足以最大化速度，因为 diffusion drafter 的候选生成成本已不是主要瓶颈；直接使用边际收益准则能更好处理“高接受概率但验证收益不够”的候选后缀。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 AR drafter 和 diffusion drafter 成本结构差异的分析，再看 Methodology 里 expected speedup、beneficial adjustment、单峰性证明和迭代长度选择算法。实验部分主要看 oracle length 对比图、不同任务和不同 decoding setting 下的端到端 speedup。若关注 serving，可以深挖它的成本模型假设：target verification latency 是否线性随长度增长、batching 和 KV-cache 行为是否会改变边际准则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies dynamic speculative-length selection for diffusion-based speculative decoding. Prior dynamic methods usually estimate how many drafted tokens will be accepted, which matches autoregressive drafters because drafting itself is sequential. With diffusion drafters, candidate blocks are generated in parallel at much lower cost, so the main decision becomes how many already-generated candidates are worth verifying with the target model.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly on inference rather than pretraining, but it is relevant for base-model researchers tracking non-AR language models. It clarifies a practical role for diffusion LMs: they may serve as efficient block drafters inside an AR target model pipeline. The useful point is the changed cost structure. Once drafting becomes cheap, verification cost and wasted suffix computation after early rejection dominate the length-selection problem.
summary_en.technical_approach: LibraSpec formulates length selection as expected-speedup optimization instead of accepted-length prediction. The method evaluates whether extending the speculative prefix improves the ratio between acceptance gain and verification cost. The paper derives necessary and sufficient conditions for a beneficial length adjustment and proves that, under its speed model, expected speedup is unimodal with respect to the speculative length. This allows iterative local adjustments to monotonically improve speedup and converge in finite steps to a globally optimal length interval. In implementation, LibraSpec is training-free. It uses confidence scores from the diffusion drafter as proxies for acceptance-related quantities that are unavailable before verification, and can be plugged into existing diffusion speculative decoding systems.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses six LLMs and three diffusion-based speculative decoding methods, covering math reasoning, code generation, and chat benchmarks under both greedy and sampling settings. LibraSpec improves end-to-end speedup over the underlying diffusion speculative decoding methods by about 0.5x to 1.5x, and reaches up to 8.49x speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding. The paper also compares against an oracle length obtained by exhaustive search and shows that LibraSpec closely tracks the round-wise optimal length. The key experimental message is that accepted-length estimation alone is not enough: a likely accepted suffix can still be a poor choice if its marginal verification cost is too high.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the introduction’s distinction between AR and diffusion drafter cost structures, then read the methodology around expected speedup, beneficial adjustment, unimodality, and the iterative length-selection rule. In the experiments, look for the oracle-length comparison and end-to-end speedup tables across tasks and decoding modes. For serving work, the most important part to inspect is the latency model: assumptions about verification cost, sequence length scaling, batching, and KV-cache behavior determine how portable the marginal criterion is.

recommendation.zh: 只看边际收益推导和成本模型；若验证开销建模干净，可直接迁移到内部推测解码 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the marginal-gain derivation and cost model; if verification cost is measured cleanly, it is directly reusable for internal speculative-decoding ablations.

paper.title: Hierarchical Latent Prediction for Language Models
paper.abstract: While standard Next-Token Prediction (NTP) lays the foundation of language model pre- training, its teacher-forced training paradigm may not be optimal for long-horizon reasoning and planning. Recent works such as Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) and Next-Latent prediction (NextLat) try to mitigate the problem through predicting multiple future tokens and self-supervised prediction in the latent space. However, those auxiliary objectives either have a limited horizon or suffer from compounding error

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 next-token prediction 在 teacher forcing 下的一个老问题：训练时总看到真前缀，推理时却要吃自己生成的前缀，长程生成和规划会出现误差累积。已有两条路各有短板：MTP 让模型多看几个未来 token，但 horizon 仍短；NextLat 在 latent space 做自监督一步预测，能改善局部动态一致性，但多步 rollout 仍会快速漂移。HiLP 要解决的就是：如何在不改变推理时主干架构、也不引入推理额外开销的前提下，把更长时间尺度的预测结构直接压进预训练表示里。
summary.importance: 这是一个值得精读的 pretrain 方向工作，因为它不是简单给 NTP 叠一个 auxiliary loss，而是明确针对“长程表征是否能在预训练阶段被塑形”这个问题提出层级 latent 方案。贡献有两层。第一，它把 NextLat 从单尺度一步 latent dynamics 扩展到多尺度预测，试图减少 latent rollout 的 compounding error。第二，它坚持 training-time only 的设计：层级模块和组合头在推理时都可以移除，保留标准 NTP 解码路径。这一点很关键，因为很多替代目标在研究上有意思，但一旦推理路径变复杂，就很难进入大规模 recipe。HiLP 至少在设计上兼顾了研究价值和落地可能性。对预训练研究员来说，更重要的启发是：如果长程 reasoning / planning 的一部分瓶颈来自表示空间缺少稳定的 coarse-grained predictive state，那么单纯扩大模型和数据未必是唯一方向，训练目标本身可以更主动地塑造多尺度状态。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是给标准 transformer 产生的 token-level latent h_t 再叠一层 higher-level abstract latent u_t，并在两个层级上同时施加自监督预测约束。具体地，模型先用主干 G_theta 从前缀 X_{1:t} 得到 lower-level latent h_t。然后用一个 sliding-window attention 模块，在最近 k 个 lower states 上做聚合，得到 higher-level latent u_t = SWA(h_{t-k+1:t})。这个设计不是任意加一层 pooling，而是显式把上层状态绑定到一个局部时间窗口，让它表示更粗粒度、跨多个 token 的抽象动态。训练时一共学四个映射：标准输出头 p_theta；lower dynamics p_psi，用于 NextLat 风格的一步 latent transition consistency；upper dynamics p_phi，用于在 abstract latent 上做 k 步前瞻预测；combined head p_rho，用 lower 与 upper latent 联合做 next-token prediction。总损失由五部分组成：标准 NTP loss、lower-level transition consistency loss、一个 KL 项、higher-level transition consistency loss、以及 combined NTP loss。论文里一个很细但重要的实现点是 stop-gradient 的放置：在 combined NTP 路径里，higher-level latent 由带 stop-grad 的 lower states 经过 SWA 得到。这样 combined head 的交叉熵只训练 SWA 和上层表示，不会反向改写 h_t。作者的理由很充分：如果不切断这条梯度，token-level 表示 h_t 会同时受到标准 NTP、lower transition consistency、以及经 SWA 回流的 combined-head 监督，形成重复计数和相互竞争的优化信号。这个处理说明作者不是把多头损失机械相加，而是在认真控制不同目标对表示空间的职责分工。另一个关键点是推理阶段只保留标准 NTP head，整个层级 apparatus 都是训练时辅助项，因此没有额外 inference overhead；如果愿意用速度换精度，也可以考虑 combined NTP，但当前实现默认不用。
summary.experiments: 实验规模在研究型论文里算扎实：1B 参数模型，在 100B tokens 上预训练，使用 8 张 NVIDIA B200。评测分两类。第一类是下游零样本能力，用 LM Evaluation Harness 跑 HumanEval，以及用 DataComp for LLMs 中的 symbolic 和 multi-step benchmarks，比较对象包括标准 NTP、MTP、NextLat。论文给出的主结论是 HiLP 在需要更长程推理和规划的任务上优于这些基线。第二类是 speculative decoding 效率，在 held-out code 和 Nemotron-Climbmix 验证集上，报告每次 drafting step 被 verifier 接受的平均 token 数，以及 K=1..4 各位置的 draft-verifier argmax agreement。HiLP 在这些指标上也更好，说明它学到的 latent dynamics 不只是离线表征更平滑，也更适合做多 token 预测和校验一致性。最有信息量的分析来自 rollout horizon 实验：作者画了 latent prediction cross-entropy 随 rollout 步数到 8 的曲线。结果显示，HiLP 基本保住了 NextLat 的近程误差水平，但在更远 horizon 上 future prediction error 更低。这正对应论文的核心主张：层级 abstract latent 缓解了多步 latent rollout 的误差累积。全文片段没有给出表格中的完整数值，因此无法逐项复述具体提升百分点；但参数规模、训练 token 数、评测任务和趋势结论是明确的。
summary.reading_guide: 建议按“问题—机制—证据”三步读。先看 Introduction，确认作者不是在替代 AR，而是在给 AR 预训练加一个多尺度 latent 预测信号。然后重点读 Methodology，尤其是 Fig.1、五项损失的定义、SWA 的作用、以及 combined NTP 路径里的 stop-gradient 设计。这部分是论文真正的新意，不只是多加一层 latent。实验部分优先看 Tab.1、Fig.2 和讨论里关于 rollout horizon 到 8 步的误差曲线。读的时候要问两个问题：一，HiLP 的收益主要来自更强的 auxiliary supervision，还是来自层级时间抽象本身；二，training-time only 的 apparatus 是否真的没有把收益偷偷建立在更复杂的 inference path 上。若时间有限，30 分钟可以抓住方法与主结果；若要判断是否值得复现，建议把损失权重、窗口大小 k、以及 speculative decoding 设置一并看清。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a core weakness of standard next-token prediction under teacher forcing: the model is trained on gold prefixes but must condition on its own generations at inference time, which leads to compounding errors over long horizons. Existing fixes are partial. Multi-token prediction extends the horizon only a little, while NextLat adds latent self-prediction but still rolls out one step at a time and accumulates error. HiLP asks whether a language model can be pretrained to encode longer-range predictive structure through a hierarchical latent objective, without changing the inference-time architecture.
summary_en.importance: This is a meaningful pretraining paper because it does more than attach another auxiliary loss to NTP. It makes a specific claim about representation shaping: long-horizon reasoning and planning may benefit from a latent state space that carries stable coarse-grained predictive information, not just token-local transition consistency. The contribution is also practical in an important way. The hierarchical machinery is used only during training and can be removed entirely at inference time, so the method preserves the standard autoregressive decoding path. That makes it much easier to think about as a recipe-level intervention rather than a separate model family.
summary_en.technical_approach: HiLP starts from a standard transformer backbone that produces lower-level token latents h_t = G_theta(X_{1:t}). It then builds a higher-level abstract latent u_t by applying a sliding-window attention module over the most recent k lower-level states, u_t = SWA(h_{t-k+1:t}). This upper latent is meant to capture a coarser temporal abstraction over multiple tokens. The model jointly learns four parameterized components: the standard token output head p_theta, a lower-level dynamics model p_psi for NextLat-style transition consistency, an upper-level dynamics model p_phi that predicts k steps ahead in the abstract latent space, and a combined head p_rho that predicts the next token from both lower and upper latents. Training uses a weighted sum of five losses: standard NTP, lower-level latent transition consistency, a KL term, higher-level transition consistency, and a combined NTP loss. A subtle but important implementation detail is the stop-gradient placement. In the combined-NTP path, the upper latent is computed from stop-grad lower states before SWA. This prevents the combined-head cross-entropy from backpropagating into h_t through the SWA window. The authors explicitly argue that otherwise the lower token-level representation would receive overlapping and competing supervision from standard NTP, lower-level transition consistency, and the combined head. At inference time, only the standard NTP head is used, so the hierarchical apparatus acts purely as a training-time regularizer.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental setup is reasonably substantial for a method paper: 1B-parameter models pretrained on 100B tokens using 8 NVIDIA B200 GPUs. Evaluation has two parts. First, zero-shot downstream performance is measured with LM Evaluation Harness on HumanEval and with DataComp for LLMs on symbolic and multi-step reasoning benchmarks. HiLP is reported to outperform the relevant baselines, including MTP and NextLat, especially on tasks that require longer-horizon reasoning or planning. Second, the paper evaluates speculative decoding on held-out code and Nemotron-Climbmix validation sets, reporting average accepted tokens per drafting step and draft–verifier argmax agreement for K=1..4. HiLP improves these metrics as well, suggesting that the learned latent dynamics are more rollout-stable and more useful for multi-token drafting. The most informative analysis is the latent prediction cross-entropy over rollout horizons up to 8 steps. HiLP preserves near-term prediction quality comparable to NextLat while reducing error at longer horizons, which directly supports the claim that hierarchical abstraction mitigates multi-step latent error accumulation. The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, so exact gains cannot be quoted reliably here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it in three passes. First, the introduction: the key point is that HiLP is not replacing autoregressive language modeling, but augmenting it with a multi-scale latent prediction signal. Second, spend time on the methodology, especially Fig. 1, the five-loss objective, the role of sliding-window attention, and the stop-gradient design in the combined-NTP path. That is where the real novelty sits. Third, go to the main results and the rollout-horizon analysis. The most useful question while reading is whether the gains come from stronger auxiliary supervision in general, or specifically from hierarchical temporal abstraction. Another good question is whether the training-time-only design truly preserves the standard inference path without hidden complexity. A careful first read should take around 30 minutes; a reproduction-oriented read should also inspect loss weights, the window size k, and the speculative decoding setup.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你对“长程能力该不该靠 AR teacher forcing 学出来”的 prior；先看方法图和对比 NextLat/MTP 的 ablation，若 compute 对齐干净，值得立刻做内部复现。
recommendation.en: This one can shift your prior on whether long-horizon competence should emerge from plain AR teacher forcing; read the HiLP-vs-NextLat/MTP ablations first, and if the compute matching is clean, it is worth reproducing internally.

paper.title: DBLAST: Dependent Block Drafting for Stochastic Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language models' inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens and a target model to verify them. While recent block and diffusion-style drafters can predict several positions in a single pass, their training and sampling procedures are typically optimized for greedy decoding or assume that positions in the draft block are conditionally independent. This assumption becomes brittle in non-greedy speculative decoding, where the ta

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是随机采样场景下的 speculative decoding：块式 drafter 一次提出多个 token，但常见做法把块内位置近似为条件独立，导致它在高熵目标分布下很难提出一条前后一致、能被 sequential verifier 接受的候选轨迹。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对高吞吐推理、RL rollout、开放式生成服务有直接参考价值。关键启发是：多 token 预测或 diffusion-style drafter 不能只优化每个位置的边缘分布；如果 verifier 按自回归条件分布逐 token 接受，训练目标就需要贴近 accepted prefix length，而不是只看 block NLL。
summary.technical_approach: DBLAST 在 DFlash 风格的 block diffusion drafter 上加入块内依赖。方法使用一个 CP-style categorical latent mixture：给整个 block 引入轻量类别 latent variable；在给定类别后，各位置仍可并行预测；对类别边缘化后，块内 token 之间形成相关性。这样保留了一次前向预测多个位置的并行性，同时比独立采样更容易生成条件上连贯的 draft block。训练上，论文不只优化 block NLL，而是提出面向 accepted length 的 log-domain surrogate，并用 threshold-truncated prefixes 稳定早期训练。这个目标更贴近 speculative verifier 的实际行为：第 i 个 token 是否被接受，取决于前面 token 是否已经被接受以及目标模型在该条件下的分布。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B，任务包括 GSM8K、MT-Bench、HumanEval 和 creative writing。论文重点报告了高熵采样下的收益：在 Qwen3-8B 高熵设置中，DBLAST 的 accepted length 宏平均提升超过 12%。诊断实验把样本按 target-block early determinism 分桶，发现独立 block proposal 在低确定性区域最脆弱；DBLAST 在所有分桶中提升 accepted length，且相对收益集中在早期位置不确定、存在多条合理续写的区域。这支持了论文的核心判断：随机 speculative decoding 的瓶颈不是单点预测质量，而是块级条件轨迹质量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 independent block sampling mismatch 的分析，以及 Figure 1 的 early determinism 分桶结果。方法部分重点看 CP-style latent mixture 如何在不牺牲并行性的情况下引入块内依赖，再看 accepted-length surrogate 的定义。实验部分可重点看高熵设置下 Qwen3-8B 的 accepted length 结果；如果关心 RL rollout 或开放式生成服务，这部分比 greedy decoding 指标更有参考意义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies speculative decoding under stochastic target sampling. Existing block drafters propose several future tokens in one pass, but often treat positions in the block as conditionally independent. This works better for greedy or low-entropy decoding, and breaks down when the target distribution admits several plausible continuations.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency paper, but it has useful implications for training multi-token and diffusion-style drafters. The main lesson is that matching per-position marginals is not enough when verification is sequential. A drafter should optimize for the accepted prefix process, not only for block likelihood.
summary_en.technical_approach: DBLAST adds dependence to a DFlash-like block diffusion drafter through a CP-style categorical latent mixture. A lightweight latent category is shared across the block. Conditioned on that category, token positions are still predicted in parallel; after marginalizing over categories, the proposal defines a correlated joint distribution over the block. The paper also introduces an accepted-length-oriented log-domain surrogate, with threshold-truncated prefixes for stable early training. This aligns the drafter more directly with the verifier, which accepts token i under the target distribution conditioned on the already accepted draft prefix.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on GSM8K, MT-Bench, HumanEval, and creative-writing tasks. In the high-entropy Qwen3-8B setting, DBLAST reports more than 12% macro-average improvement in accepted length. A diagnostic experiment groups examples by early target-block determinism. Independent proposals degrade most in the least deterministic bins, while DBLAST improves accepted length in every bin, with the largest relative gains where early positions have multiple plausible continuations.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20–30 minutes. Read the Introduction for the mismatch between independent block sampling and sequential verification. Then inspect the early-determinism analysis around Figure 1. In the method section, focus on the latent-mixture parameterization and the accepted-length surrogate. The most relevant experimental results are the high-entropy Qwen3-8B accepted-length comparisons, especially for readers interested in RL rollouts or open-ended generation.

recommendation.zh: 只看熵升高下 accepted length 崩掉的实验和 loss 设计；这对采样式 serving 比常规 greedy 加速更有用。
recommendation.en: Read the entropy-vs-accepted-length results and the loss design; this is more relevant to sampling-heavy serving than standard greedy acceleration.

paper.title: EdgeXpert: An Edge Device for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference with Mixture-of-Experts and Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: On-device deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) has become essential for personalized edge applications. A primary bottleneck is external memory access (EMA) in feed-forward network (FFN) layers. Speculative decoding and mixture-of-experts (MoE) are promising solutions. Speculative decoding reduces the number of decoding stages by generating multiple tokens per stage, and MoE minimizes per-stage cost through sparse expert activation. However, there is an incompatibility when combining these

summary.core_problem: 边缘设备LLM推理中，MoE与推测解码结合存在不兼容问题，FFN层的外部内存访问（EMA）是主要性能瓶颈
summary.importance: 系统/工程创新，提出软硬件协同的LLM加速器方案，解决MoE与推测解码的兼容问题，降低边缘LLM推理的内存访问开销
summary.technical_approach: 提出EdgeXpert软硬件协同加速器：预填充阶段将逐token独立路由重构为prompt级专家复用，用轻量编码器识别重要token构建共享专家集，降低非重要token的专家预算以减少EMA；解码阶段采用深度感知专家策略（摘要截断）
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未披露完整实验设置、模型规模、基线与效果数据
summary.authors_note: 未披露机构信息，Hoi-Jun Yoo为低功耗AI加速器领域知名学者

summary_en.core_problem: Combining Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and speculative decoding for on-device LLM inference faces incompatibility issues, with external memory access (EMA) in FFN layers being the primary bottleneck
summary_en.importance: System/engineering innovation: a software-hardware co-designed LLM accelerator is proposed to resolve the incompatibility between MoE and speculative decoding, reducing memory access overhead for edge LLM inference
summary_en.technical_approach: EdgeXpert, a software-hardware co-designed accelerator, reformulates per-token routing as prompt-level expert reuse in the prefill stage: a lightweight encoder identifies important tokens to build a shared expert set, and less important tokens are routed with a reduced expert budget to lower EMA; depth-aware expert policy is used in the decode stage (abstract truncated)
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; full experimental setup, model scale, baselines, and results are not disclosed
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations not disclosed; Hoi-Jun Yoo is a well-known scholar in low-power AI accelerators

recommendation.zh: 边缘LLM推理的软硬件协同工作，MoE路由优化思路偏硬件侧，预训练研究员无需深读
recommendation.en: Software-hardware co-design for edge LLM inference; MoE routing optimization is hardware-focused, no deep reading needed for pretraining researchers.

paper.title: SpecRoll: Fast-Slow Verifier-Feedback Adaptation for Speculative Reinforcement Learning Rollouts
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but autoregressive rollout generation remains a major efficiency bottleneck. Speculative decoding can accelerate generation, yet applying it during RL is difficult because the target policy continually evolves: static proposers become stale, while frequent drafter updates add substantial overhead. We introduce SpecRoll, a speculative rollout engine that preserves the target model's sampling di

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 RL post-training 里一个很具体但很关键的瓶颈：GRPO 这类 group-based RL 需要反复生成长 rollout，而 rollout 生成仍是逐 token 的主耗时。把 speculative decoding 直接搬到 RL 里并不顺，因为 target policy 在训练中持续漂移，静态 drafter 很快过时；如果像 FastGRPO 那样在线训练一个独立 drafter，又会引入额外反向传播、优化器状态、同步和 KV cache 成本。论文要解决的核心问题，是在不改变目标采样分布、不过多增加训练系统复杂度的前提下，让 speculative rollout 能适应 RL 中的非平稳策略，并在 wall-clock 上稳定提速。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是直接改 pretrain objective，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口很有参考价值，尤其是大模型后训练阶段的系统效率问题。它的重要性主要有三点。第一，它把“精确 speculative decoding”从静态推理场景推进到在线变化的 RL rollout 场景，说明 rollout engine 也可以作为训练算法的一部分被设计。第二，它提出了两时间尺度适应：局部、无梯度、轨迹内修正处理短期失配；慢速参数更新处理持续漂移。这种分层适应思路，对持续预训练、mid-training、online data selection 也有启发。第三，它避免了单独训练一个 autoregressive drafter，而是用 target hidden state 上的 lightweight future-token heads 做 proposal，这在工程上更轻，也更接近“在主模型内部长出辅助预测头”的路线。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个 exact speculative rollout engine，名字叫 SpecRoll。它由四个部件组成。

第一，proposal family 不是独立 drafter，而是挂在 target backbone hidden state 上的多 horizon future-token heads，形式上接近 MEDUSA。给定前缀 x_{<=t}，target 先精确采样一个 anchor token x_{t+1}，然后多个 head 并行预测后续若干位置的 token，复用 target 的词表投影矩阵 W。这些候选组成一个 prefix-closed sparse tree。这样做的好处是省掉第二个 AR backbone 和对应 KV cache，proposal 成本更低，也减少了 target/drafter 失配来源。

第二，verification 是 exact 的，而且是 concurrency-aware 的。RL rollout 里同时活跃的样本数会随着部分样本提前结束而下降，因此固定大小的 speculative tree 在高并发阶段可能浪费验证算力，在低并发阶段又吃不满硬件。SpecRoll 会根据当前 active concurrency 动态调整 sparse tree 的预算：并发高时保守，减少额外验证负担；并发下降后扩大 tree，换取更高 accepted progress。论文的出发点不是单纯提高单条序列 acceptance，而是优化整个 GRPO rollout 阶段的吞吐。

第三，快路径是 Reflex。它利用“延迟 verifier 反馈在同一轨迹邻近位置上仍有预测性”这一观察，对 proposal hidden state 做 bounded、trajectory-local、gradient-free correction。这里的关键不是学习一个新模型，而是把已经成熟的 verifier error 当作局部校正信号，在不反传的情况下修正后续 proposal。为了避免误修正，作者加了 conservative alignment gate：只有当过去误差对未来仍有可预测性时才启用；同时还有 candidate-boundary safeguard，防止在候选边界附近做有害干预。这个设计试图区分 transient local mismatch 和 persistent drift：前者不值得动参数，局部修一下就够；后者才交给慢路径。

第四，慢路径只在 sustained degradation 被检测到时，才更新 future-token heads 的参数。也就是说，SpecRoll 不把所有失配都转成在线学习问题，而是先用 Reflex 吃掉短期、局部、轨迹内的偏差，把真正跨轨迹持续存在的 proposal 退化留给参数更新。这一点和 FastGRPO 的持续在线训练独立 drafter 不同，后者把适应主要放在参数层，代价更高，也不区分误差类型。

从训练目标上，SpecRoll 始终保持 exact target verification 为最终裁决，因此 committed token 的分布不变，GRPO 的 reward、advantage 和优化目标都不被改写。它优化的是 rollout 生成过程，而不是 RL objective 本身。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 5 个模型、参数规模从 1.5B 到 14B，3 个数学推理数据集，共 15 个 model-dataset 组合。主结果是：相对 vanilla GRPO，generation speedup 达到 1.26× 到 2.15×，end-to-end speedup 达到 1.21× 到 2.04×。和 FastGRPO 做 matched setting 对比时，SpecRoll 在全部 15 个组合上 generation 和 end-to-end 时间都更好，平均 pairwise end-to-end gain 为 1.18×。

这些数字说明两件事。第一，收益不只是 token generation microbenchmark 上的局部加速，而是能传导到完整 RL 训练回路。第二，轻量 proposal + 两时间尺度适应，至少在作者测试的规模和任务上，比“单独维护一个在线 drafter”更划算。

消融部分的关键信息是：快路径和慢路径都各自有贡献，组合时效果最好。也就是说，Reflex 并不是一个可有可无的小修补；它确实能吸收一部分短期失配。反过来，只有 Reflex 也不够，因为 policy drift 会跨轨迹累积，最终仍需要慢速参数更新。另一个值得注意的点是 concurrency-aware tree budget 的作用，它解释了为什么同样是 speculative decoding，在 RL rollout 里不能直接照搬固定树结构的推理配置。

从论文给出的结果看，作者更强调 wall-clock 和 end-to-end efficiency，而不是 reward 或 final accuracy 的显著变化。这是合理的，因为 exact verification 保证了采样分布不变，理论上训练信号应保持一致，主要差异体现在吞吐和系统开销上。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但如果你做 RL 系统或 post-training infra，方法部分值得认真看。

建议先看 Introduction，抓住它和 FastGRPO 的分歧：不是再训练一个更聪明的 drafter，而是把适应拆成局部无梯度修正和低频参数更新。然后重点看 Figure 2 和 Method 里 proposal engine 的定义，理解 future-token heads、anchor token、sparse tree、exact verification 之间的关系。

接着看 Reflex 相关章节，重点不是公式细节，而是三个判断：为什么 verifier 的延迟误差在邻近位置仍可用；alignment gate 如何决定何时修正；candidate-boundary safeguard 为什么必要。这里最值得深挖的是，它其实在利用 rollout 轨迹内部的短程误差相关性，这和很多训练系统只做全局平均统计不同。

实验部分优先看主表和 ablation。主表看三件事：对 vanilla GRPO 的 generation/end-to-end 提升、对 FastGRPO 的 pairwise 优势、不同模型规模下收益是否稳定。消融则看 fast path、slow path、concurrency-aware budget 分别拿掉后的退化幅度。

如果时间有限，预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主要贡献；如果要复现或迁移到自家 RL 系统，Reflex 触发条件、慢路径更新频率、tree budget 调度策略需要细读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete bottleneck in RL post-training: GRPO-style training needs many long rollouts, and autoregressive generation dominates wall-clock time. Speculative decoding is a natural acceleration tool, but RL makes it harder because the target policy keeps changing. A static proposer quickly becomes stale, while continuously training a separate drafter adds backward passes, optimizer state, synchronization overhead, and extra KV-cache cost. The core problem is how to make speculative rollouts adapt to a non-stationary policy while preserving the exact target sampling distribution and keeping the system lightweight.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-post-train interface and for large-scale training systems. Its contribution is important in three ways. First, it extends exact speculative decoding from static inference into online RL rollouts, treating the rollout engine itself as part of the training algorithm. Second, it introduces a two-timescale adaptation scheme: local, gradient-free, within-trajectory correction for transient mismatch, and slower parameter updates for persistent drift. That separation is relevant beyond RL, including continual pretraining and other non-stationary training loops. Third, it avoids a standalone autoregressive drafter and instead uses lightweight future-token heads on top of the target hidden states, which is a cleaner and cheaper design.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SpecRoll is an exact speculative rollout engine built from four main pieces.

First, the proposer is not a separate drafter model. It uses MEDUSA-style future-token heads attached to the target backbone hidden state. Given a prefix, the target model samples an exact anchor token x_{t+1}, and multiple horizon heads predict later positions in parallel, reusing the target vocabulary projection. These candidates form a prefix-closed sparse tree. This removes the need for a second autoregressive backbone and its KV cache, reducing proposal cost and simplifying synchronization.

Second, verification remains exact and is made concurrency-aware. In GRPO, the number of active rollouts changes over time because some responses finish earlier than others. A fixed speculative tree is therefore inefficient: too expensive when concurrency is high, and too small to saturate hardware when concurrency drops. SpecRoll adjusts the sparse-tree budget based on active concurrency, using a smaller budget early and a larger one later. The objective is not just better acceptance on a single sequence, but better throughput for the whole rollout stage.

Third, the fast adaptation path is Reflex. The key observation is that delayed verifier errors can still be predictive for nearby future positions within the same trajectory. Reflex converts such mature verifier feedback into bounded, trajectory-local hidden-state corrections without backpropagation. It is guarded by a conservative alignment gate, which activates only when past errors are predictive of future mismatch, and by candidate-boundary safeguards that suppress harmful interventions near unstable boundaries. The design explicitly separates transient local mismatch from persistent drift.

Fourth, the slow path updates the future-token heads only when sustained degradation is detected. In other words, SpecRoll does not treat every mismatch as an online learning problem. It first uses Reflex to absorb short-lived, local errors, and only escalates recurring cross-trajectory mismatch into parameter updates. This differs from FastGRPO, where adaptation relies more heavily on continuously training a separate drafter.

Throughout the method, exact target verification is authoritative. The committed-token distribution is unchanged, so rewards, advantages, and the GRPO objective remain intact. The method changes rollout efficiency, not the RL objective.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers five models from 1.5B to 14B parameters and three math reasoning datasets, for 15 matched model-dataset settings. Against vanilla GRPO, SpecRoll reports 1.26x to 2.15x generation speedup and 1.21x to 2.04x end-to-end speedup. Against FastGRPO, it is better on both generation time and end-to-end time in all 15 matched settings, with an average pairwise end-to-end gain of 1.18x.

These results matter for two reasons. First, the gains are not limited to token-generation microbenchmarks; they carry through to the full RL training loop. Second, the combination of lightweight proposal heads and two-timescale adaptation appears more cost-effective than maintaining a separately trained online drafter, at least in the tested regime.

The ablations show that both the fast path and the slow path help individually, and the combination works best. That means Reflex is not a cosmetic add-on; it absorbs a meaningful portion of transient mismatch. At the same time, Reflex alone is insufficient because policy drift accumulates across trajectories, so slow parameter updates are still needed. Another useful finding is the role of the concurrency-aware tree budget, which explains why speculative decoding settings from ordinary inference do not transfer directly to RL rollouts.

The paper focuses on wall-clock and end-to-end efficiency rather than final reward improvements, which is consistent with the exact-verification design: the training signal should remain unchanged, while throughput improves.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper overall, but it is worth a closer read if you work on RL systems or post-training infrastructure.

Start with the introduction and isolate the main design choice relative to FastGRPO: instead of training a better standalone drafter, SpecRoll splits adaptation into local gradient-free correction and infrequent parameter updates. Then read Figure 2 and the method section around the proposal engine to understand the interaction among future-token heads, the anchor token, the sparse tree, and exact verification.

Next, focus on the Reflex section. The main questions are not the algebra but the mechanism: why delayed verifier errors remain useful locally, how the alignment gate decides when to intervene, and why candidate-boundary safeguards are necessary. The interesting systems idea is that the method exploits short-range error correlation inside a rollout trajectory.

In the experiments, prioritize the main timing table and the ablations. Check three things in the main results: gains over vanilla GRPO, pairwise wins over FastGRPO, and stability across model scales. In the ablations, look at what happens when the fast path, slow path, or concurrency-aware budget is removed.

If time is limited, 25 to 35 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. For implementation or reproduction, the most important details are the Reflex trigger conditions, the slow-path update schedule, and the tree-budget policy.

recommendation.zh: RL训练rollout加速的实用方案，重点看Reflex模块的无反向传播隐状态修正设计，可直接复现到内部RLHF pipeline
recommendation.en: Practical scheme for RL training rollout acceleration; focus on backprop-free hidden state correction in the Reflex module, directly reproducible for internal RLHF pipelines

paper.title: Speculative Correction: Draft-then-Refine Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) can revise tokens bidirectionally, but standard decoding procedures often adapt them to left-to-right generation by producing text block by block. We study a simple plug-and-play inference pattern: first generate a complete draft, then refine the full response using bidirectional diffusion. Using LLaDA2.1-Flash and LLaDA2.1-Mini, we evaluate two configurations. In Flash-Flash, the same Flash model serves as both drafter and refiner, testing whether an existing mo

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 diffusion language model 的解码方式：现有 DLM 常用 block autoregressive decoding，把序列分块从左到右生成，虽然方便接入常规语言任务，但削弱了 DLM 可以双向修改整段文本的能力。作者提出先生成完整草稿、再用全序列 diffusion refinement 修正的推理模式。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对新型语言建模范式有直接启发。它不改训练目标，也不改模型结构，而是证明现有 DLM checkpoint 中已经存在一定的全局修正能力。这个结论重要在于：DLM 的优势不一定体现在完全替代 AR 解码，而可能体现在“完整候选答案 + 双向编辑”的计算分配方式上。对预训练研究而言，它提示 DLM 训练分布和推理初始化之间仍有错配：refiner 训练时见到的是前向加噪样本，推理时却要修正另一个模型或 block-AR 产生的自然语言草稿。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 plug-and-play 的 draft-then-refine decoding。第一阶段用 DLM 快速生成完整回答草稿；第二阶段把草稿作为可编辑初始化，由更强或相同的 DLM 在全序列上做双向 denoising。论文测试两种配置。flash–flash 使用 LLaDA2.1-flash 同时作为 drafter 和 refiner，用来验证同一个 checkpoint 是否能改进自身 block-AR 输出。mini–flash 使用 LLaDA2.1-mini 生成草稿，再用 LLaDA2.1-flash 修正，作者称为 speculative correction。它和自回归 speculative decoding 不同：后者是小模型逐 token 提案、大模型验证接受；这里大模型不做 token-level accept/reject，而是能在任意位置重写文本，利用左右上下文一起纠错。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 LLaDA2.1-flash 和 LLaDA2.1-mini，在 GSM8K、MATH、MBPP 等任务上比较质量与延迟。flash–flash 在 GSM8K-384 上从 0.848 提升到 0.899，同时快 1.20×；在 MBPP-384 上 pass rate 从 0.545 提升到 0.693。作者还设置了 latency-window-matched 的 flash-only 控制实验，用来排除收益只是来自 block-AR schedule 没调好的解释。mini–flash 的结果更像质量-延迟折中：MATH-384 上得分 0.294，接近 flash baseline 0.300，同时快 2.17×，约恢复 mini 到 flash 质量差距的 79%；MBPP-384 上从 mini-only 的 0.401 提升到 0.568，高于文中选定 flash baseline 0.545，同时快 1.11×。在 GSM8K 和 MATH-512 上，mini–flash 仍更快，但不能完全恢复 flash 的质量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30–40 分钟。重点看 introduction 中对 block-AR diffusion 局限的定义、draft-then-refine 的具体推理流程、flash–flash 与 mini–flash 的实验设置，以及 latency-matched control。最值得深挖的是 refiner 输入分布错配问题：训练时 refiner 学的是从噪声恢复文本，推理时面对的是一个模型生成的有结构但带错误的草稿。如果后续训练能显式加入 draft corruption 或 model-generated draft，可能会比纯推理技巧更稳。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies decoding for diffusion language models. Current DLM generation often uses block autoregressive decoding: generate one block at a time from left to right, while allowing bidirectional attention only inside each block. This makes DLMs usable for standard language tasks, but it underuses their ability to revise an entire sequence bidirectionally. The proposed inference pattern first drafts a full response, then refines the full sequence with diffusion.
summary_en.importance: The paper is directly relevant to alternative language-modeling paradigms. It shows that existing DLM checkpoints may already contain useful global correction behavior, even without retraining or architectural changes. The more general lesson is that DLMs may not need to compete with AR models only through left-to-right generation. Their useful operating point may be full-candidate generation followed by bidirectional editing. The work also exposes an important training-inference mismatch: the refiner is trained on samples from a forward noising process, but at inference time it must repair a structured draft produced by block-AR decoding or by another model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is a plug-and-play draft-then-refine decoder. The first stage produces a complete response draft. The second stage treats that draft as an editable initialization and applies full-sequence bidirectional denoising. Two configurations are evaluated. In flash–flash, LLaDA2.1-flash is both drafter and refiner, isolating whether the same checkpoint can improve its own block-AR output. In mini–flash, LLaDA2.1-mini drafts and LLaDA2.1-flash refines; the authors call this speculative correction. Unlike autoregressive speculative decoding, the larger model does not accept or reject tokens one by one. It can rewrite any position using global context, closer in spirit to cascaded diffusion systems in vision.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use LLaDA2.1-flash and LLaDA2.1-mini on GSM8K, MATH, and MBPP, reporting both quality and latency. In the flash–flash setting, GSM8K-384 accuracy improves from 0.848 to 0.899 while running 1.20× faster. MBPP-384 pass rate improves from 0.545 to 0.693. A latency-window-matched flash-only control is used to check that the gain is not merely due to an undertuned block-AR schedule. In the mini–flash setting, the method defines a quality-latency tradeoff rather than uniformly dominating flash decoding. On MATH-384, it scores 0.294 versus a flash baseline of 0.300 while running 2.17× faster, recovering about 79% of the mini-to-flash quality gap. On MBPP-384, it improves mini-only decoding from 0.401 to 0.568, slightly above the selected flash baseline of 0.545, while running 1.11× faster. On GSM8K and MATH-512, it remains faster but does not fully recover flash quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–40 minutes. Focus on the introduction’s framing of block-AR diffusion, the exact draft-then-refine inference procedure, the distinction between flash–flash and mini–flash, and the latency-matched controls. The most useful point to inspect is the input-distribution mismatch for the refiner: during training it denoises corrupted text, while at inference it edits a model-generated draft with semantic and reasoning errors. Future training recipes that include draft-style corruptions or model-generated drafts may make this decoding pattern more reliable.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把 DLM 的优势从“训练目标”落到“解码机制”上；先读 latency-matched 对照，若成立，说明很多 DLM 负结果可能只是 decode 用错了。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it moves the DLM story from training objective to decoding mechanics; start with the latency-matched controls—if they hold, many negative takes on DLMs may just be using the wrong decoder.

paper.title: AcceptMoE: Commitment-Weighted Self-Sizing Verifier Expert Sets for Efficient MoE Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding verifies a tree of draft tokens in one target-model forward pass. For a mixture-of-experts (MoE) target, however, parallel verification can activate the union of the experts selected by all tree nodes, even though only a small subset of those nodes reaches the accepted output. Token count, activated-expert union size, and expert-weight traffic are therefore distinct cost measures: reducing the token workload need not shrink the expert union proportionally, and under offloadi

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 MoE 目标模型做 speculative decoding 时的 verifier 侧专家访问成本问题：验证 token 变少，不代表被激活的专家并集也按比例变小，尤其在 expert offloading 场景下，真正昂贵的是非驻留专家权重传输。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 MoE 基座模型的 serving 和架构实验有参考价值。论文把 speculative decoding 的成本拆成三个不同量：token 数、activated-expert union size、expert-weight traffic。这个拆分很实用，因为 MoE 推理瓶颈常常不是算子 FLOPs，而是专家权重访问和搬运。对研究者的启发是：评估 MoE 解码优化时，不能只看 accepted tokens 或 target forward 次数，还要看专家并集、cache residency 和路由扰动带来的精度变化。
summary.technical_approach:
AcceptMoE 是 verifier-side expert selector。它不改变 draft 生成逻辑，而是在 target verifier 对一个 speculative verification block 做验证时，限制每层可用的专家集合。

方法有三步。第一，构造 commitment-weighted expert demand。对每个 draft position，作者离线估计该位置节点最终被 committed 到输出中的概率，再用这个概率加权 target router 的自然 top-k 专家分数。这样，越可能进入最终输出的位置，对专家需求的贡献越大；越可能被丢弃的分支，对专家选择的影响越小。它区别于 MoE-Spec 的地方是，MoE-Spec 对 verification block 内位置做近似均匀聚合，并要求外部给定固定专家预算 B。

第二，自适应决定专家集合大小。AcceptMoE 总是保留 root token 的自然 top-k 专家作为 anchor，避免根位置路由被破坏；其余专家按 weighted demand 排序选择。集合大小由 demand 分布的 effective rank 决定，即 exp(entropy)。需求越集中，集合越小；需求越分散，集合越大。因此它不需要预先为每个模型-任务组合调一个固定 B。

第三，针对 expert offloading 做 residency-aware pruning。若某些被选中的专家当前不在 GPU 上，方法会按 commitment-weighted demand 从低到高剪掉一部分非驻留专家，同时受 rerouting budget 和 minimum set size 约束。这样专家 eligibility 会考虑缓存状态，而不是单纯预测自然路由并预取。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 3 个 MoE target、4 个任务，共 12 个 model-task pairs，并在 SGLang serving stack 中做 batch size 1 的端到端测量。论文还指出一个动机数字：在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上，EVICT 相比 EAGLE-3 减少了 74.7% verified tokens，但 activated experts 只减少了 32.5%，说明 token 维度优化不能直接转化为专家权重访问优化。

核心结果如下。与 MoE-Spec 在匹配的 per-pair fixed budget B0 下比较，AcceptMoE-B 的平均 accuracy 高 2.45 个百分点。自适应 self-sized 版本在五个做 budget sweep 的模型-任务组合上，平均只比实测最佳 fixed-budget 点低 0.97 个百分点，最大差距 1.83 个百分点。offloading 场景中，residency-aware pruning 相比不剪枝版本减少 38.6% 到 48.6% 的 expert-weight traffic，平均 accuracy 变化为 -0.27 个百分点，单 pair 范围为 -1.83 到 +1.22 个百分点。

端到端结果中，AcceptMoE 相比 Standard SD，即使用 target 自然路由的 EAGLE-3 speculative decoding，平均 accuracy 低 0.27 个百分点。在全专家驻留时吞吐达到 Standard SD 的 1.290 倍，并在一张 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 上达到最高 257 tokens/s。在 expert offloading 的一张 RTX 5090 上达到 2.06 倍吞吐，同时减少 73.6% 到 77.1% 的 host-to-device traffic。
summary.reading_guide:
建议泛读，预计 25-35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 MoE speculative decoding 成本的拆分，以及 Method 中 commitment-weighted demand、effective-rank self-sizing、residency-aware pruning 三个模块。实验部分重点看三类表：与 MoE-Spec 的 matched-budget accuracy 对比，self-sized 与 fixed-budget sweep 的差距，offloading 下的 traffic 和 throughput。

如果只关心预训练方向，可以略读实现细节，保留两个观察：MoE 推理优化需要显式度量专家并集和权重搬运；路由限制带来的精度损失可以通过 commitment probability 和 root anchor 缓解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets verifier-side expert traffic in MoE speculative decoding. Reducing the number of verified draft tokens does not necessarily reduce the union of activated experts, and under expert offloading the dominant cost is often the transfer of nonresident expert weights.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-systems paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is useful for researchers working with MoE base models. Its most useful point is the separation of three cost measures: token workload, activated-expert union size, and expert-weight traffic. For MoE models, decoding efficiency cannot be evaluated only by accepted tokens or target forward passes. The expert union and cache residency can dominate latency and bandwidth.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AcceptMoE is a verifier-side expert selector. It leaves the draft mechanism intact, but restricts the set of target experts eligible during verification of a speculative block.

The first component is commitment-weighted expert demand. For each draft position, the method uses an offline estimate of the probability that a node at that position will be committed to the final output. It multiplies this commitment probability by the target router’s natural top-k probabilities, then aggregates the weighted demand over the verification block. Positions likely to survive receive more weight; branches likely to be discarded receive less. This differs from MoE-Spec, which aggregates router mass more uniformly and requires a fixed expert budget B.

The second component is self-sizing. AcceptMoE always preserves the root token’s natural top-k experts as anchors. It then ranks non-anchor experts by weighted demand. The number of selected experts is derived from the effective rank of the demand distribution, computed as the exponential of entropy. Concentrated demand yields a smaller set; diffuse demand yields a larger set. This removes the need to tune a fixed budget for every model-task pair.

The third component is residency-aware pruning for offloading. Among selected nonresident experts, the method prunes low-demand experts first, subject to a rerouting budget and a minimum set size. Expert eligibility therefore depends on the current cache residency instead of only on predicted natural routes or a fixed prefetch schedule.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover 3 MoE targets and 4 tasks, giving 12 model-task pairs, with end-to-end measurements in SGLang at batch size 1. The motivation is supported by a concrete example on Qwen3-30B-A3B: EVICT reduces verified tokens by 74.7% relative to EAGLE-3, but reduces activated experts by only 32.5%.

At matched per-pair fixed budgets, AcceptMoE-B improves mean accuracy by 2.45 percentage points over MoE-Spec. In five budget-swept pairs, the self-sized configuration is on average 0.97 percentage points below the best measured fixed-budget point, with a maximum gap of 1.83 points. With offloading, residency-aware pruning reduces expert-weight traffic by 38.6% to 48.6% compared with the same selector without pruning. The mean accuracy change is -0.27 percentage points, with per-pair changes ranging from -1.83 to +1.22 points.

End to end, AcceptMoE is 0.27 percentage points lower in mean accuracy than Standard SD, defined as EAGLE-3 speculative decoding with the target’s natural routing. With all experts resident, it reaches 1.290x the throughput of Standard SD and up to 257 tokens/s on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell. Under expert offloading on one RTX 5090, it reaches 2.06x throughput and reduces host-to-device traffic by 73.6% to 77.1%.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim time is about 25-35 minutes. Start with the Introduction’s cost decomposition for MoE speculative decoding. Then read the Method section for the three main pieces: commitment-weighted demand, effective-rank self-sizing, and residency-aware pruning. In the experiments, focus on the matched-budget comparison against MoE-Spec, the self-sized versus fixed-budget sweep, and the offloading traffic and throughput tables.

For pretraining-oriented readers, the implementation details can be read lightly. The main takeaway is that MoE serving metrics should include expert union size and weight movement, not only token-level speculative decoding statistics. The root-anchor and commitment-weighting design are also useful examples of how to constrain MoE routing without causing large accuracy loss.

recommendation.zh: 针对MoE推测解码的核心痛点（专家并集膨胀），核心看§3的commitment probability估计方法和§4的卸载适配逻辑，做MoE推理的可复现
recommendation.en: Targets the core pain point of MoE speculative decoding (expert union bloat); focus on §3 commitment probability estimation and §4 offloading adaptation, reproducible for MoE inference teams

paper.title: Oilbird: Training-Free Speculative Decoding with Keys the Verifier Already Computes
paper.abstract: Training-free speculative decoding drafts by matching an exact suffix of the context against a pool of earlier context. That lookup misses correct drafts already in the pool, most visibly on tool-calling traffic, where a request repeats almost everything but the few values minted for it, and where one rejected token discards the correct continuation behind it. We diagnose the failure position by position across ten benchmarks and find it to be a problem of addressing rather than of coverage: on

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 training-free speculative decoding 中 exact-suffix copy drafter 的寻址失败问题：正确续写已经在历史请求池里，但由于上下文中出现新 token，纯文本后缀匹配无法找到它。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率论文，但对基座研究有两个启发。第一，服务流量中的重复性不只是文本重复，也包含状态相似性；模型 hidden state 可以作为更稳定的语义地址。第二，训练-free 加速方法不一定只能扩大检索池，也可以改进 key 的定义。它对预训练目标没有直接贡献，但对 KV-cache、服务侧冗余利用、agent/tool-calling 场景下的解码加速有清晰价值。
summary.technical_approach: Oilbird 保留现有 copy-based speculative decoding 的基本框架，但把历史 token 位置重新用 verifier 已经计算过的 hidden state 做 key。每次 verifier commit 一个 token 时，系统把该位置的 hidden state 和后续 continuation 存入池中；之后每个生成位置都用当前 hidden state 查询相似历史位置，拿到语义相近位置后的 token 作为 draft。关键点有两个。其一，查询是 per-position 的，而不是只在 request level 做一次，这能绕过局部新 token 造成的匹配断崖。其二，Oilbird 不是在 lexical source 和 semantic source 之间二选一，而是把多个来源的 continuation 合并进同一个 multi-source attention tree；只有分叉节点才增加成本，因此可以在不改变节点预算和验证规则的情况下提高 accepted length。贪心验证下输出保持 lossless，作者还用独立 greedy run 做 token-level audit。
summary.experiments: 论文先做了一个与具体 drafter 无关的诊断，覆盖十个 workload 和两个模型族。在 API-Bank 这个 tool-calling 密集 benchmark 上，92% 的位置其后续 token 已经存在于历史池中，但最强 exact-match oracle 仍错过 13% 的位置；其中约一半属于 identifiability gap，即续写存在但文本后缀 key 无法寻址，占生成位置的 6.8%。这些 gap 后面平均有 6.4 个可逐字匹配的 token。语义 hidden-state key 可以触达其中约五分之四。系统结果上，在 Llama-3.1-8B 的 API-Bank 上达到 4.4× autoregressive decoding speed。per-position 查询相比 faithful request-level 实现提升 36%。在三个已有 drafter 内加入该 semantic source，在相同 pool 和节点预算下 accepted length 增加 24–29%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 分钟。先看 The Identifiability Gap 和 Figure 1，理解 exact-suffix key 为什么会在新值 token 后失效。再看 Table 7，确认作者把 coverage failure 和 addressing failure 分开测量的方式。方法部分重点看 hidden-state key 如何记录、检索和并入 attention tree。Figure 4 和系统实验值得看，因为它说明 Oilbird 不是替换已有 drafter，而是作为额外 draft source 嵌入已有树结构。局限也要注意：收益主要来自高重复的服务流量，尤其是 tool-calling；对开放式长文本生成不应直接外推。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an addressing failure in training-free speculative decoding: the correct continuation is often already present in the history pool, but exact suffix matching cannot retrieve it once a newly minted token appears in the context.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper, but it has useful implications for foundation-model serving research. It shows that redundancy in production traffic is not only lexical; similar model states can identify reusable continuations even when the local text suffix fails. The result suggests that training-free acceleration can improve by changing the retrieval key, not only by increasing the store size. The work is most relevant to KV-cache usage, traffic-level reuse, and tool-calling agent serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: Oilbird keeps the standard copy-based speculative decoding setup and adds a semantic draft source. Each committed token is tagged with the hidden state that the verifier has already computed. Later, at every generation position, the current hidden state queries past positions in the same pool, and the retrieved neighbors provide candidate continuations. Two design choices matter. First, the query is performed per position rather than once per request, which lets the method recover after local novel tokens such as identifiers or names. Second, semantic continuations are merged into the same multi-source attention tree used by lexical drafters, instead of choosing one source over another. The tree pays extra only where continuations diverge, so the method can preserve the verifier cost, node budget, and acceptance rule. Under greedy verification, the output remains lossless, and the authors audit it token by token against an independent greedy run.
summary_en.experiments: The paper provides a method-independent diagnosis on ten workloads and two model families. On API-Bank, a dense tool-calling benchmark, 92% of positions have their next-token continuation already available in the history pool. Yet a strong exact-match oracle still misses 13% of positions; about half of these misses are present-but-unreachable cases, forming a 6.8% identifiability gap. Behind those gap positions, a neighbor contains an average 6.4-token verbatim run. The hidden-state key reaches roughly four out of five of these positions. In system results, Oilbird reaches 4.4× autoregressive decoding speed on API-Bank with Llama-3.1-8B. Per-position querying improves over a faithful request-level implementation by 36%. When inserted into three existing drafters with the same pool and node budget, it increases accepted length by 24–29%.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25-minute skim is appropriate. Read The Identifiability Gap and Figure 1 first; they explain why exact suffix matching fails after a novel value token. Table 7 is useful for checking how the paper separates coverage failures from addressing failures. Then read the hidden-state key construction and the merge procedure for the multi-source attention tree. Figure 4 and the system results are the most important empirical parts, because they show that Oilbird complements existing drafters rather than replacing them. The main caveat is workload dependence: the gains are strongest in highly repetitive serving traffic, especially tool-calling traces, and should not be assumed for open-ended generation.

recommendation.zh: 推理组应读失败诊断和 ablation；对 pretrain 的启发是 hidden-state locality 可被服务端复用。
recommendation.en: Inference teams should read the failure diagnosis and ablations; the pretraining-side lesson is reusable hidden-state locality.

paper.title: Approximate Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by verifying a draft block with a target model in parallel. Under standard greedy verification, decoding stops at the first draft token that differs from the target argmax, discarding the remaining target-scored suffix. Although accepting such a mismatch changes the decoding trajectory, it can make a contiguous suffix reusable when its tokens remain target-greedy under the realized prefix. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{Approximate

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是 speculative decoding 中 verifier 过于保守的问题：标准 greedy verification 一旦遇到 draft token 与 target argmax 不一致，就截断整个 block，即使这个 mismatch 的 target-logit regret 很小，且后续 token 在接受该 mismatch 后仍然会被 target 判为 greedy token。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，主要价值在推理效率和 serving。它有一个清晰的提醒：很多解码加速方法把“保持目标模型轨迹不变”作为硬约束，而 ASD 选择显式放松这个约束，用可计量的局部 regret 换取吞吐。这个思路对基座研究也有参考意义，尤其是研究训练目标、解码目标和任务正确性之间并不完全等价时。论文也比较克制地说明，ASD 只控制累计 local regret，不保证输出一致、语义一致或任务正确。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 training-free verifier 改造，不训练 draft model，也不增加额外 target forward。标准 speculative decoding 对 draft block 做 teacher-forced target pass，得到每个位置的 target logits。严格 verifier 只接受从开头开始完全等于 target argmax 的最长前缀。ASD 把它改成 budgeted longest-prefix selection：遇到 mismatch 时，计算 local target-logit regret，即 target argmax 相对 draft token 的 logit 差；只有 regret 小于阈值、当前 block 的 exception 数不超过上限、整个 request 的累计 regret budget 仍可用，才允许接受这个 mismatch。关键细节是 realized-prefix suffix reuse：如果接受了早期 mismatch，那么后续 teacher-forced target row 已经是在包含该 mismatch 的 draft prefix 上计算的；因此后面连续等于 target argmax 的 draft token 可以直接提交，不需要重新跑 target。这个设计区别于简单放宽 token match 的方法，因为它不是逐 token 独立放行，而是维护 request-level ledger，防止长输出中小偏差不断累积。
summary.experiments: 实验主要报告固定 workload 下的吞吐收益和接受率变化。Qwen3-14B 作为 target、DSpark-14B 作为 draft，在 7 个任务上，ASD 相比匹配设置下的严格 speculative decoding，最高提升 15.26% fixed-workload throughput，平均提升 7.78%。在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 285B 与 DSpark 的设置中，论文还报告了 FP4-to-FP8 compatibility 下的接受率改进：GSM8K 和 MATH-500 上约有 10% 到 16% 的提升。消融重点不是模型训练，而是 verifier 策略：local regret threshold、block-level exception cap、request-level budget，以及可复用 suffix 的出现频率。论文也指出 opportunity rate 和最终 TPS 不是严格因果对应关系，因为系统吞吐还受 batch、cache、内存带宽和实现细节影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 first-mismatch truncation 的问题定义，以及 Approximate Speculative Decoding 一节中 local target-logit regret、request-level budget 和 suffix reuse 的形式化。图 1 和图 3 值得看：前者解释为什么接受一个 mismatch 后后缀可以复用，后者给出这种机会在不同任务和阈值下的经验分布。实验部分主要看固定 workload TPS，而不是只看 acceptance rate。需要特别留意论文的边界条件：ASD 是近似解码，不是 lossless serving 优化；如果部署在高精度数学、代码生成或安全敏感场景，需要额外验证任务级错误率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an overly strict verification rule in speculative decoding. Standard greedy verification stops at the first draft token that differs from the target argmax, even when the mismatch has very small target-logit regret and the following draft tokens would still be target-greedy under the prefix that includes the accepted mismatch.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is inference efficiency rather than pretraining. Its useful lesson is that exact target-trajectory preservation is only one operating point. ASD makes a controlled tradeoff: it spends a measured local-regret budget to gain more reusable target-scored tokens. This is also a useful framing for pretraining researchers studying the gap between token-level objectives, decoding trajectories, and task-level correctness. The paper is careful about the limitation: ASD bounds accumulated local regret, but it does not guarantee identical outputs, semantic preservation, or task correctness.
summary_en.technical_approach: ASD is a training-free verifier-side modification. It uses the same teacher-forced target pass as standard speculative decoding. Instead of accepting only the longest prefix that exactly matches the target argmax, it selects the longest prefix subject to three constraints: a local target-logit regret threshold for mismatched tokens, a per-block cap on the number of accepted exceptions, and a persistent request-level regret budget. The central mechanism is realized-prefix suffix reuse. Once an early mismatch is accepted, later target rows in the teacher-forced pass are already conditioned on the draft prefix containing that mismatch. If subsequent draft tokens equal the corresponding target argmax under that realized prefix, they can be committed without another target forward pass. This differs from a naive relaxed matcher because deviations are explicitly accounted for over the whole request rather than reset at every block.
summary_en.experiments: The reported gains are throughput-oriented. With Qwen3-14B as the target and DSpark-14B as the draft model, ASD improves fixed-workload throughput over matched strict speculative decoding by up to 15.26%, with a 7.78% average gain across seven tasks. With DeepSeek-V4-Flash at 285B parameters and DSpark, the paper reports roughly 10% to 16% acceptance improvements on GSM8K and MATH-500 under FP4-to-FP8 compatibility. The ablations focus on verifier controls: regret threshold, block exception cap, request-level budget, and the empirical frequency of reusable suffixes. The paper also notes that opportunity rate does not directly determine TPS, since serving performance depends on batching, cache handling, memory bandwidth, and implementation details.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the Introduction for the precise failure mode of first-mismatch truncation. Then focus on the ASD formulation: local target-logit regret, budget accounting, and realized-prefix suffix reuse. Figure 1 is the key intuition for suffix reuse; Figure 3 is useful for understanding how often low-regret mismatches followed by greedy suffixes appear. In the experiments, prioritize fixed-workload TPS over raw acceptance rate. The main caveat is important: ASD is approximate decoding, not a lossless serving optimization, so task-level error should be checked before use in math, code, or safety-sensitive generation.

recommendation.zh: 训练免费的推测解码实用改进，无需改模型即可提升接受率，部署侧可直接接入验证，只看§3算法和核心ablation即可。
recommendation.en: A practical training-free tweak to speculative decoding that boosts acceptance rate without model changes; skip to §3 for the algorithm and core ablation results for deployment validation.

paper.title: From Chains to Trees: Parent-Conditioned Drafting for Semi-Autoregressive Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference only when drafted continuations survive target-model verification.
