Semi-autoregressive drafters such as DSpark predict an entire token block with one backbone forward and refine it with a lightweight Markov head. However, DSpark decodes this block as a single chain, so an early mismatch invalidates the remaining suffix and limits the benefit of large draft blocks.   We show that the conditional structure already learned by DSpark can support multipl

summary.core_problem: 现有半自回归推测解码方法DSpark采用单链式候选生成，块内靠前位置一旦匹配失败会导致整个后缀全部被丢弃，大draft块的接收长度收益被拒绝级联效应限制；直接做父节点无关的树状分支会生成条件不连贯的候选路径，浪费验证预算。
summary.importance: 推理效率方向的免训练改进，不需要重新训练draft模型、不增加骨干网络前向次数，即可在现有DSpark基础上进一步提升端到端推理速度，对半自回归类draft架构的推测解码落地有直接工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心观察是DSpark预训练好的一阶Markov头天然支持对每个具体父节点做条件重打分，无需额外训练。PCTree复用单次骨干前向输出的共享位置logits，通过预训练Markov头对树中每个父节点单独计算子节点分布，按固定验证节点预算构造树状候选集，避免父节点无关打分导致的路径不连贯问题；整个修改仅发生在推理阶段，不改动模型参数，也不增加骨干前向次数。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-4B/8B/14B三个模型、9个基准上测试，draft块大小B=7时，相比原版DSpark端到端自回归解码速度提升3.1%~29.5%，所有模型-任务组合的接收长度均有提升；Qwen3-4B GSM8K任务上B=16时，平均接收长度从9.41提升到11.16，端到端速度从6.14×提升到6.60×；设置共享Markov分布的对照组做消融，证明收益来自父节点特异性条件打分而非单纯的树状分支结构。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看引言中的问题拆解、图2的父节点无关分支失败案例、消融实验的对比设计，预计阅读时间15分钟；工程落地可重点关注树构造的预算分配逻辑部分。

summary_en.core_problem: Chain-style semi-autoregressive drafting in DSpark suffers from rejection cascades: an early token mismatch invalidates all subsequent suffix tokens in the block, capping acceptance length gains for large draft blocks. Naive parent-independent tree branching generates conditionally incoherent candidate paths and wastes verification budget.
summary_en.importance: A training-free inference optimization for speculative decoding that improves end-to-end speed over existing DSpark implementations without retraining the drafter or adding extra backbone forward passes, with direct engineering value for deploying semi-autoregressive speculative decoding systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key observation is that DSpark's pretrained first-order Markov head natively supports parent-conditional rescoring with no additional training. PCTree reuses shared position logits from a single backbone forward pass, runs the pretrained Markov head to compute child token distributions separately for each concrete parent node in the draft tree, and constructs a candidate tree under a fixed verification node budget to avoid incoherent paths generated by parent-agnostic scoring. The entire modification operates at inference time with no parameter changes or extra backbone passes.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across Qwen3-{4B,8B,14B} on 9 benchmarks, PCTree delivers 3.1%–29.5% end-to-end AR speedup over vanilla DSpark at block size B=7, with consistent acceptance length improvements across all model-task pairs. On Qwen3-4B GSM8K with B=16, mean acceptance length increases from 9.41 to 11.16, and end-to-end speedup improves from 6.14× to 6.60×. A controlled Shared-Markov ablation confirms gains come from parent-specific conditioning rather than branching alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim this paper; focus on the problem breakdown in the introduction, the parent-agnostic branching failure case in Figure 2, and the ablation study design. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes. Engineers implementing this method can prioritize the budget allocation logic for tree construction.

recommendation.zh: 只看算法和 Qwen3 加速表；它不改训练，但会影响 drafter 结构的预训练取舍。
recommendation.en: Read the algorithm and Qwen3 speed tables; it does not change training, but it informs drafter design choices.

paper.title: Bole: Efficient Tree Speculation for Hybrid-Attention Language Models
paper.abstract: Hybrid-attention large language models combine full attention with recurrent linear attention to reduce long-context inference costs, yet their autoregressive decoding remains memory-bound. Tree speculative decoding offers an attractive acceleration path, but existing tree-speculation systems are designed around the key--value caches of full-attention models. On hybrid models, they traverse recurrent layers branch by branch and materialize a full state for every proposal node, causing verificati

summary.core_problem: 混合注意力大模型在长上下文推理中用循环线性注意力降低单次解码成本，但自回归生成仍然受显存带宽限制。树状投机解码本可通过一次前向验证多条候选路径来加速，然而现有系统主要围绕全注意力的 KV cache 设计；在线性注意力层中，它们只能沿树分支逐条执行循环，并为每个候选节点保存完整状态，导致验证延迟和瞬时显存随树规模、batch 规模快速恶化。
summary.importance: 这项工作关注的是混合注意力模型落地中的真实系统瓶颈。随着 Qwen3.5、Kimi Linear 等全注意力加线性注意力结构进入生产环境，投机解码能否高效作用于循环状态，直接影响长上下文和 agent 场景的 serving 成本。其价值不在新的语言建模目标，而在把树状投机验证从全注意力模型扩展到带循环状态的模型，并给出 kernel 与 runtime 的协同设计。
summary.technical_approach: Bole 包含三个机制。第一，parallel tree solver 将线性注意力循环改写为树结构上的闭式分解，把已提交状态与候选 token 之间的交互分开，形成可在 GPU 上并行求解的结构化线性系统，从而避免父节点到子节点的串行递推。第二，factorized state lifecycle 只保留一个已提交循环状态，候选分支用 token 级因子表示；采样结束后只重建被接受路径的状态，拒绝分支不需要完整状态快照或回滚。第三，hardware-aware verification budget 在运行时 profiling 不同 GPU、batch 和树配置下的有效验证容量，在 batch 内统一分配树预算，而不是为每个请求使用固定容量。
summary.experiments: 论文以 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 这类混合注意力模型为主要对象。瓶颈分析显示，当候选树从 8 个节点扩大到 64 个节点时，线性注意力在目标模型前向中的耗时占比从约 4% 升到 27%；八个 32 节点请求的瞬时循环状态可达到 36 GiB，挤压 KV cache 容量并限制 batch。Bole 通过并行树求解、因子化状态和预算分配降低验证延迟与瞬时显存。提供的全文未展示完整端到端加速比表格，实验细节需参考后续章节。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看引言和问题分析中三个瓶颈的量化图，以及方法部分关于树结构循环闭式分解、状态因子化和硬件感知预算分配的设计。若关注 serving 系统，可进一步追踪 kernel 如何把树依赖映射到 GPU 并行，以及 runtime 如何在不同算子之间分配验证预算。预计用时 30 到 45 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Hybrid-attention LLMs combine full attention with recurrent linear attention to reduce long-context decoding cost, but autoregressive generation remains memory-bound. Tree speculative decoding can verify many candidate tokens in one target-model forward, yet existing systems are built around full-attention KV caches. On recurrent linear-attention layers, they execute the recurrence branch by branch and materialize full states for proposal nodes, causing verification latency and transient memory to scale poorly with tree and batch size.
summary_en.importance: The work addresses a practical deployment bottleneck for hybrid-attention models such as Qwen3.5 and Kimi Linear. As these architectures move into production, efficient speculative decoding over recurrent states matters for long-context and agentic serving cost. Its contribution is systems-level rather than a new language-modeling objective: it extends tree speculation beyond append-only KV caches through a kernel-runtime co-design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Bole has three components. First, a parallel tree solver rewrites the linear-attention recurrence as a tree-structured closed form, separating the committed state from interactions among proposal tokens and producing a structured linear system solved in parallel on GPUs. Second, a factorized state lifecycle keeps one committed state and represents candidate branches with token-scale factors; after sampling, only the accepted state is reconstructed, while rejected branches need no full snapshots or rollback. Third, a hardware-aware verification budget profiles the efficient verification capacity for each GPU, batch, and tree configuration, then allocates a batch-wide budget across requests instead of using a fixed per-request tree size.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation targets hybrid-attention models including Qwen3.5-122B-A10B. Profiling shows that as the proposal tree grows from 8 to 64 nodes, linear attention's share of the target forward rises from about 4% to 27%. For eight requests with 32-node trees, transient recurrent states reach 36 GiB, reducing KV-cache capacity and batching. Bole reduces these costs through parallel tree solving, factorized states, and budget allocation. The provided text does not include the full end-to-end speedup table.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper. Focus on the quantified bottlenecks in the introduction and problem analysis, then study the tree-structured recurrence factorization, factorized state lifecycle, and hardware-aware budget allocator. Readers interested in serving systems should trace how tree dependencies are mapped to GPU parallelism and how the runtime budgets across full-attention, linear-attention, and dense operators. Estimated reading time: 30 to 45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 recurrence 到 tree closed form 的推导；这会影响 hybrid attention 是否真的好 serve。
recommendation.en: Read the recurrence-to-tree closed-form derivation; it changes the serving calculus for hybrid-attention LMs.

paper.title: CURE: Local Uncertainty Repair for Block-Parallel Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding mitigates the latency of sequential generation in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) by interleaving draft generation with target verification. However, existing parallel drafting backends often suffer from rapid accuracy degradation over long horizons, leading to high rejection rates during verification and suboptimal wall-clock speedups. We observe that drafting errors are not uniformly distributed but typically stem from localized high-uncertainty tokens that des

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 block-parallel speculative decoding 的一个具体痛点：并行 draft 虽然便宜，但一旦某个位置出错，后面整段候选都会因为前缀校验而被连带拒绝，形成 error propagation cascade。作者的观察是，错误并不是均匀分布的，往往集中在少数高不确定 token 上。如果能只在这些局部位置做修复，而不是对整段做密集树扩展，就有机会在不把 verifier 成本推高太多的前提下，提高接受长度和端到端吞吐。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的工作，不属于预训练核心，但对大模型系统研究有现实意义。它的价值不在提出全新的 speculative decoding 框架，而在把 block-parallel backend 的结构性弱点讲清楚，并给出一个训练无关、可插拔的修补机制。对基座研究员来说，启发主要有两点：一是 speculative decoding 的收益不只取决于 draft 模型整体精度，还取决于错误空间分布；二是 acceptance length 与 verification cost 之间需要做硬件感知的折中，不能只看理论接受率。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 CURE，一个 budget-aware dynamic repair tree。输入是 block-parallel draft 一次性生成的长度 K 候选块及其 logits。标准单路径 speculative decoding 只验证这条主路径，一旦第 k 个 token 被 target 判错，k 之后的 token 即使本身合理也会被整体丢弃。CURE 的做法是先找出最可能引发级联拒绝的局部脆弱点，再只在这些点上分叉。

具体来说，作者用 top-1 与 top-2 log-prob margin 作为置信度指标，定位 Uncertainty Focal Points。margin 小意味着 draft 在该位置犹豫，局部错误概率高。然后在给定 verifier budget 下，只对这些位置生成替代分支，而不是对所有位置均匀展开候选树。这样做的理由很直接：如果大部分 token 都高度可预测，全面树扩展会把 target verification 的 token 数和显存占用迅速推高，浪费在本来就不会错的区域。

论文把这个过程形式化为一个受预算约束的 candidate-tree optimization：目标是在总验证预算 V_max 下最大化可接受长度。效率指标则写成期望接受 token 数除以 draft 成本加 verifier 成本。这个表述虽然不复杂，但把 speculative decoding 的关键权衡写得比较清楚：只有当额外分支带来的 accepted length 增益超过 target tree verification 的额外代价时，墙钟时间才会真正改善。

另一个实用点是 cache-resynchronization。因为 repair branch 可能改变被接受的路径，draft model 的内部状态需要与 target 最终接受的前缀重新对齐。作者设计了一个无需重训 draft 的 cache 同步机制，使 CURE 可以作为 plug-and-play 模块接在 block-parallel backend 上。这一点比单纯提出一个更复杂的树策略更重要，因为很多 speculative decoding 方法卡在工程接入成本高、需要专门训练 draft backend。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖代码生成主场景和一个 out-of-domain 推理任务。代码基准包括 HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench-lite，外域测试是 GSM8K。作者报告，相比单路径并行 draft backend，CURE 能把每步 accepted tokens 提高 4.2% 到 7.5%，相对 target-only 自回归解码实现 2.66× 到 3.49× 的端到端加速。

这些数字的含义要分开看。accepted tokens per step 的提升幅度并不夸张，说明 CURE 不是通过大规模树搜索硬拉接受率，而是在局部修补上做了较克制的改进；但由于 speculative decoding 的瓶颈常常是 memory-bound 的 sequential target pass，哪怕接受长度有中等提升，也可能转化成较明显的墙钟收益。作者还强调 acceptance–compute Pareto trade-off：repair 分支越多，接受长度通常越长，但 target verification 也会逐渐饱和，超过某个点后不再带来净加速。

从全文给出的信息看，论文的实验重点不是模型质量变化，而是系统层面的吞吐与接受率权衡。因此读结果时应重点看不同 budget、不同 block setting 下的曲线，而不是只盯住单个 speedup 数字。另一个值得注意的点是，方法在代码任务上更自然，因为代码 token 分布往往“整体结构稳定、局部变量和 API 选择不稳定”，正好符合 UFP 假设；GSM8K 的结果更多是在说明方法并非完全依赖代码域。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，30 分钟左右可以抓住主要内容。先看 Introduction，重点理解作者提出的 error propagation cascade 和 Uncertainty Focal Points 这两个概念。然后直接看 Methodology 里关于预算约束优化的定义，弄清楚它不是一般 tree speculative decoding，而是局部、受预算限制的 repair。接着看 cache-resynchronization 部分，这是方法能否落地的关键工程点。

实验部分建议重点看三类图表：一是 accepted tokens per step 的提升；二是 end-to-end speedup；三是 acceptance 与 verification cost 的 Pareto 曲线。若时间有限，可以跳过过多实现细节，只保留一个判断：CURE 何时比单路径 block-parallel 更划算，何时额外分支已经不值。

如果你做的是 serving 或推理系统，这篇的可读性会高于纯算法论文；如果你主要做预训练，它更像一个了解推理侧约束如何反过来影响模型设计的参考材料。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific weakness of block-parallel speculative decoding. Parallel drafting is cheap, but once an early token is wrong, standard prefix verification rejects the entire remaining block, creating an error-propagation cascade. The authors observe that these errors are not uniformly spread across positions. They tend to concentrate around a few high-uncertainty tokens. If repair is applied only at those local failure points, rather than through dense tree expansion everywhere, accepted length can improve without exploding verifier cost.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining contribution, but it is practically relevant for large-model systems. Its value is not in inventing a completely new speculative-decoding paradigm. The useful part is a clear diagnosis of block-parallel drafting failure modes and a training-free, plug-in repair mechanism. For foundation-model researchers, two lessons stand out. First, speculative-decoding gains depend not only on average draft accuracy, but also on the spatial distribution of draft errors. Second, accepted-length gains must be evaluated jointly with verification overhead; higher acceptance is not automatically better if target-side tree verification saturates memory or compute.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is CURE, a budget-aware dynamic repair tree. A block-parallel draft model produces a length-K candidate block and its logits in one pass. In standard single-path speculative decoding, only that path is verified. If token k is rejected by the target model, all later tokens are discarded even when many of them would have matched the target had the earlier local error been repaired. CURE tries to fix exactly those fragile points.

The mechanism starts by identifying Uncertainty Focal Points using the top-1 versus top-2 log-probability margin from the draft model. A small margin indicates local ambiguity and a higher chance that this position will trigger downstream rejection. Under a fixed verifier budget, the method spawns alternative branches only at these focal points instead of expanding a dense candidate tree over the whole block. The motivation is simple: if most tokens are already predictable, uniform tree expansion wastes target verification on positions that do not need repair.

The paper formulates this as a budget-constrained candidate-tree optimization problem. The objective is to maximize accepted length under a verification budget V_max. The effective generation rate is written as expected accepted tokens divided by draft cost plus verifier cost. This formalization is useful because it makes the central trade-off explicit: local branching helps only when the gain in accepted context outweighs the extra cost of target-side tree verification.

A practically important component is cache resynchronization. Because repair branches may alter the finally accepted path, the draft model’s internal state must be realigned with the target-verified prefix. The authors design a cache-consistent resynchronization procedure that does not require retraining the draft model. That makes CURE a plug-and-play add-on for existing block-parallel backends, which is more valuable in practice than a method that depends on a specially trained draft architecture.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers code generation as the main domain and reasoning as an out-of-domain check. The code benchmarks are HumanEval, MBPP, and LiveCodeBench-lite; GSM8K is used for transfer beyond code. Relative to single-path parallel drafting backends, CURE improves accepted tokens per step by 4.2% to 7.5%, and reaches 2.66× to 3.49× end-to-end speedup over target-only autoregressive decoding.

These numbers should be interpreted carefully. The gain in accepted tokens per step is meaningful but not huge, which suggests the method is not relying on aggressive tree expansion. Instead, it extracts moderate acceptance improvements from localized repairs. Because speculative decoding is often bottlenecked by memory-bound sequential target passes, even moderate acceptance gains can translate into noticeable wall-clock speedups. The paper also emphasizes an acceptance-versus-compute Pareto frontier: adding more repair branches usually increases accepted length, but target verification eventually saturates, after which extra branching no longer improves latency.

The experiments are mainly about systems trade-offs rather than model quality. The most informative results are therefore the curves across different budgets and block settings, not a single best speedup number. Another point is domain fit. The method is especially natural for code, where global structure is often predictable while identifiers, API choices, and local syntax decisions create concentrated uncertainty. GSM8K is useful mostly to show that the idea is not entirely code-specific.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. About 30 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. Start with the Introduction and focus on two concepts: the error-propagation cascade in block-parallel drafting and the notion of Uncertainty Focal Points. Then go to the Methodology section and read the budget-constrained optimization setup. The key is to see that this is not generic tree speculative decoding; it is localized repair under a strict verification budget. After that, read the cache-resynchronization part, since that is what makes the method deployable.

In the experiments, prioritize three kinds of plots or tables: accepted tokens per step, end-to-end speedup, and the Pareto trade-off between acceptance and verification cost. If time is limited, skip low-level implementation details and keep one practical question in mind: when is local repair better than a single-path block-parallel backend, and when do extra branches stop paying off.

If your work is in serving or inference systems, this paper is more directly useful. If your focus is pretraining, it is still a good reference for how inference-side constraints can shape what kinds of model errors matter.

recommendation.zh: 只看错误定位和 resynchronization 机制；若实验补全，局部不确定 token 这个诊断可迁移到 draft-model 训练。
recommendation.en: Skim the error-localization and resynchronization parts; if the experiments hold, the uncertainty-token diagnosis may inform draft-model training.

paper.title: xPress: Parallel Refinement for Diffusion Drafters in Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Block-diffusion drafters like dFlash generate an entire block of draft tokens in a single forward pass, drastically reducing the overhead of multiple-token drafting in speculative decoding. The crucial final step of the single-pass discrete denoising process involves using the logit distribution at each position to sample conditionally independent tokens. The resulting draft is thus a set of per-position marginals, rather than a joint distribution: no draft token is guaranteed to depend on its p

summary.core_problem: 块扩散草稿模型（如dFlash）可单次前向生成整块草稿token，但各位置从边缘分布独立采样，缺乏因果依赖，导致草稿局部token合理但联合概率低，会被左到右的目标模型提前拒绝，直接限制推测解码的接受长度与端到端吞吐。
summary.importance: 为扩散式推测解码的核心缺陷提供了低开销解决方案，在保留并行草稿生成优势的前提下稳定提升接受率，对大模型推理效率优化有直接工程参考价值，也为离散扩散模型的因果性注入提供了通用思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出xPress轻量因果修正框架，核心设计有两点：一是保留原扩散草稿模型的并行块生成能力，新增低秩因果修正头，将token嵌入和草稿隐藏状态投影到低秩空间，用严格下三角线性混合器聚合前驱位置信息，输出逐位置logit加性偏置完成修正；二是用Jacobi迭代并行求解修正过程的因果依赖，仅需远小于块长B的K次并行迭代即可逼近串行自回归修正的不动点，避免重新引入串行解码开销。
summary.experiments: 以Qwen3-8B为目标模型、dFlash为基础草稿模型，在7个数学、代码、对话基准上测试：贪心解码下接受长度提升18%-56%，T=1采样下提升19%-58%，端到端解码吞吐获得一致增益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第3节的Jacobi并行修正推导逻辑、第4节的实验对比与消融（尤其是块长B和迭代次数K的权衡），预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Block diffusion drafters (e.g., dFlash) generate an entire block of draft tokens in one forward pass, but sample each position independently from marginal distributions without causal dependencies. This produces drafts with locally plausible tokens but low joint probability under the target model's left-to-right distribution, leading to early rejection, limited acceptance length, and suboptimal end-to-end throughput for speculative decoding.
summary_en.importance: Provides a low-overhead fix for the core limitation of diffusion-based speculative decoding, preserving parallel drafting while improving acceptance rates. It offers direct engineering value for inference efficiency optimization, and a generalizable approach to injecting causality into discrete diffusion models.
summary_en.technical_approach: xPress is a lightweight causal refinement framework with two key designs: 1) It keeps the original diffusion drafter's parallel block proposal intact, and adds a low-rank causal refinement head that projects token embeddings and drafter hidden states into a low-rank space, uses a strictly lower-triangular linear mixer to aggregate predecessor information, and outputs per-position additive biases for the drafter's logits. 2) It resolves the causal dependency in refinement via parallel Jacobi iterations: only K ≪ B (B is block size) parallel passes are needed to approximate the fixed point of sequential autoregressive refinement, avoiding reintroducing serial overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated with Qwen3-8B as the target model and dFlash as the base drafter across 7 math, coding, and chat benchmarks. Acceptance length improves by 18–56% under greedy decoding and 19–58% under T=1 sampling, with consistent end-to-end throughput gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim focus on Section 3 (Jacobi parallel refinement derivation) and Section 4 (experimental results and ablation studies on block size B vs iteration count K). Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 准确指出 block-diffusion draft 的边际独立采样问题，因果 refiner 是直接补丁；做推测解码或 diffusion LM 应看方法节。
recommendation.en: Correctly identifies the marginal-independence flaw in block-diffusion drafts and offers a direct causal-refinement fix; read the method section if you work on speculative decoding or diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Beyond KV Reconstruction: Functional Reconstruction for MLA Draft Models in Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) is increasingly important for long-context LLM inference because compact latent states replace the growing key-value (KV) cache and reduce decoding memory traffic. Yet most capable open checkpoints use multi-head or grouped-query attention (MHA/GQA), so conversion is needed to obtain MLA's cache efficiency without retraining from scratch. Speculative decoding offers complementary acceleration, but its speedup depends on agreement between draft proposals and targ

summary.core_problem: 在推测解码中，直接将 MHA/GQA 草稿模型转换为 MLA（Multi-head Latent Attention）架构会导致注意力函数误差，从而大幅降低草稿 token 的接受率。
summary.importance: 揭示了 MHA-to-MLA 转换在推测解码场景下的关键痛点（接受率下降），并提出了一种基于功能重建的端到端转换方法，无需从头训练即可获得高效的 MLA 草稿模型。
summary.technical_approach: 放弃了传统的 KV cache 压缩视角，将 MLA 草稿构建公式化为功能重建（Functional Reconstruction）。提出了一种端到端（E2E）方法，优化每个转换后的 MLA 注意力模块，使其重现原始 MHA/GQA 模型的输出投影后响应，从而最小化对推测解码接受率的负面影响。
summary.experiments: 在长上下文 LLM 推理场景下，验证了该方法能有效保持草稿模型的接受率，同时享受 MLA 带来的 KV cache 显存优势。

summary_en.core_problem: In speculative decoding, direct conversion of MHA/GQA draft models to MLA (Multi-head Latent Attention) architecture introduces attention-function errors, drastically reducing draft token acceptance rates.
summary_en.importance: Reveals a critical pain point (acceptance rate drop) in MHA-to-MLA conversion for speculative decoding and proposes an end-to-end conversion method based on functional reconstruction, enabling efficient MLA draft models without training from scratch.
summary_en.technical_approach: Abandons the traditional KV cache compression perspective and formulates MLA draft construction as functional reconstruction. Proposes an end-to-end (E2E) method that optimizes each converted MLA attention module to reproduce the post-output-projection response of the original MHA/GQA model, thereby minimizing the negative impact on speculative decoding acceptance rates.
summary_en.experiments: Validated in long-context LLM inference scenarios, demonstrating that the method effectively maintains draft model acceptance rates while enjoying the KV cache memory benefits of MLA.

recommendation.zh: 针对 MLA 架构在推测解码中的应用痛点，提出了功能重建视角的转换方法，对关注长上下文推理效率和 MLA 架构落地的研究员有启发，建议阅读方法部分。
recommendation.en: Addresses the pain point of applying MLA architecture in speculative decoding by proposing a conversion method from a functional reconstruction perspective. Inspiring for researchers focusing on long-context inference efficiency and MLA deployment; recommend reading the methodology section.

paper.title: Revisiting Lossy Verification in Speculative Decoding: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Failure Modes
paper.abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by allowing a lightweight draft model to propose tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by a larger target model. Recent approaches introduce lossy verification schemes to further improve efficiency by relaxing strict distributional matching. Yet such relaxation silently rewrites the decoding distribution, and the resulting acceleration can come at the cost of unstable, sometimes severely degraded generation quality.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 speculative decoding 里一个常被轻描淡写的问题：为了进一步提速，很多方法把原本严格保持 target model 分布不变的 verification 改成了 lossy verification，但一旦放松这个约束，生成分布就被改写了。论文要解决的不是再提一个新 trick，而是把现有 lossy verification 方法的真实机制讲清楚：它们到底改了什么分布、为什么有时看起来几乎不掉点、有时却会明显劣化，以及这些方法之间真正的差别是否像论文名字那样大。作者的结论很明确：不少方法表面形式不同，底层其实主要落在两类机制里——基于 truncation 的 verification，以及基于 draft/target 分布插值的 collaborative verification；而很多已有结果把“采样策略本身带来的收益”和“lossy verification 机制本身的收益”混在了一起。
summary.importance: 对基座研究员而言，这篇工作的价值不在于训练范式，而在于把 serving 侧一个容易被误判的问题拆开了。第一，它提醒人不要把 lossy SD 的加速结果直接当成“几乎免费”的收益，因为一部分所谓质量保持，来自更保守的 truncation sampling baseline 本身，而不是 verification 设计。第二，它给出一个更有操作性的判断框架：如果方法属于 truncation-based verification，就应该拿对应的 target-only truncation sampling 做真 baseline；如果属于 collaborative verification，就要重点看 overshoot token 的处理，而不是只看全局 acceptance rate。第三，这对训练侧也有启发：很多推理时质量崩坏并不是均匀分布偏移造成的，而是少数高风险 token 被系统性放大，这和训练中对 tail behavior、calibration、draft-target mismatch 的关注是连着的。量级上，这不是改变范式的工作，但它把一个快速扩张的推理分支做了机制澄清，属于值得研究员补上的认知地基。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上，论文先从 lossless speculative decoding 的标准接受-拒绝机制出发，把 lossy 方法统一写成“修改接受准则后，实际诱导出什么分布”。在这个框架下，作者把现有方法归为两类。

第一类是 truncation-based verification。像 Medusa 的 typical acceptance、SpecCascade 这类方法，表面上是“只要 draft token 落在某个允许集合里就接受”，但这个允许集合本质上来自 target 分布上的 truncation sampling 规则，例如 η-sampling 或 min-p sampling。也就是说，这类方法不是在逼近原始 target 分布，而是在逼近一个被截断过的 target sampling 过程。作者据此指出，正确比较对象不该是原始采样的 target model，而应是“target model 直接使用同样 truncation 规则”的 baseline。这样一比，很多先前看起来很小的质量损失会被重新显露出来。

第二类是 collaborative verification。这里作者把 lenience-based relaxation 和 CoS 放到同一个框架里，认为它们本质上都在做 draft 分布 q 和 target 分布 p 的插值，只是插值系数是固定的还是分段/自适应的不同。进一步，作者提出一个更细的机制判断：真正决定质量的，不是是否在全分布上做复杂插值，而是是否抑制了 overshoot token——也就是 q(x) 相对 p(x) 被高估的 token。因为这些 token 更容易把生成带向低质量轨迹。论文据此主张，选择性压制 overshoot 区域，往往就足以拿到更好的 speed-quality trade-off，而没必要对整个分布做更重的修正。

这篇文章的方法贡献不是新算法，而是统一视角、分布级分析和 failure mode 拆解。它把“看起来不同的方法”还原成少数几个统计机制，这一点比单点提速数字更有参考价值。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验重点不是刷更高速度，而是重做比较基线并分析失效模式。关键结论有几条。

一是 truncation-based verification 的很多正面结果，主要来自 truncation sampling 本身改善了 baseline，而不是 verification 机制几乎无损。作者把 SpecCascade 等方法与“target model 直接采用相同 truncation sampling”的 baseline 对比后发现，真实质量差距会随着任务难度上升而扩大。文中明确提到 Figure 1 展示了 SpecCascade 在更难任务上与 true baseline 的 gap 变大，这说明在更接近真实使用场景的复杂任务里，分布扭曲的代价更明显。

二是当这些 lossy verification 方法被接入更复杂的 speculative 系统，例如 EAGLE-3 时，问题会被放大。原因不难理解：系统越依赖 draft 侧的激进提议，verification 的分布偏移越可能沿着多步生成累积，最终形成更明显的质量退化。

三是 collaborative verification 的实验支持一个更具体的经验规律：只要把 overshoot token 控住，质量就能比简单的全局插值更稳。作者把这一点和近期关于 overshoot token 主导低质量生成的研究对应起来，说明坏样本往往不是来自整体分布轻微偏移，而是来自少数 token 的局部过冲。

摘要和截取正文里没有给出完整表格数字、模型规模、具体任务分数和 wall-clock speedup，因此没法负责任地填入精确数值。能确定的是，论文做了机制对照、难度分层比较，以及在 EAGLE-3 集成场景下的额外验证，这些比单一 benchmark 上的平均分更说明问题。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和方法归类部分，抓住两件事：一是为什么很多 lossy 方法其实只是两类机制的变体；二是为什么 baseline 选错会导致结论偏乐观。接着重点看作者如何定义 truncation-based verification 与 collaborative verification，以及它们各自诱导的分布形式。这里是整篇文章最有信息量的部分。

实验部分不必逐表细抠，优先看三类结果：第一，SpecCascade/typical acceptance 与对应 truncation baseline 的对比；第二，任务难度升高时 gap 如何扩大；第三，接入 EAGLE-3 后 failure mode 为什么更明显。最后看 overshoot token 的分析，这部分能帮助理解 collaborative verification 为什么不是“插值越精细越好”，而是“该压的地方压住就够了”。

如果只是建立判断框架，30 到 45 分钟足够；如果要把它用于设计新 verification 规则，建议把分布推导和 failure case 图表一起细读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper examines a neglected issue in speculative decoding: once verification is made lossy to gain extra speed, the target model’s decoding distribution is no longer preserved. The central question is not how to add another heuristic, but how existing lossy verification methods actually alter the distribution, why some appear nearly harmless under selective settings, and why they can fail badly in harder regimes. The main conclusion is that many methods that look different on the surface reduce to two underlying mechanisms: truncation-based verification and collaborative verification. A large part of the prior narrative, according to the paper, conflates gains from the sampling rule itself with gains from the verification mechanism.
summary_en.importance: For LLM foundation-model researchers, the value here is conceptual clarity rather than a new decoding algorithm. First, it gives a cleaner lens for evaluating lossy speculative decoding: speedups are not close to free, and quality preservation can be overstated if the baseline is chosen incorrectly. Second, it provides a practical taxonomy. If a method is truncation-based, it should be compared against the target model using the same truncation sampling rule, not against the original target decoding setup. If it is collaborative, the key variable is how it handles overshoot tokens rather than its average acceptance rate alone. Third, the paper connects serving-time degradation to a broader modeling issue: a small subset of over-amplified tokens can dominate failure modes. That observation is relevant beyond inference, including calibration, draft-target mismatch, and tail-behavior analysis in training. This is not a paradigm-shifting paper, but it is a useful corrective for a fast-moving line of inference work.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper starts from standard lossless speculative decoding and asks a distributional question: after modifying the acceptance rule, what distribution is actually induced? Under that view, existing lossy methods collapse into two families.

The first is truncation-based verification. Methods such as typical acceptance in Medusa and SpecCascade accept a draft token if it lies in an allowed set defined by a truncation rule on the target distribution, such as eta-sampling or min-p sampling. The key point is that these methods are not approximating the original target distribution; they are approximating a truncated target sampling process. This leads to the paper’s main evaluation correction: the right baseline is the target model decoded with the same truncation rule, not the original target model under standard sampling.

The second is collaborative verification. The paper unifies lenience-based relaxation and CoS by showing that both interpolate between the draft distribution q and the target distribution p, differing mainly in whether the interpolation coefficient is fixed or adaptive. The more interesting claim is that good speed-quality trade-offs do not require sophisticated global interpolation. What matters most is suppressing overshoot tokens, where q(x) exceeds p(x) too aggressively. These tokens are argued to drive most low-quality generations, while the rest of the distribution matters much less.

So the contribution is not a new verifier, but a unifying distributional analysis, a cleaner categorization of prior methods, and a sharper account of where quality loss actually comes from.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental section is designed to re-evaluate baselines and expose failure modes rather than to maximize raw speed numbers. The main findings are as follows.

First, much of the favorable picture for truncation-based verification comes from the truncation sampling rule itself, not from the verification mechanism being nearly lossless. When methods such as SpecCascade are compared against the true baseline, namely the target model decoded with the same truncation rule, the quality gap becomes visible and grows with task difficulty. The paper explicitly notes that Figure 1 shows this widening gap for harder tasks, which matters because harder tasks are closer to realistic deployment settings.

Second, the issue becomes more pronounced when these lossy verification schemes are integrated into stronger speculative systems such as EAGLE-3. This suggests that distributional distortion can accumulate more severely in aggressive multi-stage or high-acceptance setups.

Third, experiments on collaborative verification support a more specific principle: selectively controlling overshoot tokens is sufficient to preserve quality better than broad interpolation over the whole distribution. This aligns with recent findings that low-quality generations are often driven by a relatively small set of overshot tokens rather than by mild global mismatch.

The provided full text excerpt does not include the detailed tables with exact model sizes, benchmark scores, or wall-clock speedups, so it would be unsafe to invent precise numbers. What is clear is that the paper includes baseline-corrected comparisons, difficulty-stratified evaluations, and integration tests inside EAGLE-3-style systems.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and the sections that define the two categories. The main thing to extract is the paper’s reframing: many lossy methods differ less than they appear to, and baseline choice is central to interpreting their results. Then read the derivation of the induced distributions for truncation-based and collaborative verification. That is the core technical value of the paper.

In the experiments, focus on three pieces: comparisons against the correct truncation baselines, the way the quality gap grows with task difficulty, and the results after integrating lossy verification into EAGLE-3. Finally, read the overshoot-token analysis, since that is the most actionable insight for designing future verification rules.

If the goal is just to build the right mental model, 30 to 45 minutes is enough. If the goal is to design or evaluate new speculative decoding variants, the distributional analysis and failure-case figures deserve a closer pass.

recommendation.zh: 读分布推导和失败案例；若内部在上 lossy speculative decoding，这篇能避免把分布漂移误当免费加速。
recommendation.en: Read the distribution analysis and failures; if lossy speculative decoding is in your stack, this prevents mistaking distribution drift for free speed.

paper.title: AngelSpec: Towards Real-World High Performance Inference with Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference without changing the target distribution, but no single drafting structure performs best across real-world workloads. Autoregressive multi-token prediction (MTP) is a lightweight, stable proposal mechanism, whereas block-parallel diffusion amortizes drafting latency over much longer candidate sequences; the better choice depends strongly on the output distribution. We present AngelSpec, a unified training framework for MTP and block

summary.core_problem: 投机解码在真实线上负载里呈现强异质性：不同请求分布（高熵对话 vs 低熵代码/数学）、不同并发与硬件条件下，"同一种 drafter 结构 + 固定验证深度"很难同时做到高接受率与低端到端延迟。论文要解决的是：如何把 speculative decoding 从“单一 drafter 追平均”推进到“面向负载分布与在线资源约束的端到端方案”，同时给出可复现实验与训练基础设施。
summary.importance: 对预训练/中训研究的直接影响不在于改语言建模目标，而在于把“为推理服务的训练”做成体系：1）提出“结构与数据联合专门化”的 drafter 训练思路，明确不同熵/不同结构任务应选不同 drafting 范式；2）给出 block-parallel drafter（扩散式/并行块预测）在工程上可落地的架构改造点（更细粒度 target-conditioning + 前驱条件化的 AR head），把接受率与块内一致性问题讲清楚；3）把 serving 侧的验证深度选择从静态超参变成“批级资源分配问题”，用成本模型+期望收益做在线自适应。整体贡献更像“训练-架构-系统闭环”的 recipe，对做大规模 MoE 线上推理的团队有现实参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三层：
1）训练层：不再训练一个通用 drafter，而是按负载分布做专门化。MTP（multi-token prediction）drafter 用更“对话/开放域”的高熵数据强化，追求短深度下的稳定接受；block-parallel diffusion drafter 用代码/数学样本强化，追求长可预测 span 的高接受与高摊销。这里的关键不是简单换数据集，而是把“接受率随深度衰减的形状”当作训练目标的隐含约束：高熵任务深度收益递减，低熵任务深度收益更线性。
2）架构层：提出 DFly，基于 DFlash 的 block-diffusion drafter 做两点改造：
  - Hybrid target-conditioning backbone：同时提供“全局变换后的 target 上下文”与“逐层（layer-specific）的 target 视图”。动机是不同 draft 层需要不同粒度/不同语义层次的 target 特征，避免所有层共享同一份固定表示导致利用不足。
  - Predecessor-conditioned autoregressive head：并行 backbone 仍一次性产出块内各位置的表示，但在输出头上用前一位置已选 token 做条件化修正，把位置边缘分布（marginal）拉回到前缀条件分布（prefix-conditioned），提升块内依赖建模与 suffix coherence，同时保留并行主干的吞吐优势。
3）推理/系统层：D-cut 把“验证更多 token”视为共享的 batch 资源。在线根据：a）不同请求当前前缀的期望接受收益（可理解为多验证一位能带来多少期望前进步长），b）profile 得到的 runtime cost model（并发、并行策略、硬件、目标模型结构导致的边际验证成本变化），在并发请求间重新分配验证深度：资源充裕时保留更长 draft，资源紧张时更激进裁剪低价值 suffix。
配套工程：AngelSpec 训练框架把 target hidden states 的生成与训练解耦（推理引擎流式产出 hidden states 给训练 worker），支持 MTP 的 on-policy TTT rollout、长上下文训练、以及 DFly 的逐层 target-conditioning 与可插拔 AR head，并提供在训 acceptance 评测服务，避免只看离线 loss。
summary.experiments:
全文实验围绕 Hy3 系列模型，覆盖 chat/code/math 与不同并发 serving 条件。核心要点是“互补增益”：
- 负载专门化：对话高熵场景下，长块 draft 的接受长度下降快，MTP 更合适；代码/数学低熵场景下，block-parallel 更能利用长可预测 span。
- 架构改造：DFly 相比 DFlash 的改造提升 target 特征利用与块内一致性，从而提升接受率/有效接受长度（论文强调 suffix coherence 改善）。
- 在线自适应：D-cut 在不同并发下动态调整验证深度，避免固定深度在高并发时浪费 batch capacity、低并发时又保守。
给出的定量细节在提供的全文片段里不完整（具体加速比、接受长度、端到端 latency 数字未出现），但论文明确声称三者（专门化 + DFly + D-cut）带来叠加收益，并且通过“训练中真实 acceptance 行为评测”来对齐线上指标，而不是只用 perplexity/离线 KL。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议按“问题—机制—落地”顺序：
- 先看 Introduction 里对高熵/低熵负载的接受率随深度衰减机制解释，这是为何要分 MTP vs block-parallel 的根。
- 重点看 DFly 的两处结构：hybrid target-conditioning（最好配合对应结构图/消融表）与 predecessor-conditioned AR head（关注它如何在不牺牲并行主干的前提下引入前缀条件化）。
- 再看 D-cut：把验证深度当批级资源分配的公式/伪代码与 cost model 的 profiling 方法，理解它如何在不同并发下改变策略。
- 最后看 AngelSpec 的系统实现细节：target hidden states 的流式管线、MTP 的 on-policy rollout 如何嵌入训练 step、以及“在训 acceptance 评测服务”如何避免指标漂移。对要复现/扩展的人，这部分比模型结构更关键。

summary_en.core_problem: Speculative decoding performance is highly workload-dependent in real serving: open-ended chat (high conditional entropy) vs code/math (low entropy, long predictable spans), plus varying concurrency and hardware, make a single drafter design and a fixed verification depth suboptimal. The paper targets an end-to-end solution that adapts drafting paradigm, training distribution, and runtime verification to heterogeneous workloads while remaining deployable at scale.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is not a new pretraining objective, but a concrete “train–architecture–serving” loop for inference-oriented training. It argues for joint specialization of drafter structure and data (MTP for chat-like entropy, block-parallel diffusion for code/math), introduces practical architectural fixes to improve block coherence and target-feature usage, and turns verification depth into an online resource allocation problem. For teams operating large MoE targets in production, this is a recipe-level contribution with clear engineering implications.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Three layers:
1) Training specialization: instead of one universal drafter trained on an averaged mixture, train an MTP drafter on diverse conversation-heavy data (optimize short-depth acceptance under high entropy) and a block-parallel diffusion drafter on code/math-heavy data (optimize long-span acceptance where structure is tight).
2) DFly architecture (building on DFlash):
  - Hybrid target-conditioning backbone: combines a globally transformed target context with layer-specific target views, so different draft layers can consume target features at appropriate abstraction levels.
  - Predecessor-conditioned autoregressive head: keeps a single-pass parallel backbone but conditions each position’s output on the previously selected token, converting per-position marginals into prefix-conditioned predictions to improve intra-block dependency and suffix coherence.
3) Serving-time adaptation (D-cut): treats target verification as a shared batch-level resource. It dynamically chooses/prunes verification depth per request based on (i) expected acceptance utility and (ii) a profiled runtime cost model that captures concurrency, parallelism strategy, model architecture, and hardware effects.
Infrastructure (AngelSpec): disaggregates target hidden-state generation (inference engines) from training workers via streaming; supports MTP on-policy rollouts inside the training step, long-context packing, per-layer target conditioning, pluggable AR heads, and an evaluation server that measures true acceptance behavior during training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on the Hy3 model family across chat, code, math, and multiple serving concurrency settings. The paper’s empirical narrative is that (a) workload specialization changes which drafter paradigm wins, (b) DFly’s architectural changes improve target-feature utilization and block suffix coherence (hence acceptance/effective accepted length), and (c) D-cut provides additional gains by adapting verification depth under different online loads. The provided excerpt does not include the key numeric tables (speedup, latency, acceptance length), but the methodology emphasizes measuring real acceptance during training rather than relying on offline loss proxies.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in this order:
- Motivation in the Introduction: the acceptance-vs-depth behavior under high-entropy vs low-entropy continuations is the central mechanism.
- DFly design: focus on the hybrid target-conditioning and the predecessor-conditioned AR head; check the corresponding ablations/figures for how each affects acceptance and coherence.
- D-cut: study the formulation as batch-level resource allocation and how the runtime cost model is obtained and used.
- AngelSpec system section: the streaming of target hidden states, how on-policy rollouts are integrated for MTP, and how in-training acceptance evaluation is implemented—these are the parts that determine reproducibility and scalability.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain prior，但会改你对 spec decode 的工程 prior：别再找万能 drafter，先按任务熵和续写可预测性分桶；重点看训练分流和 DFly 设计。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your pretraining prior, but it should change your speculative-decoding prior: stop searching for a universal drafter and bucket workloads by entropy/predictability; read the data specialization and DFly parts.

paper.title: Speculate While You Reason: Teaching Agents to Predict Their Next Tool Call via Joint Agent-Speculator RL
paper.abstract: Large language model agents often spend substantial wall-clock time waiting for tool call results. Tool-call speculation can hide this latency by predicting and pre-executing an agent's next tool call if the prediction matches the agent's eventual tool call, but existing speculators are typically separate draft models or cached traces that are poorly aligned with the deployed agent's own behavior. We identify this speculator-agent gap and show that the target agent itself is a strong next-call s

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 在工具调用阶段存在大量等待工具返回的 wall-clock 延迟；现有 tool-call speculation 依赖外部 draft model 或历史轨迹缓存作为推测器，与部署中的目标 agent 存在行为错位（speculator–agent gap），导致精确匹配命中率不高且带来额外 serving 开销。
summary.importance: 对推理侧 latency 优化有直接工程价值，核心观察是“agent 自身即最好的下一次工具调用预测器”。虽然属于 post-train / inference 范畴，不是基座预训练论文，但其联合训练两个 mode 的思路（agent mode + speculator mode，共享前缀 KV cache、on-policy RL）对多目标训练、自预测辅助任务设计有启发，也和推测解码中“draft 与 target 对齐”问题有结构相似性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 self-speculating agent：单个模型同时具备两种模式。agent mode 按常规轨迹产生推理、工具调用、观察和最终答案；speculator mode 输入中间轨迹加一个短的 speculation suffix，直接预测下一条结构化工具调用。两种模式共享轨迹前缀的 KV cache，推理时只在 suffix 处分叉，无需额外部署 draft 模型或维护历史调用缓存。训练上提出 joint agent-speculator RL：从当前 policy 采样 agent rollout，基于这些 rollout 即时构造 speculator 查询，交替优化两个模式，保持 speculator 始终 on-policy，避免在陈旧轨迹或异策略数据上训练；同时用模式切换时重置 optimizer 状态等技巧稳定联合训练，平衡“保持任务求解能力”和“提升自我预测准确率”两个目标。
summary.experiments: 在 agentic search QA 和对话式工具使用任务上评估。Qwen3-4B 上平均 next tool-call Hit@1 从 44.1 提升到 61.2，Qwen3.5-4B 上从 48.9 提升到 66.3；下游任务成功率保持稳定或略有上升。文中还给出 off-the-shelf draft model 的 gap 分析：即使同模型家族的小尺寸 draft model，对目标 4B agent 的 next call 命中率也低于 agent 自身 prompt 成“预测自己下一步”的表现，这是驱动自推测设计的关键观测。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看第 2 节 off-the-shelf speculator gap 的实证（为什么外部 draft 不行）、方法部分两种 mode 的输入格式与 KV cache 复用方式、joint RL 的交替训练细节与稳定性技巧。对预训练研究者，可把它当作“自预测辅助目标 + 多 mode 联合训练”的案例读，不必深究 agent benchmark 的具体任务设定。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents incur substantial wall-clock latency waiting for tool-call returns. Existing tool-call speculation relies on external draft models or historical trace caches, which are poorly aligned with the deployed agent’s behavior, creating a speculator–agent gap that hurts exact-match hit rate and adds serving overhead.
summary_en.importance: The work is primarily an inference-time / post-training systems paper, but it carries a useful lesson for pretraining researchers: a model’s own behavior can be the best predictor of itself, and jointly training a self-prediction mode can improve that predictive ability without damaging the primary capability. The design shares structural similarities with speculative decoding and auxiliary self-prediction objectives, and the on-policy joint RL recipe is relevant to multi-objective training more broadly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a self-speculating agent: a single model with two modes. In agent mode, it produces standard trajectories with reasoning, tool calls, observations, and final answers. In speculator mode, given an intermediate trajectory plus a short speculation suffix, it directly predicts the next structured tool call. The two modes share the trajectory prefix KV cache and branch only at the suffix, removing the need for an external draft model or historical call cache. Training uses joint agent-speculator RL: agent rollouts are sampled from the current policy, speculator queries are constructed from those rollouts, and the two modes are optimized in an alternating, on-policy fashion so the speculator tracks the current agent rather than stale trajectories. Optimization tricks such as optimizer resets at mode switches are used to stabilize joint training and prevent speculation gains from degrading task performance.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation covers agentic search QA and conversational tool-use tasks. On Qwen3-4B, average next tool-call Hit@1 improves from 44.1 to 61.2; on Qwen3.5-4B, from 48.9 to 66.3. Downstream task success remains stable or slightly improves. The motivating empirical finding is that even same-family smaller draft models underperform the target 4B agent itself when prompted to predict its own next call, motivating the unified self-speculation design.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in roughly 20–30 minutes. Focus on Section 2 (the measured speculator–agent gap for off-the-shelf draft models), the two-mode inference design and KV-cache reuse, and the joint on-policy RL training recipe with stabilization tricks. For pretraining readers, the main takeaway is the pattern of training a self-prediction head/mode jointly with the primary objective rather than approximating the model with an external proxy; the specific agent task details are secondary.

recommendation.zh: 把推测解码思路迁移到agent tool call场景，统一模型双模式的RL训练设计有启发，只看§3联合训练方法即可。
recommendation.en: Extending speculative decoding to agent tool call scenarios with a unified dual-mode RL training design is insightful; only read §3 on joint training method.

paper.title: PRESTO: Prefix-Aligned Tree Drafting for Diffusion Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) LLMs, generating tokens in parallel. This makes them effective draft models for speculative decoding (SD), producing an entire block of draft tokens in a single forward pass. Yet existing diffusion-based drafting methods rely on linear drafting, even though dLLMs emit multiple candidate tokens across positions, inducing a large combinatorial space of decoding paths. Consequently, they limit acc

summary.core_problem: PRESTO 解决 diffusion LLM 作为 speculative decoding drafter 时的候选路径利用不足问题。现有 diffusion drafting 多采用单路径线性草稿，但 diffusion 模型一次 forward 会在多个位置给出多个候选 token，天然形成组合空间。只取一条 top-1 轨迹会浪费候选。直接套用 AR tree drafting 也不合适，因为 diffusion 输出的是位置级 marginal probability，而 AR verifier 接受 token 时依赖前缀条件概率，两者的打分语义不一致。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值在于把 diffusion LM 的非自回归分布形态和 AR speculative decoding 的验证机制接起来。它指出 diffusion drafter 的 marginal token 概率可以是有用信号，但不能直接当作前缀路径分数。这个观察对新型语言建模范式的 serving 很重要：dLLM 的并行生成优势不只取决于训练目标，也取决于解码时如何把并行候选转成可被 AR 或自验证器高效接受的路径。
summary.technical_approach: PRESTO 的核心是 prefix-aligned tree drafting。方法先对 diffusion marginal score 做一个最小的 prefix-dependent correction，让候选路径排序更贴近 AR verifier 的顺序接受过程。然后用 priority-based tree search 扩展候选，而不是按单一路径生成草稿。优先队列把计算预算分配给更可能获得长接受长度的路径。和 AR tree drafting 相比，PRESTO 不能直接依赖自然的前缀条件分布，因为 diffusion drafter 并不按左到右方式建模；和线性 diffusion drafting 相比，它利用了同一轮 diffusion 输出中的多候选结构。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两类场景：一类是面向 AR LLM 的专用 diffusion drafter，例如 dFlash 路线；另一类是 diffusion LLM 的 self-speculative decoding，例如 TiDAR、I-DLM 或 Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion 一类设置。论文报告 PRESTO 能提高 accepted length，并带来端到端 throughput 提升。关键消融应包括线性 drafting、朴素 tree drafting、只用 diffusion marginal 排序、加入 prefix-aligned scoring 后的 tree search。给出的材料没有包含完整实验表，因此无法确认具体加速比例、接受长度提升和不同 batch size 下的收益边界。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。优先看问题分析部分：为什么 diffusion marginal probability 和 AR prefix verification 不对齐。然后看 prefix-aligned scoring 的定义，判断 correction 使用了哪些前缀信号，以及是否引入额外 verifier 调用或显著 drafting 开销。实验部分重点看 accepted length 与 throughput 的关系，不要只看单步草稿质量；还要看 tree size、batch size、target model 利用率的消融，因为这些因素决定方法是否能转化为真实 serving 收益。

summary_en.core_problem: PRESTO studies diffusion LMs used as draft models for speculative decoding. Existing diffusion-based drafting often follows a single linear path, even though a diffusion model produces token distributions for many positions in parallel. This leaves much of the candidate space unused. A naive tree extension is also imperfect: diffusion scores are position-wise marginal probabilities, while AR verification accepts tokens under prefix-conditioned probabilities. The ranking signal and the verifier’s decision rule are therefore misaligned.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to both diffusion language modeling and inference efficiency. It shows that the serving advantage of diffusion LMs is not only about parallel token prediction; it also depends on how candidate distributions are converted into paths that an AR-style verifier can accept. The key lesson is that well-calibrated marginals are not enough when the acceptance process is sequential and prefix-dependent.
summary_en.technical_approach: PRESTO introduces prefix-aligned tree drafting. It modifies diffusion marginal scores with a prefix-dependent correction, aiming to preserve the useful signal from the diffusion drafter while making path ranking closer to the AR verifier’s acceptance behavior. A priority-based tree search then expands high-potential candidate paths under a fixed drafting budget. Compared with AR tree drafting, the method has to compensate for the absence of native left-to-right conditional probabilities. Compared with linear diffusion drafting, it uses the multi-candidate structure that diffusion generation already exposes.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates PRESTO in two settings: dedicated diffusion drafters for AR LLM speculative decoding, such as the dFlash line of work, and self-speculative decoding for diffusion LMs. The reported outcomes are higher accepted length and better end-to-end throughput. The important comparisons are linear drafting, naive tree drafting, marginal-only tree ranking, and the full prefix-aligned priority search. The supplied content does not include exact throughput gains, accepted-length numbers, or detailed batch-size sensitivity, so those should be verified in the experiment tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take 20–30 minutes. Start with the section that explains the mismatch between diffusion marginal scoring and prefix-based AR verification. Then read the scoring rule and the priority tree construction algorithm. In the results, focus on accepted length versus wall-clock throughput, not just draft quality. The most useful ablations are tree size, scoring variant, batch size, and target-model utilization, because they determine whether the method gives practical serving gains.

recommendation.zh: 扩散 LM 推测解码的扎实改进，前缀对齐与树状草稿的组合解决了一个真实的结构性 mismatch，做 dLLM 推理的人应读 §3 和实验部分。
recommendation.en: A solid improvement in diffusion LM speculative decoding; the prefix-aligned tree drafting addresses a real structural mismatch. Researchers working on dLLM inference should read §3 and the experiments.

paper.title: Adversarial Prompts for Acceptance Collapse in Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Lossless acceleration schemes, such as speculative decoding, promise significant inference speedups by relying on dynamic token-level alignment between a draft and a target model. However, this guarantee of semantic equivalence masks a severe operational vulnerability: draft-target alignment can be systematically attacked. In this paper, we introduce ADSD, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first prompt-suffix attack that collapses verifier acceptance by pushing draft probability mass t

summary.core_problem: 研究 speculative decoding 在“语义等价但依赖 draft-target 对齐”的前提下，是否存在可被纯提示词触发的可用性攻击：攻击者仅追加短 suffix，就能系统性拉低 verifier acceptance，导致反复 draft-verify 循环、吞吐下降与延迟上升，同时输出质量看起来仍正常。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对“推理侧效率机制如何被分布偏移/对抗输入击穿”给了一个清晰案例：speculative decoding 的收益来自分布对齐，而对齐是可被输入诱导破坏的。对做大模型训练的人，启发在于：1）draft/target 的对齐不仅是平均意义的 KL/CE 问题，还存在可被放大的局部失配；2）如果未来把 speculative decoding 视作默认 serving 组件，那么训练阶段可能需要显式考虑“acceptance-robustness”（例如对齐正则、对抗式数据、或更稳健的验收规则），否则系统层面的 scaling 可能被少量恶意请求拖垮。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 ADSD（prompt-suffix attack）。核心是把“让 acceptance 崩溃”写成可优化目标，但 acceptance 由 speculative verification 的非对称接受规则（token-level accept/reject）决定，直接优化不可导且高度离散。

方法上做了两件事：
1）Soft-Collapse surrogate：构造一个与 verifier 接受规则对齐的可微代理目标，用来推动 draft 的概率质量集中到 target 不愿接受的 token 上，从而提高 reject 概率、触发早拒绝并丢弃后续 draft token，放大无效计算。这里的关键不是简单最大化 draft-target 分歧，而是贴合“非对称接受规则”带来的梯度方向：让 draft 变得更自信但更错，reject 才会稳定发生。
2）Target-preservation objective：加入保持任务输出质量/语义不被明显破坏的约束，避免攻击退化成输出乱码或触发拒答（那样容易被质量监控拦截）。

优化算法是 gradient-guided 的离散 prompt 搜索：在 token 空间里迭代更新 suffix，使 Soft-Collapse 与 preservation 两个目标同时上升。威胁模型假设白盒离线访问 draft/target/tokenizer/验收机制，但线上只能追加短 suffix，不改权重、不改温度、不碰 serving 策略。
summary.experiments:
文中给出的代表性结果：在 GSM8K（matched 设置）上，加入攻击 suffix 后，平均 sample time 从 26.05s 增加到 42.29s（+62.3%），同时“任务质量保持”（文中表述为 accuracy/quality 基本不变的 stealthy 攻击）。作者还报告了跨数据集、跨架构、跨 decoding 策略的稳定性：攻击效果在多种设置下都能复现，说明它不是某个模型/任务的偶然现象，而是 speculative acceptance 机制层面的脆弱点。

从实验设计角度，值得注意的是他们强调“短 suffix”即可触发，并且把对比重点放在 acceptance/轮次数/端到端时间，而不是只看输出长度或困惑度。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Threat Model and Impact：把攻击面限定在“只改输入 suffix、只打 acceptance”这一点讲清楚，能快速判断这是不是你关心的系统风险。
- 再看方法里 Soft-Collapse 的推导/定义：重点理解它如何近似非对称接受规则，以及为什么不是简单最大化 KL(q||p) 或交叉熵差。
- 最后看 GSM8K 的端到端时间与质量保持的对照表/图（文中 Figure 1 + 关键结果段）：确认攻击确实是‘效率崩溃但语义看起来正常’。

如果要深挖：建议把 acceptance 规则写成显式概率表达式，思考哪些训练/对齐正则能降低这种“可被输入放大的局部失配”，以及是否存在更稳健的 verification（例如分块验收、随机化、或对 draft 置信度的惩罚）。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper asks whether speculative decoding—while distribution-preserving in principle—has an input-triggered availability vulnerability: can an attacker append a short prompt suffix that systematically collapses verifier acceptance, forcing repeated draft-verify cycles and inflating latency/cost, while keeping the final answer quality seemingly intact?
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining recipe contribution, but a concrete mechanism-level warning for anyone treating speculative decoding as a default serving primitive. The speedup hinges on draft–target alignment; the paper shows that alignment can be adversarially disrupted by inputs, not just by model mismatch. For foundation-model researchers, the takeaway is that “alignment” is not only an average KL/CE issue—there are exploitable local mismatches that can be amplified. If speculative decoding becomes ubiquitous, training-time objectives may need to incorporate acceptance-robustness (regularizing draft heads, adversarial mixtures, or more robust verification rules) to avoid system-level scaling being bottlenecked by a small fraction of malicious queries.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They propose ADSD, a prompt-suffix attack optimized to reduce speculative acceptance. Directly optimizing acceptance is hard because the accept/reject rule is discrete and asymmetric. The method introduces:

1) Soft-Collapse: a verifier-aligned differentiable surrogate derived from the asymmetric speculative acceptance rule. Instead of merely maximizing distributional divergence, it pushes the draft model to place confident probability mass on tokens that the target is unlikely to accept, making early rejections frequent and wasting compute.

2) Target-preservation objective: a constraint/auxiliary loss to keep task behavior and output quality from obviously degrading (to remain stealthy under quality monitoring).

Optimization is done via gradient-guided discrete prompt search over a short suffix. The threat model is user-space only at inference time (suffix injection), with white-box offline access to the draft/target/tokenizer and the exact verification mechanism for crafting the suffix.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported number: on matched GSM8K, the adversarial suffix increases mean sample time from 26.05s to 42.29s (+62.3%) while preserving task quality (accuracy/answer quality largely unchanged per the paper’s claim). They also evaluate across multiple datasets, model families/architectures, and decoding variants, and report consistent degradation—supporting that the issue is tied to the speculative acceptance mechanism rather than a single benchmark artifact.

The evaluation focuses on acceptance-driven efficiency metrics (rounds, wasted verification, end-to-end time) rather than trivial length inflation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~20–30 minutes):
- Threat model + impact section: understand the exact attack surface (suffix-only, no serving knobs) and why it is an availability risk.
- The Soft-Collapse definition/derivation: this is the technical core; check how it mirrors the asymmetric acceptance rule and why generic divergence objectives are insufficient.
- The GSM8K latency/quality tables and the main figure illustrating acceptance collapse.

If you want to go deeper, rewrite the acceptance rule explicitly and think about defenses that can be implemented at training time (draft-head regularization, adversarial suffix augmentation) vs. at verification time (rule modifications, randomization, confidence penalties).

recommendation.zh: 做 serving 或推测解码的可读 §攻击目标；结论不改预训练路线，但会改变对“无损加速=低风险”的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the attack objective if you run speculative decoding; it does not affect pretraining strategy, but it weakens the prior that lossless acceleration is operationally low-risk.

paper.title: Windowed-MTP: Removing the Full-Context Draft-KV Tax at Million-Token Context
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by having a cheap draft propose tokens that a target verifies in parallel. Frontier models increasingly ship a built-in Multi-Token-Prediction (MTP/NEXTN) draft head under the assumption that the draft is negligibly cheap. At million-token context this breaks: an MTP draft head typically runs full attention over the entire KV cache at every draft step, so its read grows linearly with context and comes to dominate the draft cost -- precis

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是长上下文 speculative decoding 里一个被低估的瓶颈：内置 MTP/NEXTN draft head 在百万 token 上下文下并不“便宜”。虽然 target verify 端越来越多采用 hybrid 或 linear attention 来压低长上下文成本，但很多原生 draft head 仍然对全量 KV cache 做 full attention。结果是 draft 每走一步都要线性读取整段上下文，context 越长、draft 越深，这部分 draft-KV read tax 越重，甚至会把 speculative decoding 的净收益吃掉，在低 acceptance 的难任务上比不做 speculation 还慢。论文的核心问题不是如何提高 acceptance，而是如何去掉这个 full-context draft tax，同时保持 exact speculation 的正确性。
summary.importance: 对 serving 和模型共设计来说，这篇工作很重要，因为它指出了一个现实偏差：很多 speculative decoding 的成本模型默认 draft 近似免费，这在短上下文成立，但在 1M context 已经失真。更关键的是，随着 target 侧转向 hybrid/linear attention，这个失真会更严重，因为 verify 变便宜后，draft 的全上下文 attention 反而暴露成主成本。论文给出的方案很简单，但意义不小：只改 draft 的注意力工作集，不改 verify，因此不碰 exactness；不需要训练、蒸馏或额外参数，属于可以直接落地的系统改造。对预训练研究员的启发在于，内置 draft head 的设计不能只看短上下文吞吐，也要看与 target attention 形态是否匹配；否则 native MTP 在长上下文下会出现架构失配。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 Windowed-MTP。核心思想是把 StreamingLLM 风格的 sliding window + attention sink 只应用在 draft head 上，而 target verify 仍然保留全上下文注意力。这样 draft 每一步只读取 W + sink 个 token 的 KV，而不是整段 S 长度上下文；例如 1M context 下 4K window 只占 0.4%。

为什么这能做到“lossless by construction”？因为 speculative decoding 的接受与否始终由 full-attention target 决定。windowing 只会改变 draft 提出的候选 token，不会改变 target 的验证规则，因此不会改变最终采样分布。论文还专门做了 greedy output diff，验证 windowed draft 与 native full-attention draft 的最终输出没有系统性分歧，超出范围的差异只来自 verifier 既有的 bf16 非确定性。

作者还给了一个逐步 latency model，把一次 speculative iteration 分成 γ 次 draft forward 和一次 verify forward，并分析在不同 acceptance length、draft depth d=γ+1、context length S 下，什么时候 native deep draft 会从加速退化到与 dense baseline 持平，甚至变成负收益。这个模型的意义在于，它不是只报告“快了多少”，而是解释为什么在长上下文、低 acceptance、verify 变便宜时，draft attention 会成为主导项。

机制分析部分也做得比较扎实。作者没有停留在“窗口够小也没掉速”这种经验结论，而是看了 window-size dose-response、每个 draft position 的 conditional acceptance 分解，以及 in-run decision-invariance probe。结论是：windowing 大多数时候并不改变 draft 的 top-1 proposal，保留了与 full-attention draft 相近的 acceptance profile，因此速度收益来自每步成本下降，而不是靠牺牲 acceptance 换吞吐。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖三类架构：至少包括 dense Qwen-122B、hybrid Nemotron，以及另一类不同 attention 家族模型。重点都放在 1M context、batch size 1 的长上下文 decode。

首先，论文量化了 long-context draft-attention tax。在 γ=6、也就是 d=7 的设定下，仅 draft phase 相对 bare verify 就额外增加了 +92% 到 +138% 的每步成本，几乎把一次 decode step 的代价翻倍。这说明“draft 很便宜”的假设在百万上下文下已经不成立。更关键的是，在 hard、low-acceptance workload 上，原生 native draft 会出现净负收益：例如 Qwen-122B code QA 上 d=7 只有 0.80× no-speculation dense baseline，Nemotron hybrid 上是 0.97×；把 draft 加深到 d=9 也救不回来。

Windowed-MTP 的收益比较稳定。在 1M context 下，相对 native MTP，每个 speculative iteration 的 per-step cost 降低约 28%–44%，而且这个收益基本 input-invariant，大小与“draft 成本里有多少是可窗口化 attention”一致。作者还测了 draft KV pool 占总 KV 的比例，在三种模型上约为 7.7%–11%；windowing 之后，除了 W+sink 之外的 draft KV 都变成 dead state，可以回收到一个紧凑 ring buffer，且没有质量或速度副作用。

接受率方面，windowing 对 draft top-1 proposal 的保持率达到 86%–94%，整体 acceptance 曲线与 full-attention draft 在置信区间内接近。残余差异存在，但量级小、符号依赖输入和 draft depth，而且始终被每步成本下降带来的收益覆盖，所以端到端结果没有回退。论文还强调，这种改造在 exactness 上没有妥协，因为 target verify 完全不变。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合精读。先看 Introduction 和 Section 3，抓住作者提出的成本分解：speculative decoding 在长上下文下的问题不只是 acceptance 不够高，而是 draft 自身的 full-context attention 已经成为主要瓶颈。这里的 latency model 值得仔细看，它能帮助判断 native MTP 什么时候会从加速器变成负担。

然后重点读方法部分，尤其是“为什么只窗口化 draft 仍然保持 exactness”。很多人会把这类近似和 lossless 混在一起，这篇文章把边界讲得很清楚：近似发生在 proposal，正确性由 verifier 兜底。接着看 acceptance 机制分析，特别是 window-size sweep、per-position conditional acceptance 和 decision-invariance probe，这几部分解释了为什么 4K 级别窗口已经足够支撑 draft 的局部猜测。

实验上建议重点看 Table 13 一类展示 native draft 变成 net-negative 的结果，以及 1M context 下 28%–44% per-step 降幅的主表。若只想抓主线，读完引言、成本模型、主实验和 exactness 验证，大约 45–60 分钟。若要深挖，值得思考两个延伸问题：一是预训练阶段是否应该显式约束 draft head 的局部性，让它天然适配 windowed inference；二是当 target 进一步转向 linear/hybrid attention 时，draft 与 target 的 attention family 是否也应该共同设计，而不是把 full-attention MTP 直接挂在一个更便宜的 verifier 上。
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA 相关工作。正文里给出了 SGLang patch 和复现实验仓库，作者名单在提供内容中未完整展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific but increasingly important bottleneck in long-context speculative decoding: built-in MTP/NEXTN draft heads are not cheap at million-token context. While target models are moving toward hybrid or linear attention to reduce long-context verification cost, many native draft heads still run full attention over the entire KV cache at every draft step. That makes draft cost scale linearly with context, and the deeper the draft chain, the worse the tax. On hard workloads with low acceptance, the native draft can erase the speedup of speculation and even become slower than plain decoding. The paper asks how to remove this full-context draft-KV tax without sacrificing the exactness guarantee of speculative decoding.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong systems paper with direct implications for model-serving co-design. It exposes a mismatch in the standard speculative-decoding cost model: treating the draft as negligible is fine at short context, but wrong at 1M tokens. The mismatch becomes sharper as the verifier gets cheaper through hybrid or linear attention. The proposed fix is simple and deployable: restrict only the draft’s attention working set, keep verification unchanged, and preserve exact decoding by construction. For pretraining-oriented readers, the broader lesson is that native draft-head design should be evaluated jointly with the target’s attention family and long-context operating regime; otherwise an apparently lightweight MTP head can become architecturally misaligned at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Windowed-MTP, applies a StreamingLLM-style sliding window plus attention sink to the draft head only, while leaving the target verifier at full attention. As a result, each draft forward reads only W + sink tokens from KV instead of the full context length S. At 1M context, a 4K window is only 0.4% of the sequence.

The key point is why this remains lossless. In speculative decoding, the target verifier always decides which proposed tokens are accepted. Windowing changes only the draft proposals, not the acceptance rule. Therefore the final output distribution remains identical to standard exact speculation. The paper validates this with greedy output diffs, showing no systematic divergence beyond the verifier’s existing bf16 nondeterminism.

The authors also provide a per-step latency model. One speculative iteration is decomposed into γ draft forwards plus one verify forward, and the model explains when a deeper native draft stops helping: long context increases draft KV reads, low acceptance reduces amortization, and cheaper verify phases expose the draft cost instead of hiding it. This is useful because the paper does not merely report speedups; it explains the regime in which native MTP collapses from accelerator to liability.

The mechanistic analysis is also stronger than usual. The paper studies window-size dose response, conditional acceptance by draft position, and an in-run decision-invariance probe. The conclusion is that windowing usually preserves the draft’s top-1 proposal and closely tracks the full-attention acceptance profile. The gain therefore comes from reducing per-step draft cost, not from trading away acceptance for throughput.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments span three architecture families, including at least a dense Qwen-122B model, a hybrid Nemotron model, and a third model with a different attention design. The main operating point is 1M context with batch size 1.

First, the paper quantifies the long-context draft-attention tax. At γ=6, i.e. d=7, the draft phase alone adds about +92% to +138% on top of the bare verify cost per decode step, nearly doubling step latency. This directly falsifies the assumption that the draft is negligible at million-token context. More importantly, on hard low-acceptance workloads the shipped native draft can become net-negative: at d=7 it reaches only 0.80× the no-speculation dense baseline on Qwen-122B code QA and 0.97× on the hybrid Nemotron. Increasing draft depth to d=9 does not rescue the situation.

Windowed-MTP then delivers a fairly consistent reduction. At 1M context, it cuts per-speculative-iteration cost by about 28%–44% relative to native MTP, and the gain is largely input-invariant. Its magnitude tracks the fraction of draft cost attributable to windowable attention. The paper also measures that the draft KV pool is about 7.7%–11% of total KV across the three models; after windowing, all but W + sink of that draft KV becomes dead state and can be reclaimed into a compact ring buffer with no quality or speed penalty.

On acceptance behavior, windowing preserves the draft top-1 proposal 86%–94% of the time, and the resulting acceptance profile tracks full-attention draft within confidence intervals across the sweep. Residual differences exist, but they are small, depend on input and draft depth, and are always outweighed by the per-step latency reduction. End-to-end performance therefore never regresses in the reported settings, while exactness is preserved because the verifier is unchanged.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one is worth a careful read. Start with the introduction and the latency decomposition section. The central insight is not simply that acceptance matters, but that full-context draft attention becomes the dominant cost at long context, especially when the verifier has already been optimized with hybrid or linear attention. The latency model is useful because it tells you when native MTP stops being a speedup mechanism.

Then read the method section with attention to the exactness argument. The paper is careful about the distinction between approximating the proposal path and preserving the final decoding distribution through full verification. That boundary is important. After that, spend time on the acceptance analysis: the window-size sweep, per-position conditional acceptance, and decision-invariance probe explain why a relatively small local window is enough for the draft to remain a good proposer.

For experiments, prioritize the tables showing native draft becoming net-negative and the main 1M-context latency reductions. A focused read of the introduction, cost model, main experiments, and exactness validation should take about 45–60 minutes. For deeper follow-up, two questions are especially interesting: whether pretraining should explicitly encourage locality in native draft heads so they are naturally compatible with windowed inference, and whether draft and verifier attention families should be co-designed rather than attaching a full-attention MTP head to an increasingly cheap hybrid/linear verifier.
summary_en.authors_note: Appears to be an NVIDIA-affiliated work. The provided text includes an SGLang patch and reproduction package, but the full author list is not visible in the supplied content.

recommendation.zh: 指出 MTP 在长上下文下的隐性税，是部署前沿模型必踩的坑；training-free 无损修复应立刻在内部长上下文 serving 栈里复现。
recommendation.en: Exposes a hidden tax of MTP at long context that every frontier serving stack will hit; the training-free lossless fix should be reproduced in your long-context serving stack immediately.

paper.title: SonicSampler: Unified Tile-Aware Kernels for LLM Sampling and Speculative Verification
paper.abstract: Sampling in LLM inference comprises a combinatorial set of logit processing, token selection, and verification operations for speculative decoding. However, existing implementations either accelerate only subsets of this pipeline, rely on multiple kernel launches, or assume homogeneous sampling behavior across a batch, limiting support for dynamic serving workloads and preventing efficient CUDA Graph execution. We present $\textbf{SonicSampler}$, a unified suite of tile-aware Triton kernels that

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 LLM serving 中采样阶段的系统瓶颈。现有优化多集中在模型 forward，但实际生成还包含 grammar mask、重复惩罚、logit bias、temperature、top-k/top-p/min-p、token selection，以及 speculative decoding 的验证逻辑。这些步骤常被拆成多个 kernel，带来 launch 开销和中间显存读写；同时很多实现假设 batch 内采样策略一致，难以适配 continuous batching 下的混合请求，也不利于 CUDA Graph。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 serving 和解码侧研究有参考价值。它指出当 draft model、Medusa/EAGLE/MTP 这类推测解码方法把模型计算压低后，采样和验证会变成相对更显著的开销。对预训练研究员的启发在于：推理效率不能只看 Transformer forward，训练阶段引入的解码范式、输出约束和采样策略，最后都会落到 serving kernel 的可实现性上。
summary.technical_approach: SonicSampler 用一组 tile-aware Triton kernels 把 logit processing、截断采样、token selection 和 speculative verification 纵向融合到固定执行模型里，并保持 CUDA Graph 兼容。它支持 standard/draft inference 的 singular mode，也支持 speculative verification 的 multistep mode。batch 内不同请求可以有不同采样配置，靠紧凑的 bit-level indicators 做动态分派。核心算法是两阶段 hierarchical top-k：第一阶段按 vocabulary tile 执行完整 logit-processing prologue，然后在 tile 内用 adaptive radix 或 bitonic selection 保留候选；第二阶段把各 tile 的候选 gather 后 merge 成最终 top-k。论文把 top-k 的全词表归约改成 map-reduce 形态，并利用经验事实：next-token 分布通常高度集中，top-128 足以覆盖后续 top-p/min-p/采样需要的主要概率质量。
summary.experiments: 论文报告两类关键结果。第一，hierarchical top-k 相比已有 radix/bitonic top-k 实现最高有约 10 倍加速。第二，在 speculative decoding 工作负载上，完整采样管线相对 FlashInfer 等 baseline 最高达到约 16 倍加速。论文还做了 top-128 候选集的有效性验证，说明在测试设置中它能保留几乎全部相关概率质量，并基本不影响下游准确性。需要注意的是，这类结果强依赖 vocabulary size、batch heterogeneity、采样配置和 draft/target 比例，复现时应看具体 workload。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对采样瓶颈的拆解，以及 SonicSampler 设计原则和两阶段 top-k 算法部分。Section 4.5 关于 top-128 近似有效性的实验值得单独看，因为这是算法简化能否成立的关键。若关心工程落地，应重点检查 CUDA Graph 兼容性、per-request dynamic behavior 的编码方式，以及 speculative verification 与普通 sampling 是否共用同一执行路径。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in LLM serving: sampling is no longer a trivial post-processing step. Modern deployments combine grammar constraints, repetition and frequency penalties, logit bias, temperature scaling, top-k/top-p/min-p filtering, stochastic or greedy selection, and speculative verification. Existing implementations often split these operations across multiple kernels, assume homogeneous sampling behavior inside a batch, or break CUDA Graph compatibility.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-systems paper, not a pretraining method. Its relevance to foundation-model work comes from the interface between modeling choices and deployability. As draft models, Medusa-style heads, EAGLE, and multi-token prediction reduce the relative cost of forward passes, the sampling and verification path can become a visible latency component. The paper is useful when thinking about whether a decoding or training-time generation strategy can be served efficiently at scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: SonicSampler provides tile-aware Triton kernels that vertically fuse logit processing, truncation, sampling, and speculative verification into a CUDA Graph-compatible execution model. It supports both singular mode for standard or draft-model decoding and multistep mode for verification. Per-request sampling heterogeneity is handled inside a batched dispatch using compact bit-level indicators. The main algorithmic change is a two-stage hierarchical top-k. Stage one processes vocabulary tiles, applies the full logit-processing prologue, and selects local candidates using adaptive radix or bitonic selection with a stable lexicographic encoding. Stage two gathers and merges tile-level candidates into the final top-k. The design relies on the empirical concentration of next-token distributions and uses a bounded candidate set, typically k = 128, instead of treating full-vocabulary top-k as the dominant primitive.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports up to 10x speedup for the hierarchical top-k component over existing radix- and bitonic-based alternatives. For speculative decoding workloads, the end-to-end sampling pipeline shows up to 16x speedup over FlashInfer and other baselines. The authors also validate the top-128 assumption, showing that it retains nearly all relevant probability mass and preserves downstream accuracy in their tested settings. The exact gain should be read together with the workload mix, vocabulary size, batch heterogeneity, and the ratio between draft and target computation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most model researchers. Focus on the problem decomposition in the introduction, the unified execution model, and the two-stage top-k design. The empirical validation of top-128 is the key section to inspect, because it justifies the main approximation. For engineering use, check how CUDA Graph compatibility is maintained and how mixed greedy, stochastic, constrained, and verification paths are represented in one batched kernel interface.

recommendation.zh: 做 serving/Triton kernel 的人值得细看两阶段 top-k 与 fusion 策略；对预训练本身无直接方法论贡献，但工程参考价值高。
recommendation.en: Worth a close look if you write serving/Triton kernels, especially the two-stage top-k and fusion strategy; no direct pretraining methodology insight, but strong engineering reference.

paper.title: DC-Leap: Training-Free Acceleration of dLLMs via Draft-Guided Contiguous Leaping Decoding
paper.abstract: While parallel decoding is central to the efficiency of Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs), current strategies are often hindered by overly conservative confidence thresholds. These thresholds, necessitated by the Joint Probability Dependence Error (JPDE), result in redundant denoising iterations and suboptimal inference speeds. To overcome this, we propose DC-Leap, a training-free framework that enables reliable acceleration of dLLMs in the moderate-confidence regime. DC-Leap introduces a

summary.core_problem: Diffusion LLM（如 LLaDA、Dream）的并行解码依赖高置信度阈值来抑制联合概率依赖误差（JPDE），导致大量置信度中等但预测正确的 token 被丢弃，造成冗余去噪步数和实际加速受限；而朴素的逐个顺序验证又会损失并行度，并让双向注意力的 dLLM 处于缺乏右侧上下文的失配推理分布中。
summary.importance: 这是 dLLM 推理效率方向的一个实用改进，属于 training-free 解码算法层面的工作。它指出了现有 parallel decoding 中阈值设置与 JPDE 之间的核心矛盾，对理解 masked/diffusion LM 的解码动力学有参考价值，但不改变预训练范式本身，对基座预训练研究的直接启发有限，主要服务于把 dLLM 推向可用推理速度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DC-Leap，包含两个机制：1）Dynamic Contiguous Verification（DCV）：在一个动态窗口内做严格左到右的顺序验证，连续接受高置信 token，遇到第一个低于阈值的 token 就停下，把全局条件独立假设替换为局部链式因子分解，从而在不做全局顺序解码的前提下缓解 JPDE；2）Draft-guided Decoding：窗口之外仍然保留模型预测出的高置信草稿 token 作为已填入的右向上下文，这些 token 不立即 commit，但为后续 denoising forward 提供 look-ahead context，缓解纯左到右验证带来的双向上下文缺失和训练-推理分布偏移。整体不改动模型权重，只改变解码时的 mask/commit 策略。
summary.experiments: 在 LLaDA-1.5、LLaDA-8B-Instruct、Dream-v0-7B-Instruct 三个 dLLM 上，覆盖数学推理、指令跟随、代码生成等五个 benchmark，对比 Fast-dLLM、LocalLeap 等并行解码基线。论文给出的核心结论是：在不损失生成质量的前提下，通过将置信度阈值从通常 >0.9 安全下调到中等区间，获得比已有并行解码方法更明显的速度提升；文中报告 61% 的正确 token 落在 0.65–0.9 置信区间，说明高阈值确实浪费了大量可加速区域。具体端到端 wall-clock 加速比和各 benchmark 的质量退化数据在正文实验部分给出，消融主要验证了 DCV 和 draft 机制各自对速度-质量权衡的贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议先看 Figure 2 对 JPDE 和置信度分布的诊断，再看 DCV 窗口与 draft 机制的算法描述。重点理解为什么“局部顺序验证 + 保留右侧草稿”比“全局高阈值并行”和“纯顺序解码”都更适合双向 dLLM。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Parallel decoding for diffusion language models (LLaDA, Dream, etc.) relies on conservative high-confidence thresholds to suppress the Joint Probability Dependence Error (JPDE), which discards many correct tokens in the moderate-confidence regime and leads to redundant denoising steps. Naive sequential verification eliminates JPDE but destroys parallelism and forces bidirectional dLLMs into a mismatched inference regime without right-side context.
summary_en.importance: A practical training-free decoding improvement for diffusion LLMs. It cleanly articulates the tension between threshold stringency and JPDE in parallel decoding, which is useful for understanding masked/diffusion LM inference dynamics. The paper is mainly an inference-effort contribution rather than a pretraining advance; its direct relevance to base-model pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: DC-Leap combines two mechanisms. Dynamic Contiguous Verification (DCV) maintains a dynamic decoding window in which tokens are verified strictly left-to-right and accepted contiguously until the first below-threshold prediction. This replaces the global conditional-independence assumption of standard parallel decoding with a local chain factorization, mitigating JPDE without full sequential commitment.
