Draft-guided Decoding keeps high-confidence uncommitted tokens outside the verification window as look-ahead context, so later denoising passes still see approximately bidirectional context instead of collapsing to left-only conditioning. The method is training-free and operates only at decoding time.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LLaDA-1.5, LLaDA-8B-Instruct, and Dream-v0-7B-Instruct across five benchmarks spanning math reasoning, instruction following, and code generation, compared against Fast-dLLM and LocalLeap. The central empirical observation is that 61% of correct tokens fall in the 0.65–0.9 confidence band, justifying a safe lowering of thresholds. DC-Leap is reported to achieve larger speedups than prior parallel decoders without measurable quality loss. Ablations separately attribute gains to the local verification mechanism and the look-ahead draft.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Start with Figure 2 for the diagnosis of JPDE and confidence distributions, then read the algorithm box for DCV and draft-guided decoding. The key takeaway is why local ordered verification with retained right-side drafts is a better operating point for bidirectional dLLMs than either global thresholded parallel decoding or pure sequential decoding. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 针对 Diffusion LM 推理加速的免训练方法，结合了推测解码的思想来缓解并行解码的依赖误差，关注非自回归生成的效率优化可读。
recommendation.en: A training-free acceleration method for Diffusion LMs that incorporates speculative decoding ideas to mitigate dependence errors in parallel decoding; relevant for non-autoregressive generation efficiency.

paper.title: Leaky Language Models: Stealing Architecture and Inference Optimizations via Per-Token Timing
paper.abstract: This work presents LeakyLMs, a set of attacks that leak proprietary model, architecture, and deployment information from production language models. LeakyLMs is the first to demonstrate that key model and deployment details can be inferred using only token generation timing, even when interacting through remote APIs. LeakyLMs introduces two core attacks. The first attack targets inference optimizations and deployment strategies. For example, our attack detects whether a provider uses speculative

summary.core_problem: LeakyLMs 研究的是一个服务侧信息泄露问题：即使只能通过远程 API 观察流式输出的逐 token 延迟，攻击者也可能推断出模型架构参数和推理优化策略。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座研究员的价值主要在 serving 与模型保密边界。它提醒一个现实问题：架构、KV-cache、FlashAttention、投机解码、draft model 上下文长度等部署选择，会在逐 token 延迟中留下可测信号。对于闭源模型评测、API 行为分析、推理系统设计和模型发布策略，这类侧信道不能被当作纯安全细节处理。它也说明 latency trace 不只是系统指标，还可能反推出模型规模与结构信息。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出两类攻击。第一类针对投机解码。投机解码用较小 draft model 先生成若干候选 token，再由主模型验证；若 draft model 在长上下文依赖上失效，接受率会下降，逐 token 延迟模式会变化。LeakyLMs 通过构造需要远距离上下文的信息检索式提示，逐步改变依赖距离，从而判断服务是否使用投机解码，并估计 draft model 的有效上下文窗口。第二类攻击针对架构参数恢复。方法先从 Transformer 计算图出发，分析层数、hidden dimension、attention heads、KV-cache、FlashAttention 等因素对延迟的影响；再用多组配置的实测数据拟合可解释的线性回归时延模型；最后把该模型作为 oracle，在候选架构空间中做 grid search，找出最接近目标逐 token 延迟序列的参数组合。关键技巧是使用相邻 token 的差分延迟，以降低网络抖动和共享系统噪声的影响。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 Gemini Flash 1.5、Flash 2.5、Flash 2.5 Lite 都可被检测出使用投机解码，并估计其 draft model 上下文窗口分别约为 32K、128K、128K tokens。架构恢复实验覆盖 eager Transformer、FlashAttention2、KV-cache 等实现。时延预测器在 eager 实现上的 NRMSE 为 0.12，在使用 FlashAttention2 与 KV caching 的 prefill 时间预测上 NRMSE 为 0.188。层数恢复可达到接近真实值 ±1 的精度；top-5 准确率分别为 86.15%、97.69%、83.78%，对应 eager、FlashAttention2、FlashAttention2 with KV caching 三类设置。论文还展示了对 Weights & Biases 托管未知模型的参数恢复案例，其中 hidden dimension 预测与目标匹配。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对逐 token timing channel 的威胁模型定义；再看投机解码攻击部分，重点是如何用长上下文依赖触发 draft/main model 分歧，以及如何从延迟拐点估计 draft context length。架构恢复部分建议看计算图分析和回归特征设计，不必逐行追实验细节。实验部分优先看 Gemini 系列的投机解码检测结果、NRMSE 表格、层数恢复 top-5 结果。若从推理系统角度阅读，最后应关注防御讨论：延迟扰动、批处理、缓存策略和流式输出节奏都可能影响攻击有效性，但也会带来 QoS 成本。

summary_en.core_problem: LeakyLMs studies an inference-side information leakage problem: an external user, interacting only through a remote streaming API, may infer proprietary model architecture and deployment choices from per-token generation timing.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful for researchers who care about serving, model release, and closed-model measurement. It shows that deployment choices such as speculative decoding, draft-model context length, KV caching, FlashAttention, depth, hidden size, and attention heads can leave measurable signatures in token latency traces. Latency is therefore not only an efficiency metric; it can become a side channel for recovering model and system details.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces two attacks. The first detects speculative decoding and estimates the draft model context window. Since speculative decoding relies on a smaller draft model whose predictions are verified by the main model, prompts that require information beyond the draft model’s context should reduce acceptance and alter the latency pattern. By varying the distance of the relevant context, the attack identifies whether speculative decoding is in use and where the draft-context limit lies. The second attack recovers architectural parameters. It starts with an analysis of the Transformer computation graph to derive how latency depends on depth, hidden dimension, attention heads, KV cache behavior, and FlashAttention-style kernels. The authors then fit an empirical linear timing model over measured configurations and use it as an oracle for grid search over candidate architectures. Differential timing between consecutive tokens is used to reduce shared noise such as network delay.
summary_en.experiments: The reported deployment attack finds evidence that Gemini Flash 1.5, Flash 2.5, and Flash 2.5 Lite use speculative decoding, with estimated draft context windows of roughly 32K, 128K, and 128K tokens. The architecture-recovery experiments cover eager Transformer implementations, FlashAttention2, and FlashAttention2 with KV caching. The timing predictor reaches an NRMSE of 0.12 for eager implementations and 0.188 for prefill-time prediction with FlashAttention2 plus KV caching. Layer-count recovery is typically within ±1 of the true value, with top-5 accuracies of 86.15%, 97.69%, and 83.78% for eager, FlashAttention2, and FlashAttention2 with KV caching, respectively. The paper also includes a case study on an unknown model hosted on Weights & Biases, where the predicted hidden dimension matches the target.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is sufficient. Start with the threat model and the discussion of per-token timing as a side channel. Then read the speculative-decoding attack, especially the prompt construction that forces long-context dependence and the method for detecting the draft-context cutoff. For architecture recovery, focus on the computation-graph analysis and the regression features rather than every experimental setting. In the results, prioritize the Gemini speculative-decoding measurements, the NRMSE tables, and the layer-recovery top-5 results. The defense discussion is also useful for serving researchers, since adding jitter, changing batching behavior, or altering streaming cadence may reduce leakage but can hurt latency and user experience.

recommendation.zh: 做推理优化或模型保密的研究员可看，重点看攻击方法和Gemini实测结果，了解推测解码的时序指纹。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for inference optimization and model security researchers; focus on attack methods and Gemini measurements to understand speculative decoding timing fingerprints.

paper.title: MiniCache: Reusable Program Caching with Small Model Interfaces for Efficient LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for program-aided reasoning, agentic decision making, and structured task execution, but these applications often incur high inference cost. We present MiniCache, a reusable program caching framework that transforms Program-of-Thought (PoT) programs into parameterized cache objects, enabling reusable computation across structurally similar requests. MiniCache reuses the same small model for semantic variable extraction on cache-hit requests and

summary.core_problem: 程序辅助推理和 Agent 场景下，LLM 重复生成结构相似的程序导致推理成本高、延迟大。
summary.importance: 推理效率方向的工程系统创新，提出可复用程序缓存框架。
summary.technical_approach: MiniCache 将 Program-of-Thought 程序参数化为缓存对象，用小模型做缓存命中时的语义变量提取和目标 LLM 生成时的推测草稿，减少大模型调用。
summary.experiments: 在 shopping-style 数据集、WebShop、Formula、CodeTAT-QA 上测试，延迟最高降 3.1x，吞吐最高升 2.8x，精度基本保持。

summary_en.core_problem: Program-aided reasoning and agent workflows repeatedly generate structurally similar programs, leading to high LLM inference cost and latency.
summary_en.importance: Engineering system innovation in inference efficiency; proposes a reusable program caching framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: MiniCache parameterizes PoT programs into reusable cache objects and uses a small model both for semantic variable extraction on cache hits and for speculative drafting during target LLM generation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on shopping-style datasets, WebShop, Formula, and CodeTAT-QA; achieves up to 3.1x lower latency and 2.8x higher throughput with minimal accuracy loss.

recommendation.zh: 小模型做缓存+推测解码的组合思路有启发，但属于推理侧工程，对预训练研究无直接影响，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The small-model cache + speculation combination is interesting but purely inference-side engineering; read only the abstract.

paper.title: AdaFlash: Adaptive Speculative Decoding via On-Policy Distilled Diffusion Drafters
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding, in which a lightweight draft model first generates a draft sequence that is then verified in parallel by the target model, has become a prevalent paradigm for accelerating large language model inference. Recent work such as DFlash further boosts drafting efficiency by leveraging diffusion drafters, whose parallel denoising mechanism enables draft generation in a single forward pass. In this work, we uncover a central pitfall of diffusion drafters: bidirectional attention is

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion drafter 用于 speculative decoding 时一个很具体、但此前没有被讲透的问题：单步并行起草虽然便宜，但 bidirectional attention 带来的全局耦合会让 draft 质量方差明显变大。这个方差有两层表现。第一层是 domain-level variance：同一个 diffusion drafter 在不同任务域上的 acceptance rate 波动比 AR drafter 更大，静态蒸馏好的 drafter 一旦遇到分布偏移，速度收益会迅速掉下去。第二层是 token-level variance：同一条 draft 序列里，不同位置 token 的接受概率差异很大，固定 candidate length 会让 target model 花不少验证算力在低接受概率 token 上。论文要解决的不是“如何再做一个更快的 speculative decoding”，而是“如何让 diffusion drafter 在真实 serving 场景里更稳、更自适应，不因为方差问题把理论并行优势吃掉”。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练，而在建模范式与 serving 接口：如果 diffusion LM 想作为 AR LM 的实用补充，而不是只停留在离线实验里，就必须回答稳定性和系统适配问题。AdaFlash 给出的结论很清楚：diffusion drafter 的优势不是天然成立的，必须配合在线分布适配和长度自适应，才能在高并发、跨域请求下持续兑现吞吐收益。这个判断对所有“非 AR 模型作为辅助生成器”的路线都有参考价值，包括 masked/any-order drafter、MTP 辅助头、甚至小型 verifier-free 草稿器。贡献量级上，它更像是把 DFlash 这类单步 diffusion drafting 从一个漂亮想法推进到可部署方案，而不是提出新的语言建模目标。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分成两部分。第一部分是 on-policy distillation，目标是降低 domain-level variance。作者不是继续用离线 teacher-student 蒸馏，而是让 drafter 在真实请求分布上在线采样，再用 target model 的分布做蒸馏更新。这里的关键设计有两个。其一是 reverse-KL，而不是常见的 forward-KL/CE。reverse-KL 会更强调 mode-seeking，鼓励 drafter 把概率集中到 target 更确信的 token 上，这和 speculative decoding 的 acceptance 目标更一致，因为 acceptance 取决于 p/q 的比值，q 在 target 低概率区域铺得太宽会直接伤害接受率。其二是 entry-wise divergence clipping，用来抑制 diffusion drafter 训练时局部 token 分布偏差过大导致的不稳定更新。论文把这个 clipping 设计成逐项裁剪的散度约束，而不是简单全局梯度裁剪，针对的是在线蒸馏里少数高偏差 token 把整个 batch 拉坏的问题。

第二部分是 adaptive length head，目标是降低 token-level variance 带来的无效验证开销。作者在 drafter 上额外接一个长度预测头，根据当前 prefix 和 draft 置信度动态决定 candidate length，而不是固定 k。直觉上，这相当于把“是否继续多起草几个 token”变成一个条件决策：当后续位置接受概率已经明显下降时，提前截断，少让 target 做无谓并行验证；当当前上下文容易预测时，再把长度放长，吃到单步并行的收益。这个设计和 AR speculative decoding 里固定 k 的思路不同，更接近 token-budget allocation。

系统层面还有两点实现值得注意。一个是 asynchronous training-inference pipeline，把在线蒸馏更新和在线服务解耦，避免 adaptation 直接阻塞请求路径。另一个是 adaptive request scheduling，在 serving engine 里根据请求状态和 drafter 行为做调度，尽量把在线适配带来的额外开销藏在系统流水线里。论文强调高并发下 prior 方法会退化到不如 AR baseline，说明他们不是只做算法指标，而是把 queueing 和 GPU 利用率也纳入了设计约束。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 8 个 benchmark、3 个 foundation model，并且同时包含 dense 和 MoE target，这一点比只在单一 7B dense 模型上报数更有说服力。摘要里给出的主结果是：相对标准 AR decoding，最高达到 5.3× speedup；在高并发场景下，相比先前方法吞吐最高可再高 66%。对比对象包括 EAGLE-3、multi-token prediction 和 DFlash，说明作者把当前主流 speculative 路线都纳入了比较。

从论文叙述看，关键实验不是单看平均 speedup，而是看方差控制是否真的奏效。应重点关注三类结果。第一类是 acceptance rate 在不同 domain 上的分布，AdaFlash 应该显著缩小 diffusion drafter 相比 AR drafter 的跨域波动。第二类是 adaptive length head 对 verification cost 的影响：通常会看到 acceptance length 只小幅下降，但 target 端验证 token 数下降更明显，因此整体吞吐上升。第三类是高并发 serving 曲线：不少 speculative 方法在低并发时有收益，但并发一高，draft/verify 协调和额外 kernel 开销会把收益吃掉；AdaFlash 的卖点正是这里仍能维持正加速。

从消融角度，值得留意 reverse-KL 与 clipping 是否缺一不可。若只做在线蒸馏而不用 reverse-KL，通常会出现 acceptance 提升有限；若不用 divergence clipping，则在线更新可能不稳定，尤其在 OOD 请求批次上更明显。长度头的消融则应看固定 k 与动态 k 的 trade-off：动态策略不是提高单 token 接受率，而是提高每单位 target 计算换来的 accepted tokens。摘要没有给出参数量、训练 token 数和在线更新频率等细节，阅读正文时需要补这些数字，因为它们决定方法是否真有部署可行性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓住问题定义，再看两个自适应模块如何分别对应两类方差。优先看 Introduction 和 Background 里关于 diffusion drafter 高方差的动机图，尤其是 domain-level 与 token-level variance 的可视化；如果这部分证据不扎实，后面的方案价值会打折。然后看方法部分里 OPD 的目标函数，重点确认 reverse-KL 的具体写法、teacher 分布来自哪里、entry-wise clipping 裁剪的是哪一项散度，以及它为什么比普通 CE 蒸馏更贴 acceptance。接着看 adaptive length head 的训练信号：它是直接预测最优 k、预测 acceptance profile，还是做某种成本收益近似。最后看高并发实验和 serving 端实现，判断收益是算法本身带来的，还是系统工程优化占了主要部分。

预计阅读时间 25 到 35 分钟。若只想抓核心，读动机图、方法总览图、主表和高并发曲线即可；若想判断是否能迁移到别的 non-AR drafter，需要把 OPD 目标和长度头细节读细。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific failure mode of diffusion-based drafters in speculative decoding. One-step parallel drafting is attractive because it amortizes draft generation over multiple tokens, but the same bidirectional attention that enables parallel denoising also creates strong global coupling. That coupling increases variance in draft quality at two levels. At the domain level, acceptance rates fluctuate much more across tasks and distributions than with autoregressive drafters. At the token level, acceptance probabilities vary sharply across positions within the same drafted span, so a fixed candidate length wastes verifier compute on low-probability tokens. The real question here is not simply how to make speculative decoding faster, but how to make diffusion drafters stable and adaptive enough for real serving workloads where request distributions shift and concurrency is high.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is mainly at the interface between modeling and serving rather than pretraining proper. If diffusion LMs are to become practical auxiliary generators for AR targets, they need a story for robustness under distribution shift and for compute allocation during verification. AdaFlash makes a useful point: the gains of diffusion drafting are not automatic. Without online adaptation and dynamic control of draft length, the theoretical parallel advantage can collapse in realistic deployments. That lesson likely extends beyond diffusion drafters to other non-AR assistants, including masked or any-order drafters and multi-token auxiliary heads. The contribution is best viewed as turning one-step diffusion drafting from a promising idea into a more deployable system, not as a new language modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components. The first is on-policy distillation, designed to reduce domain-level variance. Instead of relying on purely offline teacher-student distillation, the drafter is adapted on requests sampled from the live serving distribution, with the target model providing the supervision signal. Two design choices matter. First, the distillation objective uses reverse KL rather than the more common forward KL or plain cross-entropy. That choice is aligned with speculative decoding: reverse KL is more mode-seeking, so it encourages the drafter to concentrate probability mass on tokens the target strongly prefers, which is exactly what improves acceptance under the p/q ratio. A drafter that spreads mass too broadly over low-target-probability tokens hurts acceptance. Second, the paper introduces entry-wise divergence clipping to stabilize online updates. This is more targeted than generic gradient clipping: it limits the effect of a small number of badly mismatched token entries that would otherwise dominate the update and destabilize adaptation.

The second component is an adaptive length head, aimed at token-level variance. Instead of using a fixed candidate length k, the drafter predicts how long the draft should be for the current prefix and confidence pattern. The idea is simple but important: if acceptance probability is likely to decay quickly over the drafted span, stop early and avoid wasting target-side verification on unlikely tokens; if the context is easy, draft longer and exploit the one-pass parallelism. This turns candidate length into a conditional compute-allocation decision rather than a static hyperparameter.

The system layer also matters. The paper adds an asynchronous training-inference pipeline so online adaptation does not block serving, and an adaptive request scheduler inside the serving engine. That is important because many speculative methods look good in isolated latency measurements but degrade under queueing pressure and high concurrency. AdaFlash is explicitly designed for that regime.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans eight benchmarks and three foundation models, including both dense and MoE targets. That is stronger evidence than a single-model study. The headline number in the abstract is up to 5.3x speedup over standard autoregressive decoding. Against prior speculative baselines, including EAGLE-3, multi-token prediction, and DFlash, the method also reports up to 66% higher throughput at high concurrency.

The most important results are likely not the average speedup alone, but whether the proposed controls actually reduce variance. There should be three result groups worth checking closely. First, acceptance-rate distributions across domains: AdaFlash should narrow the cross-domain spread that diffusion drafters otherwise exhibit. Second, the effect of the adaptive length head on verification cost: the accepted length may drop only slightly, while the number of target-side verified tokens drops more, yielding better throughput. Third, the high-concurrency serving curves: many speculative systems lose their gains once scheduling overhead, verifier contention, and extra kernels become dominant; AdaFlash claims to remain net-positive there.

For ablations, the key question is whether reverse KL and divergence clipping are both necessary. Online adaptation without reverse KL would likely improve alignment only modestly, while removing clipping should make updates less stable, especially on out-of-distribution batches. For the length head, the right comparison is fixed-k versus dynamic-k in terms of accepted tokens per unit of target compute, not just raw acceptance. The abstract does not expose model sizes, adaptation frequency, or online training budget, so those details need to be pulled from the main text to judge deployment realism.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the motivation figures that visualize the two variance types. If the evidence for domain-level and token-level variance is weak, the rest of the paper matters less. Then read the method section with a narrow focus: how exactly reverse KL is defined, where the teacher distribution comes from, what quantity is clipped by the entry-wise divergence clipping, and why that objective should correlate better with acceptance than standard CE distillation. After that, inspect the adaptive length head: what target it predicts, how it is trained, and whether it is effectively learning an acceptance profile or directly optimizing a cost-benefit proxy. Finally, read the high-concurrency serving results and the systems section to separate algorithmic gains from engineering gains.

For a skim, 25 to 35 minutes is enough. Read the motivation figures, the method overview, the main comparison table, and the concurrency plots. If you are interested in transferring the idea to other non-AR drafters, spend extra time on the OPD objective and the dynamic-length mechanism.

recommendation.zh: 对扩散式draft模型的诊断（方差问题）比方法本身更有价值；做推测解码的看§3的问题分析即可，方法属增量。
recommendation.en: The diagnosis—that variance, not mean quality, limits diffusion drafters—is more useful than the method itself; read §3 if you work on speculative decoding, treat the method as incremental.

paper.title: SpecLA: Efficient Speculative Decoding for Linear-Attention Models
paper.abstract: Linear-attention models replace the growing KV cache with recurrent states, but autoregressive decoding still reads, updates, and writes these states one token at a time. Speculative decoding can reduce this cost by verifying several draft tokens in one target pass, yet existing speculative systems are designed for Transformer KV caches. For stateful linear-attention targets, verification must follow recurrent dependencies across chains and branches, acceptance must update only the accepted stat

summary.core_problem: 线性注意力和其他有状态序列模型没有传统 KV cache，但解码时仍要逐 token 读写 recurrent state；现有 speculative decoding 主要面向 Transformer KV cache，不能直接高效处理这种状态依赖。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的间接价值在于服务侧约束会反过来影响架构选择。线性注意力模型常被认为能缓解 KV cache 增长，但 decode 并不会自动变快，因为 recurrent state 的读写、更新和 kernel 调度仍是瓶颈。SpecLA 给出了一套面向有状态线性注意力目标模型的 speculative decoding 运行时，说明新架构要进入真实 serving，需要重新设计验证、接受和 draft 策略，而不是复用 Transformer 的 KV-cache 方案。
summary.technical_approach: SpecLA 保留 draft-verify-accept 的外部流程，但把内部机制改成适配 recurrent state。第一，topology-aware verification：把 draft 提交的链或树结构作为 target kernel 的调度信息。链式候选可以在层内保持 recurrent state tile 驻留在 SRAM，减少逐 token 状态往返；树形候选用 parent-pointer 表示祖先依赖，对 Gated DeltaNet 这类层使用 tree-masked factorized 路径或 chain-decomposed hybrid 路径，在满足依赖的同时并行验证可并行分支。第二，accepted-factor state management：验证阶段会产生可重建状态更新的紧凑 layer-specific factors，系统缓存这些 factor，而不是保存完整 dense state 快照或只记录 token。posterior acceptance 后只 gather 被接受路径，并把状态提交延迟到下一次 verification kernel 内完成，避免额外状态更新 kernel。第三，target-aligned drafting：draft 端不只是给出候选 token，还要按 target 侧验证成本做调度。系统用 confidence-guided pruning 剪掉低概率分支，并采用类似 EAGLE 的 drafter，利用 recurrent target feature 训练，使候选分数更贴近目标模型动态。
summary.experiments: 实现基于 PyTorch 和 Triton，在 NVIDIA H100 上评测，目标模型是公开的 GDN-1.3B。端到端相对自回归解码，在 mixed suite、GSM8K、HumanEval 上分别达到 1.42 倍、1.70 倍、1.06 倍加速。HumanEval 收益较小，说明代码生成这类分布下 draft 接受率或 topology 成本可能更不利。微基准显示，chain-decomposed hybrid verification 相对 root-to-leaf replay 提升 1.80–7.11 倍；factor-buffer reuse 将 accepted-state recovery latency 降低 2.74–4.28 倍；delayed state update 将 commit-boundary latency 降低 1.15–1.44 倍。这些数字说明主要收益来自减少 recurrent state 往返和避免接受阶段的完整状态恢复。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 30–40 分钟泛读。先看 Introduction 中两个失败迁移路径：decode-kernel replay 和 prefill-kernel reuse，这能帮助判断为什么 Transformer speculative decoding 不能直接套到线性注意力模型上。然后重点看 Section 4 的 topology-aware verification 和 Section 5 的 accepted-factor state management，这是技术核心。Section 6 可快速看 draft pruning 与 EAGLE-style feature alignment。实验部分优先看端到端加速和三组 microbenchmark；如果关心 serving 落地，还应检查 batch size、draft length、树宽、接受率、kernel launch 数量和不同序列长度下的曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets speculative decoding for stateful linear-attention models, where generation still requires per-token recurrent-state reads, updates, and writes, while existing speculative systems assume Transformer-style KV-cache suffixes.
summary_en.importance: The main lesson for foundation-model research is that serving constraints can change the value proposition of new sequence architectures. Linear attention reduces the growing KV cache, but decoding remains limited by dense recurrent-state movement and kernel overhead. SpecLA shows that speculative decoding for such models requires new verification and state-management mechanisms, not a direct port of Transformer KV-cache speculation. This matters when evaluating whether linear-attention or hybrid models are practical alternatives for large-scale deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpecLA keeps the standard draft-verify-accept loop but replaces KV-cache suffix operations with mechanisms designed for recurrent states. First, topology-aware verification uses the submitted draft topology as the target-kernel schedule. Chain proposals keep tiled recurrent-state slices resident on chip, while tree proposals preserve ancestor-only dependencies through parent-pointer topologies and either tree-masked factorized GDN execution or chain-decomposed hybrid execution. Second, accepted-factor state management avoids full dense-state snapshots. The verifier already produces compact layer-specific factors sufficient to reconstruct state updates, so SpecLA buffers these factors, gathers only the accepted path after posterior selection, and applies the pending update inside the next verification kernel instead of launching a separate state-update pass. Third, target-aligned drafting treats proposal generation as cost-aware scheduling. Confidence pruning removes low-value branches before target verification, and an EAGLE-style drafter trained on recurrent target features makes proposal scores better aligned with the target model’s dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The system is implemented in PyTorch and Triton and evaluated on an NVIDIA H100 with a public GDN-1.3B target model. End-to-end speedups over autoregressive decoding are 1.42x on a mixed suite, 1.70x on GSM8K, and 1.06x on HumanEval. The smaller HumanEval gain suggests that code-generation workloads may have lower acceptance, less favorable proposal structure, or higher verification overhead. Microbenchmarks show that chain-decomposed hybrid verification is 1.80–7.11x faster than root-to-leaf replay, factor-buffer reuse reduces accepted-state recovery latency by 2.74–4.28x, and delayed state updates reduce commit-boundary latency by 1.15–1.44x. The gains mainly come from avoiding repeated recurrent-state round trips and removing extra accepted-state recovery passes.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the introduction’s two failed adaptations, decode-kernel replay and prefill-kernel reuse, because they clarify why Transformer speculative decoding does not transfer cleanly. Then read Section 4 on topology-aware verification and Section 5 on accepted-factor state management; these are the core system ideas. Section 6 can be skimmed for confidence pruning and EAGLE-style feature alignment. In the evaluation, focus on end-to-end speedups and the three microbenchmarks. For deployment relevance, check batch size, draft length, tree width, acceptance rate, kernel-launch behavior, and sequence-length sensitivity if those details are available.

recommendation.zh: 如果你还在怀疑线性注意力能否进入真实 serving，这篇该看；重点盯 verification kernel 和 accepted-state recovery，速度数字次之。
recommendation.en: If you still doubt whether linear attention can survive real serving, read this; focus on the verification kernel and accepted-state recovery design more than the headline speedups.

paper.title: Lossless but Not Free: An Empirical Anatomy of Speculative Decoding on Consumer Hardware
paper.abstract: Single-stream autoregressive decoding of large language models is bound by memory bandwidth: each generated token requires one full forward pass through the target model, and successive passes cannot be parallelized. Speculative decoding restructures this computation: a small draft model proposes $K$ tokens autoregressively, the target model scores all of them in one batched pass, and a rejection-sampling rule provably preserves the target model's output distribution. We present a from-scratch,

summary.core_problem: 评估 speculative decoding 在消费级硬件上是否真正带来端到端加速，以及分布无损性在实际实现中如何验证。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率工程实证。它不是新算法，但对 serving 和本地部署有参考价值，尤其提醒 speculative decoding 的理论无损不等于免费加速。
summary.technical_approach: 从零实现 device-agnostic speculative decoding，支持 CUDA、MPS 和 CPU。小 draft model 自回归提出 K 个 token，target model 一次 batched pass 验证，并用 rejection sampling 保持 target 分布不变。论文在多个 draft/target/backend 配置下测量接受率、wall-clock speedup 和分布一致性。
summary.experiments: 在消费级 Apple-silicon 笔记本上测试 5 种 draft/target 后端配置。分布等价性通过三层验证，包括约 9,200 个真实模型 token 的 two-sample test，χ²=162.5、dof=200、p=0.976，以及 greedy sequence exact agreement。最佳配置在 K=6 达到 1.61× wall-clock speedup，接受率从 69.7% 开始随位置下降。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether speculative decoding actually delivers end-to-end speedups on consumer hardware, and how to verify its lossless distributional property in practice.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency engineering study rather than a new decoding algorithm. Its useful contribution is an empirical reminder that distribution-preserving speculative decoding does not automatically translate into large wall-clock gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author implements device-agnostic speculative decoding from scratch across CUDA, MPS, and CPU. A small draft model proposes K autoregressive tokens, the target model verifies them in one batched pass, and rejection sampling preserves the target model distribution. The study measures acceptance profiles, wall-clock speed, and distribution equivalence across draft/target/backend configurations.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover five draft/target backend configurations on a consumer Apple-silicon laptop. Distributional equivalence is checked at three levels, including a two-sample test over about 9,200 real-model tokens with χ²=162.5, dof=200, p=0.976, plus exact greedy-sequence agreement. The best setup reaches a 1.61× wall-clock speedup at K=6, with acceptance starting at 69.7% and declining across positions.

recommendation.zh: 没有新算法，但实测很接地气；只看 acceptance 曲线和后端对比，别把 1.6× 当通用结论。
recommendation.en: No new algorithm, but the measurements are grounded; read the acceptance and backend tables, not the 1.6× number as a universal claim.

paper.title: WAR: Workload-Aware Rollouts for Synchronous Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Long-horizon rollout generation has become the dominant systems bottleneck in agentic reinforcement learning (RL). As agents interact with environments over many turns, trajectories rapidly grow to tens of thousands of tokens, making synchronous RL training increasingly constrained by rollout. We propose WAR, a workload-aware rollout system that substantially accelerates synchronous agentic RL by jointly optimizing decoding and scheduling. WAR is built on a key observation: the optimal rollout o

summary.core_problem: 同步智能体强化学习中长视野rollout生成成为系统瓶颈，现有推测解码方法需要额外草稿模型易产生GPU资源争抢。
summary.importance: 系统创新，针对agent RL训练的rollout瓶颈提出负载感知的联合解码与调度方案，无需额外草稿模型即可实现低负载下的解码加速。
summary.technical_approach: 提出WAR负载感知rollout系统，根据运行时负载动态切换优化策略：低负载下采用无模型SuffixDecoding，复用已完成轨迹的后缀模式作为推测草稿，无需额外draft模型避免GPU争抢；高负载下的优化策略在摘要中截断未完全披露。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型规模、基线对比、加速比等量化实验结果，仅给出了核心设计思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon rollout generation has become the dominant bottleneck for synchronous agentic RL, while existing speculative decoding methods require extra draft models that cause GPU contention.
summary_en.importance: Systems innovation that proposes a workload-aware joint decoding and scheduling solution for agent RL rollout bottlenecks, enabling decoding acceleration under low load without additional draft models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes WAR, a workload-aware rollout system that switches strategies dynamically by runtime load: under low load, it uses model-free SuffixDecoding that reuses suffix patterns from completed trajectories as speculative drafts, avoiding GPU contention from extra draft models; the high-load strategy is truncated in the abstract.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose quantitative results including model sizes, baselines, or speedup ratios, only presenting core design ideas.

recommendation.zh: Agent RL训练rollout加速的工程trick，无新范式，做RL训练系统的可以扫一眼后缀复用思路，其他人跳过。
recommendation.en: An engineering trick for agent RL rollout acceleration with no paradigm novelty; skim the suffix reuse idea if you work on RL training infra, otherwise skip.

paper.title: D-cut: Adaptive Verification Depth Pruning for Batched Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference without compromising output quality. Recent parallel drafting methods further improve single-request performance by decoupling draft length from drafting latency, enabling longer drafts and higher mean accepted tokens (MAT). However, under high request concurrency, long drafts waste substantial computation on rejected tokens, increasing verification cost and potentially making speculative decoding slower than autoregressive de

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 batched speculative decoding 在高并发下会失效的问题。长 draft 在低并发时通常有利，因为一次 verify 可以吞下更多候选 token；但并发升高后，verify 端从 memory-bound 逐渐转成 compute-bound，系统开始为大量最终会被拒绝的 draft token 付出真实算力。论文抓住的关键矛盾不是“draft 不够长”，而是“长 draft 的利用率在 batch 内高度不均匀，却仍被强制按统一深度验证”。结果是：某些请求只值得验证前几步，另一些请求却可以安全吃到更深位置，但现有方法把它们一视同仁，导致验证预算被低价值 token 吞掉，甚至让 speculative decoding 在大 batch 下落到低于 AR baseline。
summary.importance: 对基座研究员而言，这不是训练范式创新，而是 serving 侧一个很实在的系统问题：并行 draft 技术把单请求速度做上去之后，新的瓶颈转移到了批量验证的算力浪费。论文的贡献在于把 speculative decoding 的优化目标从“尽量拉长 draft”改成“在给定 runtime 条件下分配验证预算”。这个视角有启发性，因为它说明 speculative decoding 的最优策略不是静态的，也不是只由 acceptance rate 决定，而是由 acceptance 分布、batch 规模、模型结构、GPU 类型和并行实现共同决定。对 dense 与 MoE 模型都成立，尤其对 verify 成本结构更复杂的部署环境更有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 D-cut，核心是训练无关的自适应深度裁剪。它包含两个机制。

第一是 cross-request pruning。作者观察到 acceptance length 在请求之间和时间步之间都有很大方差，而且 drafter 的 token-level confidence 与是否会被接受存在可利用的相关性。于是他们不再要求 batch 内每个请求都验证同样深度，而是把整个 batch 的所有 draft 位置看成共享预算池：先为每个请求生成长度为 D 的 draft，再依据 drafter 置信度对所有候选位置做全局排序，只保留更可能被接受的 token 进入 verify。直观上，这是把预算从“低置信度请求的长尾后缀”转移到“高置信度请求的更深 continuation”。这样做并不改变 target model 的接受规则，因此仍保持 lossless 输出分布；变化的只是哪些位置被送去验证。

第二是 runtime-adaptive depth selection。作者没有把裁剪深度写成固定超参，而是显式建模“多验证一个 token 到底要多贵”。这个代价依赖部署环境：dense/MoE 架构不同，张量并行和批处理策略不同，GPU 也不同。论文在启动时做 profile，估计不同验证深度下的实际 step latency，然后把这个 runtime-specific cost 放进选择目标里，求一个更合适的保留深度。换句话说，D-cut 不是单纯最大化 expected accepted tokens，而是在 accepted tokens 增益和 verify latency 增量之间做权衡。

从方法形态看，它更像是 speculative decoding 上的一层 scheduler，而不是新 drafter。它不改 target model，不要求额外训练，也不依赖特定 drafter 架构；论文主要结合 block-parallel drafter 场景展开，因为这类方法最容易出现“draft 很长但 verify 浪费更大”的问题。与固定 depth、per-request 独立裁剪相比，D-cut 的区别在于它允许 batch 内非均匀深度，并把决策目标直接对齐到真实 runtime，而不是离线 acceptance 统计。
summary.experiments:
实验重点不是离线 acceptance 指标，而是端到端吞吐与不同 batch 下相对 AR 的真实加速。论文在 dense 和 MoE 模型上都做了评测，并覆盖不同并发规模。文中给出的代表性现象是：以 Qwen3-8B 配合 DFlash、draft length D=15 为例，平均 acceptance length 只有约 6，意味着约 60% 被验证的 draft token 最终会被拒绝；在 bs=64 时，vanilla DFlash 的吞吐已经可能低于标准 AR。D-cut 的作用就是在这种高并发区间把 speculative decoding 拉回到有效区。

结果层面，作者报告 D-cut 能在 dense 配置上恢复高并发下的加速收益，在原本会跌破 AR baseline 的区域重新取得正加速；在 MoE 模型上最高达到约 3.0× 相对 AR 的 speedup。论文还展示了几个支撑性实验：一是 acceptance length 在不同请求之间确实高度离散，说明统一验证深度不合理；二是 drafter confidence 对 acceptance 有可分性，支持用其做 pruning signal；三是不同 benchmark 的 acceptance 形态不同，例如 Math500、MBPP 更常出现长 acceptance，而 MT-Bench 更偏短前缀，这也解释了为什么固定深度策略在不同工作负载上表现不稳。

消融上，值得注意的点通常有三类：只做 confidence pruning 但不做 runtime adaptation，会在某些硬件/并行配置下选错深度；只做 per-request 裁剪而不做 cross-request 全局预算分配，收益明显更弱；继续盲目增大 draft length，在高并发下未必带来更高吞吐，反而可能因 verify 代价上升而恶化。论文的实验叙事比较完整，核心结论是 speculative decoding 的收益曲线随 batch 变化并非单调，系统最优点需要在线适配。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Introduction 和 Motivation，抓住两个事实：一是高并发时 verify 成本结构变了，二是 acceptance 在 batch 内高度不均。然后重点看方法部分里 cross-request pruning 的形式化定义，以及 runtime profiling 如何进入目标函数。这里决定了 D-cut 不是简单 heuristic，而是面向真实延迟的预算分配。

实验部分建议优先看三类图表：吞吐/加速比随 batch size 变化的曲线；confidence 与 acceptance 的相关性分析；不同任务负载下 acceptance length 分布。前者回答“有没有用”，后两者回答“为什么有用”。如果时间有限，30-40 分钟足够把主要思想和适用边界看清。更值得深挖的点有两个：其一，confidence 作为 acceptance proxy 的稳健性，在不同 drafter 和温度设置下是否稳定；其二，runtime cost model 是否可以进一步做成在线闭环，而不只是启动时 profile 一次。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a failure mode of batched speculative decoding under high concurrency. Long drafts help at low concurrency because many candidate tokens can be verified in one target-model pass. But as batch size grows, verification shifts from being mostly memory-bound to meaningfully compute-bound, so rejected draft tokens are no longer cheap. The key mismatch is that current systems often verify the same draft depth for every request in the batch, even though acceptance lengths vary widely across requests and across decoding steps. This makes the system spend substantial verification budget on low-value suffix tokens and can even push speculative decoding below the autoregressive baseline at large batch sizes.
summary_en.importance: This is a serving-side paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant because it reframes the optimization target of speculative decoding. The message is not simply “make the drafter longer” or “increase acceptance rate.” The useful objective is to allocate verification compute under actual runtime constraints. That depends jointly on acceptance distribution, batch size, model architecture, GPU characteristics, and parallelization strategy. The paper is a good reminder that once draft generation becomes cheap through block-parallel methods, verification becomes the dominant systems problem. That perspective matters for dense and MoE deployment alike.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, D-cut, is a training-free adaptive depth pruning layer on top of speculative decoding. It has two main components.

First, cross-request pruning removes the uniform-depth constraint. The authors observe large variance in accepted lengths across requests and show that drafter confidence is informative about whether a token will be accepted. Instead of verifying depth D for every request, D-cut treats all draft positions in the batch as a shared verification budget. It globally ranks candidate draft tokens using confidence and keeps the positions that are more likely to survive verification. In effect, it shifts budget away from low-confidence suffixes of weak requests toward deeper continuations of stronger requests. Because the target model still performs the same acceptance test on the retained positions, the output distribution remains lossless.

Second, runtime-adaptive depth selection explicitly models the cost of verifying extra tokens. That cost is deployment-specific: it depends on dense vs. MoE architecture, the parallelism scheme, and the GPU/runtime stack. D-cut profiles verification latency at startup and incorporates this measured cost into the selection objective. So the method is not maximizing expected accepted tokens alone; it is trading off accepted-token gain against incremental verification latency under the current runtime.

Conceptually, D-cut is a scheduler rather than a new drafter. It does not modify the target model, does not require training, and is compatible with existing speculative pipelines. The paper focuses on block-parallel drafters because they make long drafts cheap to produce, which amplifies the waste on the verification side. Compared with fixed-depth verification or per-request local pruning, the distinctive idea is batch-level non-uniform depth allocation guided by both confidence and measured runtime cost.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments focus on end-to-end throughput and speedup relative to autoregressive decoding across batch sizes, not just offline acceptance metrics. The paper evaluates both dense and MoE models under varying concurrency. A representative result highlighted in the paper is that with Qwen3-8B plus DFlash at draft length D=15, the mean accepted length is only about 6, implying that roughly 60% of verified draft tokens are rejected. At batch size 64, vanilla DFlash can already fall below standard AR throughput. D-cut is designed precisely for this regime.

Empirically, D-cut recovers positive acceleration in dense settings where vanilla speculative decoding becomes worse than AR at high concurrency. On MoE models, the reported peak speedup reaches about 3.0× over AR. The supporting analyses are also important: accepted lengths are highly dispersed across requests, drafter confidence has predictive value for acceptance, and the acceptance profile differs by workload. For example, Math500 and MBPP tend to exhibit more long accepted continuations, while MT-Bench is dominated by short accepted prefixes, which explains why a fixed verification depth is unstable across workloads.

The ablations suggest three practical lessons. Confidence-based pruning without runtime adaptation can choose the wrong depth under some hardware/runtime configurations. Per-request pruning without cross-request global allocation leaves noticeable gains on the table. And simply increasing draft length does not guarantee higher throughput at high concurrency, because verification cost can dominate. The main experimental takeaway is that speculative decoding speedup is not monotonic in batch size, and the best operating point must be adapted to the runtime.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and motivation. The two facts to lock in are: verification becomes expensive at high concurrency, and accepted lengths are highly uneven within a batch. Then read the method section carefully, especially the formalization of cross-request pruning and how runtime profiling enters the objective. That is where the paper moves beyond a heuristic and becomes a latency-aware budget allocation method.

In the experiments, prioritize three figure types: throughput or speedup versus batch size, confidence-versus-acceptance analysis, and accepted-length distributions across tasks. The first tells you whether the method works, and the latter two explain why. A 30-40 minute skim is enough to extract the main idea and deployment boundary conditions. If you want to go deeper, two questions are worth following up: how robust confidence is as an acceptance proxy across drafters and decoding temperatures, and whether the runtime cost model could be turned into a closed-loop online controller rather than a one-time startup profile.

recommendation.zh: 这是 serving 侧很实在的一刀：别再盯单请求 MAT，直接看高并发下验证预算怎么分；读方法和吞吐曲线就够了。
recommendation.en: A useful serving-side correction: stop optimizing single-request MAT in isolation and look at verification-budget allocation under concurrency.

paper.title: Efficient and Privacy Aware Edge Cloud Collaborative Inference for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: On-device LLM inference faces a trilemma of response latency, limited hardware resources and user privacy. Full cloud inference delivers strong computing power but exposes user prompts and dialogue data, while standalone on-device inference is unfeasible for most consumer and embedded edge devices. This paper presents a privacy-centric edge-cloud collaborative LLM inference framework built on endpoint-authenticated KV cache. Local endpoints handle input preprocessing, embedding computation, adap

summary.core_problem: 解决端侧 LLM 推理在延迟、算力受限与隐私保护之间的三难问题，尝试在边缘与云之间拆分推理路径。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏系统工程：把 KV cache、speculative decoding、量化传输和加密结合到 edge-cloud 协同推理中。对预训练本身帮助有限，但对推理系统、隐私约束部署和模型切分有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方案在本地端执行输入预处理、embedding、特征优化、KV cache 认证、speculative decoding 和低维 head 计算；云端负责认证后的 decoder 推理、KV cache 管理、token 验证和高维词表投影。传输数据与截断 logits 做量化并用 AES-GCM 加密，核心是 endpoint-authenticated KV cache 的协同推理框架。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型规模、硬件配置、吞吐/时延数字，也未说明与纯云端、纯端侧或已有 split inference baseline 的系统性比较。现阶段更像设计提案，证据强度有限。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the latency-resource-privacy trade-off in on-device LLM inference by splitting inference between edge devices and the cloud.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is primarily systems-oriented: it combines KV-cache handling, speculative decoding, quantized transmission, and encryption in an edge-cloud collaborative setup. It is only indirectly relevant to pretraining researchers, but may inform deployment under privacy constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The endpoint handles preprocessing, embeddings, adaptive feature optimization, KV-cache authentication, speculative decoding, and a low-dimensional head, while the cloud performs authenticated decoder inference, cache management, token verification, and full-vocabulary projection. Data and truncated logits are quantized and encrypted with AES-GCM, centered around an endpoint-authenticated KV-cache design.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, hardware details, latency/throughput numbers, or clean comparisons against cloud-only, device-only, or prior split-inference baselines. At this stage, it reads more like a system design than a well-validated empirical study.

recommendation.zh: 只在你关心隐私约束下的 split inference 时值得扫一眼；摘要里系统点子不少，但没有干净数字前先别改 prior。
recommendation.en: Only skim if privacy-constrained split inference matters to you; there are some system ideas here, but without clean numbers it should not update your priors.

paper.title: Less Experts, Faster Decoding: Cost-Aware Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become an important approach for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs), but their inference efficiency depends strongly on expert activation patterns. Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive generation by verifying multiple draft tokens in parallel, yet existing draft selection strategies primarily optimize acceptance likelihood. In large-scale MoE models, however, selecting draft tokens also determines the union of experts activated during

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE 模型中 speculative decoding 只追求草稿 token 接受率、却忽略专家权重访存成本的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与 MoE 成本建模。它指出 MoE 推理的瓶颈不只是 token 数和接受率，还取决于验证阶段被草稿树触发的专家集合大小；这个观察对 MoE serving、路由设计和推测解码策略都有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 EcoSpec，在 draft-tree 选择时加入预测的边际专家激活成本。相较于只按 token 概率或接受概率扩展草稿，它把候选 token 会引入的新专家权重访存纳入目标函数，从而减少 expert scattering，即高概率候选路由到互不重叠专家导致的访存扩散。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明实验围绕大规模 MoE 推理中的 speculative decoding 展开，对比现有以接受率为中心的草稿选择策略。给定信息未提供具体 MoE 模型、参数量、专家数、硬件配置、吞吐提升或延迟下降幅度，因此需要读正文确认收益是否来自真实 serving 瓶颈而非简化成本模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses speculative decoding for MoE models when draft-token selection ignores expert-weight memory cost.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems and MoE cost-modeling contribution. It argues that MoE speculative decoding is governed not only by acceptance rate and token count, but also by the union of experts activated during verification, which directly affects serving efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: EcoSpec augments draft-tree selection with predicted marginal expert activation cost. Instead of expanding candidates purely by probability or expected acceptance, it penalizes tokens that introduce additional expert-weight memory traffic, reducing expert scattering across draft candidates.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare cost-aware speculative decoding against acceptance-centered draft selection for large MoE inference. The supplied abstract does not give the exact MoE models, parameter counts, expert counts, hardware setup, throughput gains, or latency reductions, so the main paper is needed to judge how much of the gain holds under real serving conditions.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 expert-scattering 的测量和成本模型；若复现成立，MoE 推测解码不能再只优化接受率。
recommendation.en: Read the expert-scattering measurements and cost model; if they reproduce, MoE speculative decoding should not optimize acceptance rate alone.

paper.title: Accepted Prefixes Are Not All You Need: A Negative Result on PEFT-Based Block-Diffusion Drafting
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language model inference by using a cheap drafter to propose multiple future tokens and a target model to verify them. A common design goal is therefore to improve draft quality while reducing auxiliary parameters and systems overhead. We study a negative result for this direction through PEFT-BD, a same-backbone speculative decoding method in which a LoRA-like adapter acts as a block-diffusion drafter for an autoregressive verifier. PEFT-BD is mot

summary.core_problem: 能否用“同一 backbone + 少量 PEFT 参数”的 block-diffusion drafter，在 speculative decoding 中实现真实可用的端到端加速。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是负结果/工程剖析：指出“accepted prefixes 不等于速度提升”，把 speculative decoding 的瓶颈从算法层拉回到系统与算子成本层，对后续设计 drafter 形态很有约束力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出/评估 PEFT-BD：在目标 AR 模型上挂 LoRA 类 adapter 作为 drafter，用类似 BD3LM 的去噪目标并行提议一段 token block，由原模型 verifier 接受/拒绝；优势是无 tokenizer mismatch、无需加载独立 draft 模型、参数增量小。通过 profiling 发现每步 speculative 仍需“adapter-enabled 的全 backbone draft pass”，导致吞吐收益被计算开销抵消。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-0.6B 上实验；方法能产生非平凡 accepted prefixes，但整体不产生实用加速；结论主要来自端到端 profiling（摘要未给出具体加速比/接受率数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether a same-backbone, PEFT-parameter-only block-diffusion drafter can deliver practical end-to-end speedups for speculative decoding.
summary_en.importance: A negative result with profiling: shows that accepted prefixes are not sufficient for real speedups, constraining future drafter designs by highlighting system/compute overhead.
summary_en.technical_approach: Evaluates PEFT-BD: attach a LoRA-like adapter as a block-diffusion drafter on the same AR backbone, trained with a BD3LM-style denoising objective to propose token blocks in parallel, verified by the AR model. Despite avoiding tokenizer mismatch and a separate draft model, profiling shows each speculative step still requires an adapter-enabled full-backbone draft pass, wiping out throughput gains.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on Qwen3-0.6B; achieves nontrivial accepted prefixes but no practical speedup; conclusions rely on end-to-end profiling (no exact speedup/acceptance numbers in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 这是“别被接受率骗了”的硬核负结果：重点看 profiling 结论，drafter 复用 backbone 基本注定算不过账。
recommendation.en: A useful “acceptance rate isn’t speed” negative result—read the profiling; same-backbone drafters tend to lose on compute economics.

paper.title: Unlocking Parallelism in Autoregressive Language Models via Speculative Decoding with Progressive Tree Drafting
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding has significantly accelerated Large Language Model (LLM) inference by alleviating memory-bound bottlenecks. However, traditional speculative decoding typically relies on auxiliary draft modules, incurring significant training and communication overhead. Although recent methods attempt to generate drafts within the target model itself, they often fail to fully exploit its latent parallel capacity due to a lack of structural coordination. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Prog

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是训练外、模型内 speculative decoding 的一个具体瓶颈：目标模型虽然有并行计算能力，但现有 endogenous drafting 方法大多让模型独立地产生多条线性候选，结果是不同分支高度相似，重复消耗 attention 和 KV 计算，接受率也不稳定。论文想解决的不是“能不能做自草稿”，而是“如何用结构化方式把 AR 模型潜在的并行能力真正转成可验证、可接受、可带来端到端加速的 draft”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，更偏推理侧系统优化，所以是 skim 而不是 must-read。但它有两点对基座研究仍有启发。第一，它把 AR Transformer 的并行潜力重新表述为“通过输入组织和 attention mask 改写计算图”，这对理解 AR 模型在非标准生成范式下还能做什么有参考价值。第二，它指出 draft 质量不只是 token-level 准确率问题，还和候选之间的结构冗余有关；这个观察对 speculative decoding、any-order generation、甚至训练时的多路径监督设计都有借鉴意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Progressive Tree Drafting, PTD。它不再把 draft 组织成若干彼此独立的线性序列，而是组织成一棵共享前缀的树。这样做有两个直接目的。其一，公共前缀只算一次，减少重复计算；其二，树结构天然要求分支在更靠后的层级才分化，能把并行预算更多用在真正不同的语义路径上。

具体机制分三部分。第一是 tree construction。作者先用若干 seed nodes 初始化 drafting tree，这些 seed 可以来自随机采样或上下文语义启发。树中每个节点只能 attend 到自己的祖先节点，借此保证每条路径仍符合 AR 因果约束；位置编码则按祖先链长度分配，使树输入仍兼容标准 Transformer。

第二是 progressive evolution。PTD 不是一次性把整棵树铺开，而是逐步扩展。每一轮 forward pass 后，根据当前节点的预测结果扩展候选子节点，再结合 stepwise pruning 删除低价值或高冗余分支。论文的动机很明确：如果一开始就无约束扩展，树会迅速膨胀，验证成本和冗余都会上升；逐步演化则允许模型先形成粗粒度语义分叉，再把算力集中到更有希望的路径。

第三是 draft extraction and verification。树中多条 root-to-leaf 路径会被抽取为候选 continuation，再交给标准 speculative verification 过程并行验证。与 Self-Draft 这类通过输入扰动生成多分支的方法相比，PTD 的区别不在于“多生成几条”，而在于显式利用 prefix sharing 和 pruning 去协调分支间关系。与 LADE 这类并行预测线性未来 token 的方法相比，PTD 更像在语义空间里做受约束搜索，而不是在固定线性位置上做 Jacobi 式迭代。
summary.experiments:
从正文可确认的主结果是：PTD 在多个基准上都能稳定带来最高约 2× 的解码加速，而且不需要额外 draft model，也不需要额外训练。论文前面给出的诊断分析显示，Self-Draft 中超过一半 decoding steps 存在分支相似度超过 80% 的情况，这构成了 PTD 的主要经验动机。

实验重点应当包括三类。第一，端到端 speedup，对比 vanilla decoding、外部 draft speculative decoding、LADE、Self-Draft 等训练外方法。第二，acceptance rate 与 draft diversity 的关系，证明树结构和 pruning 不是只减少计算，而是确实提高了有效候选比例。第三，结构消融，例如是否使用 progressive update、是否使用 pruning、不同树宽/树深设置、不同 seed 策略对速度和质量的影响。

受限于给出的全文片段，无法可靠提取完整的模型规模、数据集名称、每个 benchmark 的精确数字和全部消融表格，因此不应编造。可以确定的是，作者把“最高约 2× speedup”作为主结论，并把高相似度冗余作为关键实证发现。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 里对 Self-Draft 冗余的诊断，尤其是 Figure 2 右图。这一部分决定了方法是否有必要。然后看 Method 里的 tree construction、progressive update、stepwise pruning 三段，重点理解两个约束：节点只看祖先，以及为什么要逐步剪枝而不是一次性展开。最后看主实验里的 speedup、acceptance rate、diversity 指标和消融。

如果时间有限，建议 20 到 30 分钟读法：先读 Figure 2 和 Figure 3，再读方法定义和主表。真正值得想一层的是，这种 tree-structured drafting 是否只是工程技巧，还是说明 AR Transformer 在 attention mask 重新布线后可以承担更一般的并行搜索角色。这个问题比论文表面的推理加速更有研究味道。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in training-free, endogenous speculative decoding. Recent methods can draft candidates using the target AR model itself, but they usually generate multiple linear branches independently. In practice, many of those branches are semantically near-duplicates, so the model spends parallel compute on redundant candidates and gains limited acceptance-rate improvement. The real question here is not whether self-drafting is possible, but how to organize the model’s latent parallel capacity into diverse, coherent, and verifiable drafts.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, so it fits skim. Still, it has two useful implications for foundation-model researchers. First, it reframes AR Transformer parallelism as something that can be exposed by restructuring inputs and attention masks, which is relevant to broader non-standard generation paradigms. Second, it shows that draft quality is not only about token accuracy; structural redundancy among candidates matters. That observation may carry over to speculative decoding, any-order generation, and even multi-path supervision during training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is Progressive Tree Drafting (PTD). Instead of representing drafts as several independent linear continuations, PTD organizes them as a prefix-sharing tree. This serves two purposes: shared prefixes are computed once rather than repeatedly, and branching is coordinated so parallel budget is spent on genuinely different semantic paths rather than near-identical continuations.

The method has three main components. First, tree construction. PTD initializes a drafting tree with seed nodes, obtained either stochastically or from context-aware semantic cues. Each node is only allowed to attend to its ancestors, preserving autoregressive causality along every root-to-node path. Positional encoding is assigned according to ancestor-chain length so the tree input remains compatible with a standard Transformer.

Second, progressive evolution. PTD does not expand the full tree in one shot. It grows the tree step by step: after each forward pass, candidate children are proposed, and a stepwise pruning rule removes low-value or highly redundant branches. This design is important. Unconstrained expansion would quickly inflate the tree and verification cost; progressive growth lets the model first establish coarse semantic alternatives and then allocate compute to the most promising paths.

Third, draft extraction and verification. Multiple root-to-leaf paths are extracted as candidate continuations and then verified with a standard speculative-decoding acceptance procedure. Compared with Self-Draft, which obtains multiple branches through input perturbations, PTD explicitly coordinates branch relationships through prefix sharing and pruning. Compared with LADE-style parallel future-token prediction, PTD is closer to constrained semantic search than to Jacobi-style linear refinement.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text content, the main confirmed result is that PTD consistently achieves up to about 2× decoding speedup across several benchmarks, without auxiliary draft models and without extra training. The motivating analysis in the paper shows that in Self-Draft, more than half of decoding steps contain branches with over 80% similarity, which is the empirical basis for the proposed tree formulation.

The experimental story appears to center on three aspects. First, end-to-end speedup against vanilla decoding and prior speculative baselines such as external-draft methods, LADE, and Self-Draft. Second, the relationship between acceptance rate and draft diversity, showing that the tree structure and pruning improve not only compute reuse but also the usefulness of candidates. Third, structural ablations: progressive update vs. one-shot expansion, pruning vs. no pruning, different tree widths/depths, and different seed strategies.

Because the supplied text is truncated, I cannot reliably extract all benchmark names, model sizes, or exact table values, and those should not be fabricated. The robust takeaway is the reported up-to-2× speedup and the redundancy diagnosis that motivates the method.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the Introduction and the redundancy analysis, especially Figure 2 on branch similarity in Self-Draft. That section tells you whether the method is solving a real bottleneck. Then read the Method section around tree construction, progressive update, and stepwise pruning. The two key ideas to track are: each node only attends to ancestors, and the tree is expanded progressively rather than fully materialized. Finally, inspect the main speedup table, acceptance-rate results, diversity analysis, and ablations.

A practical skim path is 20–30 minutes: Figure 2, Figure 3, the algorithm description, then the main results. The deeper question worth thinking about is whether tree-structured drafting is merely an engineering trick for decoding, or evidence that AR Transformers can act as more general parallel search engines once their attention graph is rewired.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和端到端延迟表；若加速不依赖小 batch 或短输出，值得放进内部 speculative decoding ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and end-to-end latency table; if the gain survives non-toy batch and length settings, it is worth an internal speculative-decoding ablation.

paper.title: TIGER: Text-Conditioned Visual Gated Routing with Acceptance Alignment for Multimodal Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by letting a lightweight drafter propose multiple tokens that are verified by a larger target model. Although effective for text-only LLMs, speculative decoding yields limited gains in VLMs because drafters often diverge on vision-critical content, while existing multimodal acceleration methods do not directly address irrelevant visual evidence or optimize the verifier-accepted prefix length that governs speedup. We propose TIGER, a Text

summary.core_problem: 多模态（尤其含高分辨率视觉 token）的 speculative decoding 很难获得文本 LLM 那样的加速：小 drafter 在“视觉关键 token”（OCR 字符串、计数/数值、指代与关系、 grounded 描述等）上更容易早早偏离大 verifier，导致 verifier 接受的前缀很短，速度收益被抵消。论文要解决的是：在不改变 verifier 分布（保持 lossless 验证）的前提下，如何让 drafter 在多模态场景生成更长的可接受块（accepted prefix），从而真正提升端到端吞吐。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练的直接影响有限，更偏推理侧系统与训练目标设计；但它给了两个对“训练—推理闭环”有用的启发：
1) 把训练目标从“拟合分布/蒸馏”转到“直接优化推理时的关键运行量”（accepted prefix length），属于典型的 post-train 信号反哺推理效率；这类思路可迁移到长上下文、工具调用、结构化输出等场景。
2) 多模态小模型的失败往往不是容量不足这么简单，而是“给了不该看的视觉证据”导致噪声与分歧；用文本状态条件化的视觉证据路由，提供了一种比固定压缩接口更细粒度的视觉 token 预算分配方式。
整体贡献量级：属于把 speculative decoding 真正落到 VLM 的工程化方法论文，价值在于目标函数与路由接口的组合，而不是提出新的预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两块组成，分别对应“看什么”和“怎么训”。

(1) Text-conditioned Visual Gated Routing（看什么）：
- 设 vision encoder 产生视觉 token bank V（r 个 token）。传统做法要么把全量 V 给 drafter（贵且噪声大），要么用固定压缩/适配器给一个静态接口（对不同解码阶段不够自适应）。
- TIGER 在每个 speculative round j，用 drafter 当前的文本状态（prefix embedding / decoder state）作为条件，对视觉 token 做稀疏选择，得到 V_j^{route} 作为 drafter 的视觉接口。直觉是：下一段要生成的 token 只需要与当前语义相关的一小部分视觉证据（例如当前在读图表某个区域、或 OCR 某行），其余 token 只会增加 drafter 的不确定性与与 verifier 的分歧。
- 这种“按解码阶段动态路由视觉 token”的设计，和固定的视觉压缩（例如固定数量的视觉 query）相比，核心差异是：预算分配随文本状态变化，且目标是减少 drafter/verifier 的分歧而非仅压缩计算。

(2) Acceptance Alignment（怎么训）：
- 论文指出：多模态 speculative decoding 的速度主要由 verifier 接受的前缀长度决定，但常规蒸馏/模仿学习优化的是 token-level 似然或 KL，对 accepted prefix 这个离散运行量并不敏感。
- 训练流程：先用知识蒸馏 warm-start drafter，保证基本行为稳定；再进入 acceptance-aligned 阶段：对同一输入采样多个 draft continuations，运行标准 speculative decoding 的 verifier acceptance test（保持“lossless”验证逻辑），把“被接受的前缀长度”作为奖励信号，做 group-based policy optimization（类似用 verifier 作为可计算的监督/奖励源，而非人类偏好或 learned RM）。
- 为了稳定：加入 KL anchoring 防止策略漂移（drafter 过度追求某些模式导致整体分布偏离，反而降低可接受性或质量）。

关键取舍：
- 不去改 verifier，也不牺牲正确性（仍用标准 acceptance test），把所有可控变量放在 drafter 的可见视觉证据与训练目标上。
- 相比“让 drafter 更大/更强”这种线性堆算力的方案，TIGER 试图用更好的信息接口 + 更贴近推理指标的训练信号来换 accepted prefix。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段只能确认实验覆盖“多类多模态基准（OCR-heavy、counting、grounded reasoning 等）”，并且报告了三类指标：
1) verifier-accepted prefix length 变长；
2) target-model decoding work 减少；
3) 端到端 speculative decoding speedup 提升，同时保持任务准确率。

但当前提供的内容未包含具体表格/数字（例如：drafter/verifier 参数规模、视觉 token 路由的稀疏率、平均接受长度提升多少、吞吐提升多少、各基准上的准确率差异与方差）。因此无法在不臆测的情况下给出精确提升幅度。

建议在精读时重点核对：
- speedup 的定义（是否包含路由开销、是否计入 vision encoder、是否按 wall-clock 还是按 verifier step）；
- acceptance length 的统计方式（平均/分位数、按 block γ 的归一化）；
- 与强基线的对比（全视觉 token drafter、固定压缩接口、仅蒸馏不做 acceptance alignment 等）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“VLM speculative decoding 为何不加速”的诊断：它把问题落在 vision-critical token 与 accepted prefix 上，这个 framing 决定了后续设计。
- Method 重点抓两处：
  1) 路由模块如何用文本状态选择视觉 token（选择机制、稀疏度/预算、是否可微、是否引入额外注意力层）。
  2) acceptance-aligned 训练的具体优化形式：奖励如何定义、group-based 更新怎么做、KL anchoring 的实现细节、采样与验证的计算开销。
- 实验部分优先看：accepted prefix length 与端到端吞吐的对应关系图/表；以及消融（仅路由/仅 alignment/两者叠加）。

如果你的关注点是 pretrain：把它当作“用可计算 verifier 信号做训练目标”的案例，思考能否把类似信号迁移到预训练/中期训练的课程或数据选择上；但不要期待它提供新的 scaling law 或数据配比结论。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal speculative decoding often fails to deliver meaningful speedups because a small drafter diverges early on vision-critical tokens (OCR strings, numbers, counting, grounded attributes/relations). Early divergence shortens the verifier-accepted prefix, which is the actual runtime driver of speculative decoding gains. The paper targets a lossless setup (standard verifier acceptance test) and asks how to make the drafter produce longer accepted blocks in VLM decoding.
summary_en.importance:
This is primarily an inference-time acceleration + training-objective paper rather than a pretraining contribution. Still, it offers two reusable ideas for foundation-model researchers:
1) Replace “distill to match logits” with an objective that directly optimizes the runtime quantity that matters (accepted prefix length). This is a concrete example of closing the train–inference loop using a computable verifier signal.
2) In VLMs, drafter/verifier mismatch is often driven by exposing the drafter to irrelevant/noisy visual evidence. Text-state-conditioned routing is a more adaptive alternative to fixed visual compression interfaces.
Overall impact is practical: making speculative decoding more viable for VLM serving without modifying the verifier distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TIGER combines (a) an adaptive visual interface for the drafter and (b) acceptance-aligned drafter training.

(a) Text-conditioned Visual Gated Routing:
- A vision encoder produces a visual token bank V (r tokens). Instead of feeding the full V to the drafter or using a fixed compressed adapter, TIGER selects a sparse subset V_j^{route} at each speculative round j.
- The selection is conditioned on the drafter’s current textual state (prefix embedding/decoder state), aiming to expose only the visual evidence needed for the next speculative block. The goal is not just compute reduction, but reducing drafter/verifier divergence on the upcoming tokens.

(b) Acceptance Alignment training:
- The paper argues that standard distillation optimizes imitation quality, while speculative decoding efficiency is governed by the verifier-accepted prefix length.
- Training pipeline: warm-start the drafter via knowledge distillation; then sample multiple draft continuations, run the standard verifier acceptance test, and use accepted prefix length as a reward signal for group-based policy optimization.
- KL anchoring is used to prevent policy drift and stabilize optimization.

Key design choice: keep the verifier and acceptance test unchanged (lossless), and move all adaptation into the drafter’s visual evidence budget and objective.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the evaluation spans diverse multimodal benchmarks (OCR-heavy, counting/numerical, grounded reasoning) and reports: longer accepted prefixes, reduced verifier decoding work, and higher end-to-end speedup while preserving task accuracy.

However, the excerpt does not include the concrete numbers/tables (model sizes, routed token budget, acceptance-length deltas, wall-clock speedups, accuracy changes). Without those sections, it’s not possible to quote exact gains reliably.

When checking the paper, validate: (i) how speedup is measured (wall-clock vs verifier steps; whether routing/vision encoding is included), (ii) acceptance-length statistics (mean vs tail), and (iii) ablations separating routing vs acceptance alignment.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the failure analysis: “vision-critical tokens” + “accepted prefix length” as the bottleneck.
- In Method, focus on (1) how routing selects visual tokens conditioned on text state (budget, sparsity, overhead), and (2) the exact acceptance-aligned optimization (reward definition, group-based update, KL anchoring, sampling/verification cost).
- In Experiments, prioritize the plots/tables linking accepted prefix length to end-to-end throughput, plus ablations (routing only vs alignment only vs both).

If your main interest is pretraining, treat this as a case study of using a verifier-derived, fully automatic signal to optimize a deployment metric, rather than as a new pretraining recipe.

recommendation.zh: 多模态 spec decode 一直缺干净做法，这篇把瓶颈明确落在 accepted prefix 和视觉 token 暴露方式上；先看路由设计和 acceptance reward，别急着信总加速数字。
recommendation.en: Multimodal speculative decoding has lacked a clean formulation; this paper usefully pins the bottleneck on accepted-prefix length and visual-token exposure. Read the routing design and acceptance reward first, but do not over-trust the headline speedups.

paper.title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting several tokens and verifying them in parallel. Block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash produce   a draft block in one pass but model only per-position marginals; best-first tree methods such as DDTree expand candidate trees from those marginals. The   released Domino drafter adds a GRU-based causal correction that makes each draft token's distribution path-dependent, a structure DDTree's factorized   formulation cannot represent. We intr

summary.core_problem: Domino 已经用 GRU 对 block-diffusion drafter 的边际 logits 做路径相关修正，但公开实现只沿一条 draft path 生成 token。DDTree/CaDDTree 可以构造 draft tree，却假设每个位置的分布相互独立，不能表达 Domino 的非因子化条件分布。DominoTree 解决的是：如何在不重新训练 drafter 的情况下，把 Domino 的路径相关条件打分用于 speculative decoding 的树状草稿构造。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身的直接影响有限，主要价值在推理效率。值得泛读的原因是它把“非自回归/块式草稿模型”和“树状验证”之间的分布假设讲得比较清楚。对基座研究员有两点启发：第一，block diffusion drafter 的质量瓶颈不只是并行生成能力，还在于 per-position marginal 与真实条件分布之间的错配；第二，轻量级因果校正可以在不重复全词表投影的前提下提升 draft acceptance，这对设计低成本辅助模型有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法沿用 DDTree 的 best-first heap 和 tree-attention verification，但替换节点打分函数。DDTree 使用因子化边际概率，节点分数只取决于深度位置；DominoTree 对每个 root-to-node path 重新运行 Domino 的 GRU correction，使候选 token 的分布依赖已经选择的前缀。为了控制开销，每个节点只在该深度 marginal top-M 候选集合上计算 GRU 修正，而不是对全词表重复计算。实现上还提供 CUDA graph 版本，把条件树构造放到 GPU-native 路径中，保证与 Python reference 在 T=0 时逐行一致。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上进行，温度覆盖 T=0、0.5、1.0。Qwen3-4B 在 T=0 时，DominoTree 平均达到 4.81× 相对 AR 解码加速，平均 accepted tokens 为 7.98，在测试的 DFlash、DDTree、CaDDTree、Domino 中 accepted length 最高。吞吐上，相比 Domino 的最佳 CUDA-graph 配置，DominoTree 在所有温度都有 Overall rollup 提升：Qwen3-4B 约 9–10%，Qwen3-8B 约 4–6%。相比 DDTree/CaDDTree，整体吞吐提升为 T=0 时 +7.67% [5.63, 9.80]，T=0.5 时 +5.18% [3.07, 7.29]，T=1.0 时 +2.55% [0.55, 4.59]。受控消融固定 drafter、节点预算和 verifier，只改 scoring function，条件打分相比 marginal scoring 带来 +9.2% [8.1, 10.3] 吞吐提升。代码类任务仍然是短板，表现输给 DDTree/CaDDTree。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 2.3–2.5，理解 Domino 的 partial-conditional 结构为什么破坏 DDTree/CaDDTree 的因子化假设；再看 Section 3 的节点打分和 top-M 限制，这是核心方法。Section 3.3 的 CUDA graph 实现适合关注 serving 的读者。Section 4.4 的 scoring ablation 最值得看，因为它把收益归因到路径条件化，而不是树构造本身。CondAdaptive 的负结果也有价值：路径累计 log-prob 会高估 acceptance，说明 drafter score 与 verifier acceptance 的校准仍然是 speculative decoding 的关键问题。

summary_en.core_problem: Domino adds a GRU-based causal correction on top of a block-diffusion drafter, but the released system only samples a single draft chain. DDTree and CaDDTree build draft trees, yet their scoring assumes factorized per-position marginals. DominoTree addresses the missing piece: how to build a speculative decoding tree using Domino’s path-dependent conditional scores without training a new drafter.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its useful signal for foundation-model researchers is the clean separation between marginal block proposals and conditional acceptance quality. It shows that the bottleneck of block-style drafters is not only parallel generation, but also the mismatch between per-position marginals and the realized draft path. The lightweight causal correction is also a useful design pattern for cheap auxiliary models: keep the expensive full-vocabulary projection parallel, then add a small sequential correction only where conditioning matters.
summary_en.technical_approach: DominoTree keeps DDTree’s best-first tree construction and tree-attention verification, but changes the node score. Instead of reading a factorized marginal score at each depth, it reruns Domino’s GRU correction along each candidate root-to-node path, so each token score depends on the tokens already chosen in that branch. To keep this affordable, the correction is restricted to the marginal top-M candidates at each node rather than the full vocabulary. The paper also implements a CUDA-graph version of the conditional tree builder and verifies that it is bit-identical to the Python reference at T=0.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B at T=0, 0.5, and 1.0. On Qwen3-4B at T=0, DominoTree reports 4.81× speedup over AR decoding and 7.98 accepted tokens on average, the highest accepted length among DFlash, DDTree, CaDDTree, and Domino in the reported setting. Against Domino’s best CUDA-graph configuration, the overall throughput gain is about 9–10% on Qwen3-4B and 4–6% on Qwen3-8B. Against DDTree/CaDDTree, the reported throughput gains are +7.67% [5.63, 9.80] at T=0, +5.18% [3.07, 7.29] at T=0.5, and +2.55% [0.55, 4.59] at T=1.0. A controlled scoring ablation shows +9.2% [8.1, 10.3] throughput from conditional scoring over marginal scoring. Code remains the workload family where DDTree/CaDDTree still win.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read Sections 2.3–2.5 for the structural mismatch between Domino’s partial-conditional logits and DDTree’s factorized formulation. Then read Section 3 for the conditional node scoring and the top-M restriction. Section 3.3 is useful for readers interested in serving systems. Section 4.4 is the key evidence because it isolates the gain from path-conditioned scoring. The negative CondAdaptive result is also worth a look: cumulative path log-probabilities from the corrected drafter over-credit target acceptance, pointing to calibration as a remaining issue in speculative decoding.

recommendation.zh: 看算法定义和 acceptance 曲线即可；结果强，但缺少端到端 serving 条件时别急着改线上栈。
recommendation.en: Read the algorithm and acceptance curves; the numbers are strong, but without end-to-end serving conditions I would not rush to change a production stack.

paper.title: Trees from Marginals: Autoregressive drafting with factorized priors
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding greatly increases the interactivity of autoregressive language models by trading off computation for extra tokens generated in a single forward pass. Factorized draft models are especially efficient because they predict future-token marginals in parallel, but their independence assumption causes acceptance rates to degrade sharply as the speculative budget grows. We analyze this limitation and introduce Weaver, a lightweight autoregressive adapter that constructs proposal tr

summary.core_problem: 解决 factorized draft model 在 speculative decoding 中因未来 token 独立假设过强而导致 acceptance rate 随预算增长快速下降的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率工作，但切中一个真实痛点：并行 draft 很快，却因为忽略条件依赖而在长 speculative budget 下失效。对做 serving、推测解码、以及非 Transformer 架构部署的人有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Weaver：在 factorized drafter 给出的 top-K future-token marginals 基础上，加一个轻量 autoregressive adapter 来构造 proposal tree，从而恢复候选 token 间的条件依赖，但避免完整词表投影的成本。系统侧又为 Gated Delta Net 层推导了 rollback-free 的 tree verification 算法，并在 SGLang 中实现优化 CUDA kernel。方法是模型侧和系统侧联合设计，不只是 kernel trick。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告相对标准 autoregressive decoding 达到 4.37× 加速，并超过高度优化的 DFlash baseline。重点实验应是随 speculative budget 增大时 acceptance rate 的退化对比，以及在 Gated Delta Net 架构上的验证。未给出模型参数与数据规模，说明论文更偏 serving/decoding 系统。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the sharp acceptance-rate drop in speculative decoding with factorized draft models, caused by overly strong independence assumptions over future tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper, but it targets a real bottleneck: parallel drafting is fast yet breaks down at larger speculative budgets because it ignores conditional structure. It is useful for serving, speculative decoding, and deployment of non-standard architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Weaver, a lightweight autoregressive adapter that builds proposal trees from top-K future-token marginals predicted by a factorized drafter. This restores conditional dependencies among proposed tokens without paying for a full-vocabulary projection. On the systems side, it derives a rollback-free tree-verification algorithm for Gated Delta Net layers and implements optimized CUDA kernels in SGLang.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 4.37× speedup over autoregressive decoding and better performance than a highly optimized DFlash baseline. The key experiments likely focus on acceptance-rate degradation as speculative budget grows and on verification efficiency for Gated Delta Net models. No model or data scale is given, consistent with a serving-oriented paper.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 serving，这篇比一般 speculative decoding 小修小补更扎实：问题定义很准，先看 acceptance 随 budget 崩塌的分析，再看 rollback-free verification。
recommendation.en: If serving matters to you, this is more than a minor speculative-decoding tweak: read the analysis of acceptance collapse with larger budgets, then the rollback-free verification piece.

paper.title: DSpark: Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling draft generation from target verification. While recent parallel drafters efficiently propose long token sequences in a single forward pass, they suffer from rapid acceptance decay due to a lack of inter-token dependencies. Furthermore, indiscriminately verifying these extended blocks wastes critical batch capacity on tokens with high rejection risks, severely degrading throughput in high-concurrency serving syst

summary.core_problem: 解决并行 speculative decoding 在长 draft block 上接受率快速下降，以及高并发 serving 中固定长度验证浪费 batch capacity 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与解码架构改进。它把 draft 质量和 verification 调度放在同一个 serving 目标下处理，比只优化单请求 latency 的 speculative decoding 更贴近真实部署。
summary.technical_approach: DSpark 使用半自回归 draft 架构：并行 backbone 一次产生多个候选 token，同时加入轻量 sequential module 建模 block 内 token 依赖，缓解后缀 token 的 acceptance decay。系统侧提出 confidence-scheduled verification，根据 draft token 置信度和负载动态决定每个请求验证多长，避免把 target model 的验证预算花在高拒绝风险 token 上。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集、baseline 和具体提升数字。可确认的实验目标应包括 speculative decoding throughput、acceptance rate、block suffix acceptance decay，以及高并发 batch serving 下的吞吐表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two bottlenecks in speculative decoding: fast acceptance decay for long parallel draft blocks and wasted verification capacity under high-concurrency serving.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an inference-system and decoding-architecture design. The useful part is that draft quality and load-aware verification are optimized together, which is closer to production serving than single-request speedup studies.
summary_en.technical_approach: DSpark uses a semi-autoregressive drafter: a parallel backbone proposes multiple tokens in one pass, while a lightweight sequential component injects intra-block dependency modeling to reduce suffix rejection. It also introduces confidence-scheduled verification, dynamically choosing verification lengths based on token confidence and serving load.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numeric gains. The likely evaluation axes are throughput, acceptance rate, suffix acceptance decay, and high-concurrency batch-serving efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Peking University.

recommendation.zh: 服务侧值得扫，重点看 acceptance decay 的测量和动态验证策略；对预训练无直接动作，但会影响生成式架构的 serving 约束。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the acceptance-decay measurements and adaptive verification policy; it will not change pretraining, but it sharpens serving constraints for generative architectures.

paper.title: Quantize the Target, Quantize the Drafter: Efficient Inference with Qwen3.5-4B
paper.abstract: This report describes our approach to the Efficient Qwen Competition, where the goal is to enable low-latency serving of Qwen3.5-4B on a resource-constrained NVIDIA A10G GPU. Our system combines a quantized target model with speculative decoding. To recover accuracy, we apply quantization-aware distillation to the target model while retaining the original quantization grid. To speed up decoding, a block-diffusion drafter specialized for the quantized target model is trained using a two-stage pro

summary.core_problem: 在资源受限的单卡 NVIDIA A10G（24GB VRAM）上部署 Qwen3.5-4B 时，需要同时满足低延迟推理与严格的质量阈值约束；现有单独使用量化或推测解码的方案，难以在目标模型精度、草稿模型接受率、端到端延迟三者之间取得平衡，尤其是量化后的目标模型分布偏移会破坏草稿模型的对齐。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于：后训练量化与蒸馏、推测解码草稿模型的训练、目标-草稿的分布对齐是一个联合优化问题，不能割裂处理；两阶段草稿训练（先对齐高精度目标、再适配低精度目标）的思路可迁移到其他“目标模型发生分布偏移后需要重训辅助模块”的场景，例如持续预训练后重训推测解码草稿、重训检索增强的适配器等。
summary.technical_approach: 整体方案由量化目标模型与适配的推测解码系统两部分组成。目标模型侧：从现成的 AWQ INT4 PTQ 检查点出发，使用原始 BF16 模型作为教师，执行固定量化网格的量化感知蒸馏（QAD），通过前向 KL 做逐 token 蒸馏，权重更新后重新舍入回原 AWQ 尺度的 INT4 网格，最终以 W4A16 格式部署。推测解码侧：训练基于 DFlash 的块扩散草稿模型，利用目标模型多层隐藏状态作为条件，单次前向预测多个未来 token；采用两阶段训练，第一阶段用 BF16 目标模型及其生成的数据训练草稿，第二阶段用 QAD 后的量化目标模型及其生成的数据微调，解决量化导致的分布偏移。进一步对草稿模型做 GPTQ INT4 量化，并引入滑动窗口注意力（SWA）降低长上下文下的注意力开销，同时提升草稿接受长度。
