paper.title: DREAM-S: Speculative Decoding with Searchable Drafting and Target-Aware Refinement for Multimodal Generation
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) has proven to be an effective technique for accelerating autoregressive generation in large language models (LLMs) however, its application to vision-language models (VLMs) remains relatively unexplored. We propose~\textit{DREAM-S}, a novel SD framework designed specifically for fast and efficient decoding in VLMs. DREAM-S leverages a neural architecture search (NAS) framework with target-aware supernet training to automatically identify both the optimal interaction str

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决 VLM 自回归生成中的 speculative decoding 适配问题：文本 LLM 上的草稿模型加速方法不能直接迁移到多模态场景，因为视觉 token、文本 token、跨模态交互和目标模型中间表示都会影响草稿 token 的接受率与推理延迟。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接影响有限，更偏推理加速与部署效率。但它有一个有用信号：VLM 的解码加速不能只看小草稿模型的语言建模能力，还要考虑视觉输入剪枝、目标模型中间层信息复用、以及硬件上的真实延迟。对于训练侧，草稿模型蒸馏如何利用目标 VLM 的跨模态中间表示，也可作为多模态模型压缩和协同推理的参考。
summary.technical_approach: DREAM-S 把 VLM speculative decoding 中的草稿模型设计表述为一个 NAS 问题。搜索对象不只是草稿模型宽度或深度，还包括输入剪枝比例、草稿模型与目标模型的连接方式、以及不同硬件平台上的速度—接受率权衡。训练侧使用 two-phase progressive training：先 warm-up 训练完整草稿模型，再进入可搜索配置训练。另一个核心模块是 adaptive intermediate feature distillation。它从目标 VLM 的中间层动态选择更有信息量的隐藏状态，用注意力熵等信号指导选择，再通过交叉注意力把目标模型的中间表示注入草稿模型。这样做的目标是提高草稿 token 与目标模型输出的一致性，而不是单纯缩小草稿模型。与常规 speculative decoding 相比，DREAM-S 的主要差别在于：它把多模态输入剪枝、中间层蒸馏、草稿—目标交互策略和硬件约束放在同一个搜索框架里优化。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLaVA-v1.6-Vicuna-7B/13B、SmolVLM-2B、Pixtral-12B 等 VLM，并在多类视觉语言生成任务上比较常规解码和已有 speculative decoding 方法。给出的主要结果是最高可达到 3.85× 加速，同时保持较高接受率。消融重点应在三个部分：NAS 搜索出的草稿配置是否优于手工配置；中间层特征蒸馏是否提升 token 接受长度；输入剪枝和交互策略在不同目标模型、不同硬件上的选择是否稳定。给定内容未提供完整表格数字，因此不能进一步确认平均加速、质量退化幅度和各消融项的独立贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。优先看 Methodology 中 Figure 2，对齐训练和推理流程；再看 TPPT、AIFD、cross-attention feature reuse 的具体实现；实验部分重点看速度提升表、接受率、质量指标和消融。无需细读任务背景和 VLM 应用介绍。若只关心 LLM pretrain，可把它作为“多模态 speculative decoding 中草稿模型如何训练”的案例，而不是预训练方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: DREAM-S targets speculative decoding for autoregressive VLM generation. Draft-model acceleration methods designed for text-only LLMs do not transfer cleanly to VLMs, because visual tokens, text tokens, cross-modal interactions, and target-model intermediate states all affect both acceptance rate and latency.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its useful lesson for foundation-model researchers is that VLM decoding acceleration needs more than a small language draft model. Visual input pruning, reuse of target-model intermediate representations, and hardware-aware latency all matter. The distillation design is also relevant to multimodal compression: the draft model is trained to exploit cross-modal hidden states from the target model, not just to imitate final logits.
summary_en.technical_approach: DREAM-S formulates VLM speculative decoding as a neural architecture search problem. The search space includes draft-model configuration, input pruning ratio, and interaction strategy between draft and target models, with the objective tied to the target hardware. Training uses a two-phase progressive procedure: first training the full draft model, then training searchable configurations. The second key component is adaptive intermediate feature distillation. Target-model middle-layer features are selected dynamically, guided by signals such as attention entropy, and injected into the draft model through cross-attention. This is intended to improve draft-token agreement with the target model and extend accepted token runs. Compared with standard speculative decoding, the main difference is that DREAM-S jointly optimizes multimodal input pruning, intermediate-feature supervision, draft-target coupling, and hardware-aware speed.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers LLaVA-v1.6-Vicuna-7B/13B, SmolVLM-2B, and Pixtral-12B on multiple vision-language generation tasks. The reported headline result is up to 3.85× speedup over conventional decoding while maintaining high acceptance rates. The important ablations are the NAS-selected draft configuration versus manual choices, the contribution of adaptive intermediate feature distillation, and the stability of pruning and interaction choices across target VLMs and hardware settings. The provided content does not include the full experimental tables, so average speedup, quality degradation, and per-component gains cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with Figure 2 and the Methodology section to understand the training and inference pipeline. Then read the details of TPPT, AIFD, and cross-attention-based feature reuse. In the experiments, focus on latency, acceptance rate, quality preservation, and ablations. The application background can be skipped. For LLM pretraining researchers, this is best read as a case study in training multimodal draft models for speculative decoding.

recommendation.zh: 多模态推测解码的工程化落地方案，注意力熵引导蒸馏的设计可参考，重点看§3的NAS搜索空间和实验结果
recommendation.en: Engineering implementation of multimodal speculative decoding; the attention-entropy guided distillation design is worth referencing, focus on §3 search space and experimental results

paper.title: SENSE: Semantic Embedding Navigation with Soft-gated Evaluation for Retrieval-based Speculative Decoding

summary.core_problem: SENSE 解决的是检索式 speculative decoding 中的词面刚性问题：候选片段通常依赖 token 级前缀或精确匹配，导致语义相近但表面形式不同的 draft 被检索不到或被验证阶段拒绝。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值主要在推理效率，而不是预训练方法。对基座研究员的启发在于，它把 speculative decoding 的瓶颈从“更强 draft model”转向“更好的候选表示与验证准则”。如果候选来自检索库而不是生成模型，就没有 draft logits，传统基于概率分布校正的 SD 方法很难直接使用。SENSE 给出了一条替代路线：用目标模型 hidden state 做语义检索锚点，再用更宽松但受控的验证规则提高接受长度。这对大模型 serving、长文本生成加速、异构 tokenizer 场景都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两个核心模块组成。第一是 Semantic Embedding Navigation。它不只用目标模型当前 greedy token 作为检索键，而是把目标模型在当前 prefix 上的 hidden state 与预测 token 一起投影成 query embedding，再从静态 datastore 和动态上下文中检索长度最多为 M 的候选片段。这样做的动机是：hidden state 比离散 token 保留更多语义和上下文意图，能扩大候选池，减少对词面前缀的依赖。第二是 Soft-gated Evaluation。验证阶段仍然用目标模型对 prefix+draft 做 batched forward，但不是所有位置都要求精确 token match。它根据目标分布熵做 gating：高置信位置保持严格匹配，避免错误接受；高不确定位置允许基于 top-k 分布对齐的软验证，以保留语义等价但表面不同的候选。为控制大 batch 验证开销，方法还引入 parallelized neighborhood fusion，把候选邻域并行融合验证。和常规 RSD 相比，SENSE 的核心区别是同时放松检索键和验证准则，但仍把目标模型作为最终裁判，因此保持 training-free 和 plug-and-play。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLaMA 和 Qwen 系列 backbone。论文报告最高 3.26× 解码加速，平均每次 decoding step 接受 4.09 个 token。关键实验关注 acceptance length、speedup、不同 backbone、不同检索候选设置和验证策略的影响。消融的主要信息是：只扩大检索空间不足以稳定提升，因为语义相近候选仍会在严格验证中被拒；只做软验证也不够，因为检索阶段如果仍受词面约束，候选质量和多样性有限。SEN 与 SE 组合后，接受长度和端到端速度才同时改善。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看 Method 中 SEN 的 query 构造、静态/动态 datastore 的使用方式，以及 SE 的 entropy-guided gating 规则。实验部分优先看 speedup 与 acceptance length 的主表、SEN/SE 消融、batch 验证开销分析。若关注 serving，可继续看统一 SD testbed 的组件拆分方式，因为它有助于比较不同 speculative decoding 方法时避免实现差异带来的偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: SENSE targets a rigidity problem in retrieval-based speculative decoding: retrieved drafts are usually tied to token-level prefixes or exact lexical matches, so semantically valid continuations can be missed during retrieval or rejected during verification.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about inference efficiency rather than pretraining. Its useful signal for foundation-model researchers is the shift from building a stronger draft model to improving candidate representation and acceptance criteria. Retrieval-based drafts do not naturally provide logits, which makes many distribution-correction techniques in speculative decoding hard to apply. SENSE instead uses target-model hidden states for semantic retrieval and a controlled soft verification rule to increase accepted length. This is relevant for serving large models, long-form generation, and heterogeneous-tokenizer settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two main components. Semantic Embedding Navigation builds the retrieval query from the target model hidden state under the current prefix, together with the current greedy anchor token. This projected query is used to retrieve candidate continuations from static datastores and dynamic contexts. The reason is straightforward: hidden states carry richer semantic intent than a discrete next-token key, so the candidate pool is less constrained by surface-form overlap. Soft-gated Evaluation then verifies prefix-plus-draft batches with the target model, but it does not enforce exact token matching everywhere. It uses entropy as a gate: low-entropy positions remain strict, while uncertain positions can be accepted through top-k distributional alignment. The paper also uses parallelized neighborhood fusion to reduce the overhead of verifying many retrieved candidates. Compared with standard RSD, SENSE relaxes both retrieval and verification, while keeping the target model as the final verifier and requiring no training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on LLaMA and Qwen backbones. The paper reports up to 3.26× decoding speedup and a mean accepted length of 4.09 tokens per decoding step. The key metrics are acceptance length, end-to-end speedup, and verification overhead under different retrieval and gating configurations. The ablations support a useful point: broadening retrieval alone is not enough, because semantically similar drafts can still be rejected by exact matching; soft verification alone is also limited if the candidate set remains lexically narrow. The gains come from combining hidden-state retrieval with entropy-aware soft verification.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is sufficient. Focus on the Method section for the SEN query construction, the use of static and dynamic datastores, and the entropy-guided SE rule. In the experiments, read the main speedup and accepted-length tables, the SEN/SE ablations, and the analysis of batched verification cost. For serving-oriented readers, the unified speculative-decoding testbed is also useful because it decomposes SD methods into comparable primitives.

recommendation.zh: 检索式 spec decoding 的关键是端到端 latency；只看 acceptance-rate/overhead 表，别只信 token/s。
recommendation.en: For retrieval-based speculative decoding, end-to-end latency is the real metric; inspect acceptance-rate and overhead tables, not just tokens/sec.

paper.title: Speculative Pipeline Decoding: Higher-Accruacy and Zero-Bubble Speculation via Pipeline Parallelism
paper.abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) accelerates low-concurrency LLM inference by employing a draft-then-verify paradigm. However, mainstream methods typically rely on multi-token prediction, which introduces escalating prediction difficulty and serial drafting latency. To address these, we propose Speculative Pipeline Decoding (SPD), a groundbreaking framework that unlocks the true potential of pipeline parallelism. By partitioning the target LLM into $n$ pipeline stages, SPD allows LLM to process $n$ tok

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是单序列低并发场景下 speculative decoding 的两个结构性瓶颈。第一，主流方法依赖 multi-token drafting，越往后预测越依赖草稿模型自己生成的浅层、未验证状态，误差会沿 draft length 累积，接受率快速下降。第二，draft 与 verify 往往仍有串行依赖，目标模型会等待草稿，或者草稿模块本身要串行生成多个 token，导致加速被 drafting latency 吃掉。作者想解决的不是再把 draft 头做得更强，而是换一个执行范式：把 target LLM 改成 pipeline 形式，让不同 token 同时处在不同深度，再只预测“下一个需要填进流水线的 token”，从而避免传统 speculative decoding 中 draft length 带来的长程衰减和等待开销。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练，而在推理执行范式。它给出的启发是：speculation 不一定要围绕“多预测几个未来 token”来设计，也可以围绕“如何持续喂满 target model 的执行流水线”来设计。这个视角把 speculative decoding 从 token-level lookahead 改成 pipeline occupancy optimization。对 serving 和系统研究更有价值，对训练侧的启发相对有限，但如果未来训练时就考虑中间层可预测性、分层特征可聚合性，可能会反过来影响模型结构和中间表示设计。论文的贡献量级属于中等偏上：提出了一个清楚的新框架，也给了比 EAGLE-3 更好的理论速度指标，但目前主要还是 inference-side 方法，且收益依赖 pipeline 切分和实现条件。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心有两部分。第一部分是把目标模型切成 n 个 pipeline stages。这样在任一 cycle 内，模型不是让一个 token 走完整个网络，而是让 n 个 token 分别位于不同深度并行推进。为了避免 bubble，每个 cycle 都需要有一个新 token 被送入第一阶段。SPD 的 speculation module 就负责预测这个 token。

第二部分是 speculation module 的设计。作者没有像 PPSD 那样只用第一阶段的浅层 hidden state 做 early exit，而是做 multi-depth feature aggregation：收集当前流水线中各 token 在不同 stage 的部分特征，以及已经验证 token 的完整特征，再把这些信息聚合后预测下一个 token。这样做的关键原因是，预测时不再只依赖某个很浅的局部表示，而是利用了“多 token、多深度”的上下文切片。论文强调一个重要性质：由于流水线长度固定为 n，预测所依赖的不完整特征的缺失程度被上界在常数 n 内，不会像传统 multi-token drafting 那样随着 draft length 增长而无界恶化。

另一个关键设计是 zero mutual waiting。常规 speculative decoding 中，草稿往往要等 target model 产出某些状态后才能继续。SPD 把 speculation module 的执行窗口前移，只基于当前 cycle 的 pipeline 输入状态来预测下一 token，而不是等本 cycle 输出出来后再预测。这样 speculation 和 target pipeline step 可以严格并行。代价是预测时可用信息更早、更少，理论上更难；作者用更强的 multi-depth aggregation 来补偿，并指出因为该模块延迟被 target step 完全掩蔽，所以可以把 speculation network 做得更深而不增加端到端时延。

论文还提出了 Equivalent Acceptance Length 这一指标，用来替代传统 acceptance length。原因是 pipeline speculative decoding 里存在初始化和 flush penalty，简单统计接受 token 数会高估真实收益。这个指标把 rejection 后流水线清空、重新填充的代价算进去，更接近理论吞吐提升。
summary.experiments:
实验基于 Qwen3.5-4B 和 Qwen3.5-9B，评测覆盖 MT-Bench、GSM8K、HumanEval。摘要和引言里给出的主结论是：SPD 在 equivalent acceptance length 上与主流方法相当或更高，并且在大多数设置下理论 speedup 超过 EAGLE-3。全文可见作者重点不是宣称绝对 wall-clock 全面领先，而是先证明这种 pipeline speculation 在接受长度和理论吞吐上成立。

从实验设计看，值得注意的点有几个。第一，作者专门把 SPD 与 PPSD 对比，说明只看第一阶段浅层特征会明显损伤接受率，且 stage 数增加后更难扩展；这支撑了 multi-depth aggregation 的必要性。第二，作者把 zero-bubble 并行执行作为核心卖点，因此消融里应重点看 speculation module 是否真的被完全 latency hidden，以及不同模块深度对端到端速度的影响。第三，Equivalent Acceptance Length 这个指标本身也是实验的一部分，因为它解释了为什么某些方法表面 acceptance 高，但真实 pipeline speedup 并不高。

从已给出的数字看，论文没有在你提供的片段里列出完整表格数值，但明确声称 SPD 在多数设置下超过 EAGLE-3 的理论加速，并保持可比的等效接受长度。若精读全文，建议重点核对：不同 pipeline stage 数 n 下的收益曲线、rejection flush 带来的损失、4B 与 9B 模型上趋势是否一致、以及 wall-clock 与理论 speedup 的偏差有多大。这些决定方法是否只是分析上成立，还是工程上也稳。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不必逐行推公式。先看 Introduction，把作者批评现有 speculative decoding 的两点抓住：long-range decay 和 mutual waiting。然后直接看方法图，理解“不是一次猜多个 token，而是每个 cycle 猜一个 token 去填流水线”。如果这个执行图看懂了，后面的设计就顺了。

接着重点看三处。第一，multi-depth feature aggregation 的输入到底包含哪些 token、哪些 stage 的特征，聚合方式是否足够轻量。第二，zero mutual waiting 的时间线图，确认 speculation 用的是 pipeline input state 而不是 output state。第三，Equivalent Acceptance Length 的定义和推导，这决定了作者的速度结论是否公平。

实验部分建议优先看：SPD vs EAGLE-3 vs PPSD 的主表；不同 stage 数、不同 speculation module 深度的消融；理论 speedup 与真实 latency 的对应关系。预计 30 到 45 分钟可以抓住主要内容。如果只想判断是否值得后续跟进，看方法图、指标定义、主结果表就够了。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two structural limits of speculative decoding in low-concurrency, single-sequence inference. First, mainstream methods rely on multi-token drafting, where later draft tokens are conditioned on shallow and unverified states produced by the draft process itself. This creates compounding error and sharply lowers acceptance as draft length grows. Second, drafting and verification still introduce waiting: either the target model idles while drafts are produced, or the draft path itself is partially serial. SPD reframes the problem. Instead of predicting a long future chunk, it keeps a pipelined target model continuously fed by predicting only the next token needed to fill the pipeline.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is a meaningful inference-side idea for foundation model researchers. The main value is conceptual: speculation does not have to be framed as longer lookahead in token space; it can be framed as maintaining pipeline occupancy in execution space. That shift is useful for serving systems and may eventually feed back into model design if intermediate representations are trained to be more predictable or more aggregatable across depths. The contribution is moderate but real: a clean new decoding framework, a better metric for pipelined speculation, and stronger theoretical speedup than EAGLE-3 in most reported settings.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SPD has two central components. First, the target LLM is partitioned into n pipeline stages. Instead of running one token through all layers, the model processes n tokens concurrently at different depths. To avoid bubbles, each cycle must inject one new token into stage 1. The speculation module predicts exactly that token.

Second, the speculation module uses multi-depth feature aggregation. Unlike PPSD, which only uses shallow hidden states from the first stage, SPD collects partially processed features from tokens currently inside the pipeline, together with fully processed features from already verified tokens. These features are aggregated to predict the next token. The key argument is that prediction is grounded in richer and better-aligned internal states from the target model itself, rather than in a shallow early-exit view. The paper emphasizes a bounded-difficulty property: because the pipeline length is fixed at n, the incompleteness of the available features is bounded by a constant, instead of growing unbounded with draft length as in conventional multi-token speculation.

A second key design is zero mutual waiting. SPD shifts the speculation window forward so that the speculation module runs from the current pipeline input state, not from the output state after the current pipeline step. This allows speculation and target execution to run strictly in parallel. The trade-off is that prediction is made from earlier, less complete information. The authors compensate with stronger multi-depth aggregation and argue that, since speculation latency is fully hidden behind the target pipeline step, the speculation network can be made deeper without increasing end-to-end latency.

The paper also introduces Equivalent Acceptance Length, a metric intended to better reflect pipelined speculative decoding. Standard acceptance length can overestimate gains because it ignores pipeline fill and flush costs after rejection. The new metric explicitly accounts for initialization overhead and rejection penalties, making the theoretical speedup analysis more faithful.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments are conducted on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B, evaluated on MT-Bench, GSM8K, and HumanEval. The main reported result is that SPD achieves comparable or better equivalent acceptance length and surpasses EAGLE-3 in theoretical speedup under most settings. The paper appears more careful about theoretical throughput than about claiming universal wall-clock dominance.

Several experimental choices matter. First, comparisons against PPSD are important because they isolate the value of multi-depth aggregation over shallow first-stage speculation. Second, the zero-bubble claim should be checked through ablations on speculation-module depth and whether its latency is truly hidden by the target pipeline step. Third, the proposed Equivalent Acceptance Length is itself part of the empirical story, since it explains why raw acceptance can be misleading in pipelined settings.

The excerpt provided does not include full tables, so the exact numbers are not all visible here. Still, the paper explicitly claims better theoretical acceleration than EAGLE-3 in most settings while maintaining comparable effective acceptance. When reading the full paper, the most important details to verify are: how gains scale with the number of pipeline stages, how severe flush penalties are after rejection, whether trends are consistent between 4B and 9B models, and how close wall-clock speedup is to the theoretical estimate.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Do not spend time on every derivation. Start with the introduction and lock onto the two critiques of prior speculative decoding: long-range decay and mutual waiting. Then go straight to the method figure. The key mental model is simple: SPD does not guess many future tokens at once; it predicts one token per cycle to keep the pipeline full.

Then focus on three parts. First, inspect exactly which token states and which stage features are used in multi-depth aggregation, and whether the aggregation module stays lightweight. Second, read the execution timeline for zero mutual waiting and confirm that speculation uses pipeline input states rather than output states. Third, read the definition of Equivalent Acceptance Length carefully; much of the speedup claim depends on this metric being the right one.

In experiments, prioritize the main comparison table against EAGLE-3 and PPSD, the ablations over stage count and speculation depth, and the relationship between theoretical speedup and measured latency. Around 30 to 45 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea and judge whether it is worth deeper follow-up.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统图和 speedup 假设；若硬件利用率和 acceptance rate 同时成立，单请求 serving 的 pipeline prior 要改。
recommendation.en: Read the system diagram and speedup assumptions; if utilization and acceptance both hold, this changes the prior on pipeline parallelism for single-request serving.

paper.title: Draft-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Draft Models
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by pairing a target model with a lightweight draft model whose proposed tokens are verified in parallel. A common way to build draft models, like EAGLE3 or DFlash is supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on target-generated trajectories. However, we observe that SFT quickly plateaus: the draft model's acceptance length on test data stops improving. The reason is an offline-to-inference mismatch: In SFT, the drafter learns from fixed target-g

summary.core_problem: Draft-OPD 解决的是训练型 speculative decoding draft model 的离线训练瓶颈。常规 SFT 学的是 target model 生成的固定轨迹，但推理时 draft model 的接受长度由它自己提出的 token block 决定，两者状态分布不一致，导致继续 SFT 很快进入平台期。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练方向的直接关系不强，但对大模型推理效率和 post-train 信号设计有清晰启发。它指出 draft model 的训练目标不能只看 teacher-forced next-token matching，而要看 verification-time state distribution。这个观点和预训练中的 exposure bias、on-policy data、训练-推理分布差异是同一类问题。对做推测解码、轻量预测头、蒸馏和推理加速的人，方法价值较高。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Draft-OPD，即面向 speculative draft model 的 on-policy distillation。直接让 draft model 自己 rollout 不可行，因为 EAGLE 类或 DFlash 类 drafter 通常不是完整自回归模型，而是依赖 target model 上下文提出短 token span，单独生成会重复或退化。单纯 target-assisted rollout 也不够，因为 target 会丢弃 draft 的错误 token，最有训练价值的错误状态被抹掉。Draft-OPD 的做法是：先用 target-assisted rollout 保持续写稳定，同时记录 speculative verification 中暴露出来的错误位置；再从这些错误位置 replay drafting，让 target model 对相同的 draft-induced prefixes 打分；最后使用 acceptance-aware distillation objective，对 accepted tokens 和 rejected tokens 区分处理。accepted tokens 用来强化与 target 的可靠一致性，rejected tokens 用来集中修正限制接受长度的 draft-induced errors。
summary.experiments: 论文报告，离线 SFT 在初始 warm-up 后 accepted length 不再提升，继续在 OPD 数据上做 SFT 甚至可能降低接受长度。Draft-OPD 在 matched FLOPs 设置下，相比 EAGLE-3 提升 23%，相比 DFlash 提升 13%。在 thinking models 上实现超过 5 倍的 lossless acceleration。关键实验信号是 accepted length，而不是单纯 distillation loss；这符合 speculative decoding 的实际目标，因为更长的接受片段直接减少 target model 解码步数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30 分钟。重点看 Figure 1 和相关训练曲线，理解 SFT plateau 的证据。然后读方法部分的 error-position replay 和 acceptance-aware objective，这是论文的核心。实验部分重点看 matched FLOPs 对比、accepted length、端到端加速倍率，而不是只看 loss。若关注推理系统，可进一步看它如何接入 EAGLE-3 和 DFlash 风格 drafter。

summary_en.core_problem: Draft-OPD addresses a training mismatch in learned speculative draft models. Standard SFT trains the drafter on fixed target-generated trajectories, while speculative decoding evaluates the drafter on token blocks produced by its own policy. This offline-to-inference mismatch causes accepted length to plateau after a short SFT warm-up.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant to inference efficiency and distillation, with a useful connection to broader foundation-model training. It shows that matching the teacher under teacher-forced states is not enough when the deployment metric depends on student-induced states. This is the same class of issue as exposure bias and on-policy data collection, but studied in the concrete setting of speculative decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Draft-OPD, adapts on-policy distillation to speculative drafters. Naive draft-only rollouts are unstable because EAGLE-style or DFlash-style drafters are designed to propose short spans under target-model guidance, not to act as standalone autoregressive generators. Target-assisted rollouts are stable, but they erase the rejected draft tokens, which are exactly the states that limit acceptance. Draft-OPD keeps target-assisted rollout for stable continuation, records error positions exposed by speculative verification, replays drafting from those positions, and asks the target model to score the resulting draft-induced prefixes. The training objective is acceptance-aware: accepted tokens reinforce reliable agreement with the target, while rejected tokens focus learning on the errors that reduce accepted length.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that continued offline SFT stops improving accepted length after the initial warm-up, and in some settings can even reduce it on OPD data. Under matched FLOPs, Draft-OPD improves over EAGLE-3 by 23% and over DFlash by 13%. For thinking models, it achieves more than 5x lossless acceleration. The important metric is accepted length rather than distillation loss alone, because accepted length directly determines how many expensive target-model decoding steps are saved.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Start with Figure 1 and the SFT plateau analysis, since that motivates the method. Then read the error-position replay procedure and the acceptance-aware objective. In the experiments, focus on matched-FLOPs comparisons, accepted length, and end-to-end speedup. The implementation details are useful if the goal is to integrate the method with EAGLE-3 or DFlash-style speculative drafters.

recommendation.zh: 离线蒸馏失配这个诊断很可信；读方法里如何保留 on-policy 信号，值得在内部 draft 训练复现。
recommendation.en: The offline-distillation mismatch diagnosis is credible; read how they preserve on-policy signal and consider reproducing it for draft training.

paper.title: Speculative Decoding Across Languages
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding has become a crucial component of large language model (LLM) inference, enabling faster generation by drafting multiple tokens and verifying them in parallel. However, small draft models tend to suffer from disproportionately poor multilingual capabilities. Thus, when generating text in a non-English language, speculative decoding is far less effective.   We compare three strategies to improve speculative decoding efficiency for eleven languages: finetuning the draft model o

summary.core_problem: 解决 speculative decoding 在非英语场景加速效果差的问题：小 draft 模型多语能力弱、tokenization 偏置导致 acceptance rate 低，从而 speed-up 接近 1 甚至为负。论文比较三种提升跨语言 acceptance 的策略，并检验是否能从“翻译（训练域）”泛化到“故事生成（新域）”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，更偏推理侧工程与多语公平性问题；但它给了一个清晰结论：在跨语言场景，提升 acceptance rate 未必需要把 draft 做成小号 LLM，简单的统计语言模型（n-gram）在成本结构上可能更优。这对“系统-模型协同设计”有启发：当 verifier 很强而 draft 很便宜时，draft 的建模范式可以更简单，关键是匹配 verifier 的局部条件分布并控制 draft 成本。
summary.technical_approach:
在标准 speculative decoding 框架下，用 Qwen 3.5 9B 作 verifier、0.8B 作 draft（并在附录测试 2B/4B）。比较三类 draft 构建：
1) 任务蒸馏（task-specific distillation）：用英→目标语的平行数据，对 0.8B 做 soft-target distillation，使其在翻译分布上更贴近 verifier。
2) 通用单语蒸馏（general monolingual distillation）：用目标语单语无标注语料蒸馏 0.8B，期望提升该语言的 next-token 分布匹配。
3) n-gram draft：在同一单语语料上训练 n-gram（用 Qwen tokenizer 分词），推理时用 (n-1) 前缀查表给出 draft 分布；实验发现 2-gram（bigram）在所有语言上 acceptance 最好。
评估用 acceptance rate 的 Monte Carlo 估计，并结合 draft/target 单步耗时比 c=t_draft/t_target 计算期望 speed-up；对每个设置 sweep γ∈[2,4] 取最优。
summary.experiments:
可从全文片段直接读到的关键数字：
- 语言：11 种。
- 任务：翻译（每语种平行数据最多 5,200 条；test 用于评估，train 用于蒸馏）+ 故事生成（200 个 topic，最长 128 tokens）。
- baseline（未专精 0.8B draft）在翻译上的 acceptance rate：0.30（ber）到 0.54（amh），跨语言平均 ᾱ=0.40；对应平均 speed-up f̄=1.02×，基本无收益。
- 结论性发现（定性）：任务蒸馏在翻译域内能显著提高 acceptance，但跨到故事生成泛化差；n-gram 因 forward 成本极低，整体 speed-up 更大且更稳。
片段在“任务蒸馏提升 acceptance”处被截断，缺少各方法在 11 语种上的完整 acceptance/speed-up 数值表与故事生成上的对比幅度，无法安全补全。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（15–25 分钟）：
- 先看 speed-up 公式与 c 的测量方式：这决定了为什么“更差但更便宜”的 draft 可能赢。
- 重点看 Figure 3（翻译 acceptance/speed-up）以及跨域到故事生成的对比图：它支撑“蒸馏不泛化、n-gram 更稳”的主结论。
- 如果要复现或迁移：关注 n-gram 的 tokenizer 选择（直接用 verifier 的 tokenizer）、n 的选择为何 bigram 最优、以及 γ sweep 的设置；这些细节决定 acceptance 与吞吐的权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the poor effectiveness of speculative decoding in non-English generation: small draft models are disproportionately weak multilingual models and tokenization can inflate sequence lengths, leading to low acceptance rates and near-zero speedups. It evaluates how to improve cross-lingual acceptance and whether improvements transfer from an in-domain task (translation) to an out-of-domain task (story generation).
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference/systems paper rather than a pretraining contribution. The useful takeaway is a cost-structure argument: for multilingual speculative decoding, a draft model does not have to be a small LLM—very cheap statistical drafts (n-grams) can outperform distilled neural drafts in end-to-end speedup, especially when generalization across tasks matters. It encourages thinking of draft design as distribution-matching under a strict compute budget, not as “mini-me LLM training.”
summary_en.technical_approach:
Using a standard speculative decoding setup, the verifier is Qwen 3.5 9B and the main draft is Qwen 3.5 0.8B (with 2B/4B drafts in additional experiments). Three draft-training strategies are compared:
1) Task-specific distillation on parallel translation prompts (soft-target distillation from the verifier).
2) General monolingual distillation on unlabeled target-language corpora.
3) Token-level n-gram drafts trained on the same monolingual corpora using the Qwen tokenizer; bigrams are found best across all languages.
Evaluation reports Monte-Carlo estimated acceptance rate and an expected speedup factor that incorporates the draft/target per-step cost ratio c=t_draft/t_target. The speculative parameter γ is swept over [2,4] and the best setting is reported.
summary_en.experiments:
Directly supported by the provided excerpt:
- 11 target languages.
- Tasks: MT (up to 5,200 parallel examples per language; test for evaluation, train for distillation) and story generation (200 prompts; max 128 generated tokens).
- Baseline (undistilled 0.8B draft) on MT: acceptance ranges 0.30–0.54 across languages, with mean ᾱ=0.40; mean speedup is only f̄=1.02×, i.e., speculative decoding is mostly ineffective.
- Qualitative result: task distillation helps in-domain but transfers poorly to story generation; n-gram drafts yield larger speedups due to extremely low drafting cost.
The excerpt is truncated before the full result tables/figures; exact per-language gains for each method and the out-of-domain deltas are not visible here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (15–25 minutes):
- Start from the speedup equation and how c is measured; it explains why a weaker but cheaper draft can win.
- Inspect the main MT figure (acceptance/speedup) and the cross-task transfer to story generation; these support the “distillation is brittle, n-grams are robust” claim.
- For replication/porting, focus on tokenizer choice for n-grams (sharing the verifier tokenizer), the n selection (why bigram wins), and the γ sweep protocol—these details drive the acceptance/throughput trade-off.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改算法范式，但把一个常被忽略的坑讲清了：多语 speculative decoding 的瓶颈常在 draft 分布失配；只看实验设计和跨任务泛化表就够。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it cleanly exposes a neglected failure mode: multilingual speculative decoding is often bottlenecked by draft-distribution mismatch; read the generalization tables, not just acceptance rates.

paper.title: Bastion: Budget-Aware Speculative Decoding with Tree-structured Block Diffusion Drafting
paper.abstract: Block-diffusion drafters have recently emerged as a powerful alternative for speculative decoding by predicting multiple future-token distributions in a single parallel step. However, since these parallel predictions are sampled from position-wise marginals rather than fully conditioned sequences, committing to a single greedy path often fails to capture the target model's preferred trajectory. To address this, we propose BASTION, a budget-aware speculative decoding framework with tree-based dif

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 speculative decoding 中 block-diffusion drafter 的一个实际瓶颈：并行预测多个未来位置时，输出更接近 position-wise marginal，不是严格条件化的自回归路径；如果只取单条 greedy draft，容易错过 target model 更愿意接受的轨迹。
summary.importance: 这是一篇推理效率论文，但对预训练研究也有间接价值。它展示了 diffusion/非自回归语言建模组件可以作为 AR LLM 的高吞吐 drafter，并且需要用树结构和硬件预算控制来弥补 marginal prediction 的条件化不足。对研究 AR 与 diffusion LM 混合建模、multi-token prediction head、serving-aware 训练目标的人有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: Bastion 使用 tree-structured block diffusion drafting。block diffusion drafter 一次性给出未来多个位置的候选分布；方法不再固定为单条 top-1 序列，而是从这些分布中构造 prefix tree，让 target model 在一次并行 verification 中检查多条可能路径。核心有三部分。第一，acceptance surrogate 根据 drafter 的 path confidence 估计期望接受长度，用来判断扩展某个分支是否有收益。第二，online latency estimator 用硬件感知的 roofline model 预测 verification 成本，并用观测 runtime 校准，避免树越大越慢。第三，adaptive best-first expansion 按边际收益扩展候选树，当预期接受增益不足以覆盖额外 verification 成本时停止。与静态树方法相比，Bastion 的树拓扑随 query 和硬件状态变化；与单路径 block-diffusion drafting 相比，它保留了并行预测的低 draft 成本，同时让 verifier 利用更多候选轨迹。
summary.experiments: 论文在 math、code generation、chat benchmark 上评估，并覆盖多个 target model、GPU 架构和 decoding temperature。报告的平均加速为：相对标准自回归解码 6.61 倍，相对 EAGLE-3 为 2.45 倍，相对 DFlash 为 1.39 倍。相对单路径 block-diffusion drafting，提升为 38.87%。这些数字说明主要收益来自两处：一是 block diffusion 一步并行产生多个未来位置，降低 draft 端的串行开销；二是 query-dependent tree 提高 verifier 的有效接受长度，而不是把并行 logits 压成一条脆弱的 greedy path。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 分钟。先看方法图和 tree construction algorithm，确认它如何从每个位置的 marginal logits 生成 prefix-closed tree。然后看 acceptance surrogate 和 latency estimator，这两部分决定了方法是否能在真实 serving 中稳定加速。实验部分重点看与 EAGLE-3、DFlash、标准解码的速度对比，以及不同 GPU、不同 temperature 下的稳定性。若关心预训练，可重点关注 block diffusion drafter 的训练方式和误差形态：位置边缘分布如何影响 target acceptance，是这类非 AR drafter 能否进一步扩展的关键。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical weakness of block-diffusion drafters for speculative decoding. They predict several future positions in parallel, but these predictions are closer to position-wise marginals than fully conditioned autoregressive continuations. A single greedy draft path can therefore miss trajectories that the target model would accept.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper, but it is relevant for researchers studying alternatives to pure autoregressive generation. It shows how a diffusion-style, non-sequential language-modeling component can serve as a high-throughput drafter for an AR target model. The key lesson is that parallel multi-token prediction needs structured candidate exploration and hardware-aware budgeting; otherwise, the gain from parallelism is partly lost through low acceptance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Bastion introduces tree-structured block-diffusion drafting. The diffusion drafter produces candidate distributions for a future block in one parallel step. Instead of collapsing them into a single top-1 sequence, Bastion builds a prefix tree and lets the target model verify multiple plausible continuations in parallel. The system has three main components. An acceptance surrogate estimates expected accepted length from path confidence scores under the drafter distributions. An online latency estimator predicts verification cost using a hardware-aware roofline model calibrated with observed runtimes. A best-first expansion procedure grows the tree only while the expected acceptance gain justifies the extra verification cost. Compared with static tree methods, the topology is query-dependent and budget-aware. Compared with single-path block-diffusion drafting, it better uses the target model’s parallel verification capacity.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers math, code-generation, and chat benchmarks, with multiple target models, GPU architectures, and decoding temperatures. The reported average speedups are 6.61x over standard autoregressive decoding, 2.45x over EAGLE-3, and 1.39x over DFlash. The paper also reports a 38.87% improvement over single-path block-diffusion drafting. The results suggest that the gain comes from combining two effects: block diffusion reduces sequential draft cost, and dynamic tree construction increases the expected accepted length by keeping several likely trajectories available to the verifier.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Start with the tree construction algorithm to see how marginal logits are turned into a prefix-closed candidate tree. Then read the acceptance surrogate and online latency estimator, because these determine whether the method remains useful under real serving constraints. In the experiments, focus on comparisons with EAGLE-3, DFlash, and standard decoding, and check robustness across GPU types and temperatures. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most useful angle is the behavior of the block-diffusion drafter: how marginal prediction errors translate into target-model acceptance, and whether a different drafter training objective could improve this interface.

recommendation.zh: 动态树+扩散草稿的推测解码思路扎实，硬件感知的扩展逻辑对推理系统优化有参考价值，重点看§3的核心设计
recommendation.en: The dynamic tree + diffusion draft speculative decoding approach is solid; the hardware-aware expansion logic is useful for inference system optimization, focus on §3 core design

paper.title: Domino: Decoupling Causal Modeling from Autoregressive Drafting in Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting multiple tokens and verifying them in parallel with the target model. However, its practical speedup is constrained by the trade-off between draft quality and drafting cost: autoregressive drafters model causal dependencies among draft tokens but incur sequential overhead, while parallel drafters reduce drafting cost but weaken intra-block dependency modeling. In this paper, we propose Domino, a speculative decoding framework that decoup

summary.core_problem: Speculative decoding 的实际加速受 draft 质量和 draft 成本之间的矛盾限制：自回归 draft 质量好但串行慢，并行 draft 快但块内因果依赖弱。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法改进。论文试图把因果依赖建模从昂贵的自回归 draft 执行中拆出来，从而在保持并行 draft 低成本的同时恢复一部分 causal consistency。
summary.technical_approach: Domino 先用并行 draft backbone 为整个 token block 产生初始分布，再用轻量 Domino head 注入 prefix-dependent 的因果信息来细化这些分布。训练上引入 base-anchored curriculum：先强化并行 backbone，再逐步把优化目标转向因果正确的 refinement，以稳定 teacher-forced causal encoding。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、目标模型、draft block size、benchmark 和速度提升数字。可确认的实验主张是 Domino 被用于 speculative decoding，并针对 AR drafter 与 parallel drafter 的质量/成本折中进行对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Speculative decoding is limited by a quality-cost trade-off: autoregressive drafters model intra-block causality but are sequential, while parallel drafters are cheap but weaker at causal dependency modeling.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method. Domino tries to separate causal modeling from expensive autoregressive draft execution so that parallel drafting can retain part of the dependency structure.
summary_en.technical_approach: Domino first uses a parallel draft backbone to produce preliminary distributions for the whole block, then applies a lightweight Domino head to refine them with prefix-dependent causal information. A base-anchored curriculum first strengthens the parallel backbone and then gradually shifts optimization toward causally correct refinement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, target models, block sizes, benchmarks, or exact speedups. The stated comparison is against the usual autoregressive and parallel drafter trade-off in speculative decoding.

recommendation.zh: 作为 serving 备查即可；关键看 Domino head 是否真低成本，摘要里的速度收益证据还不够。
recommendation.en: Keep it as serving literature; the key question is whether the Domino head is truly cheap, and the abstract does not yet show enough speed evidence.

paper.title: Pair-In, Pair-Out: Latent Multi-Token Prediction for Efficient LLMs
paper.abstract: Long chain-of-thought reasoning has made autoregressive decoding the dominant inference cost of modern large language models. Existing methods target either the input side (latent compression) or the output side (speculative decoding and multi-token prediction, MTP), but the two lines of work have been pursued independently. Moreover, output-side methods must incur an expensive verifier pass to validate the unreliable draft tokens predicted by MTP. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{Pai

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是长链式推理场景下自回归解码成本过高的问题。现有路线通常只处理一侧：输入侧用 latent compression 缩短有效上下文，输出侧用 speculative decoding 或 multi-token prediction 一步生成多个 token。但输出侧方法往往需要大模型 verifier 再跑一遍来确认 draft token，接受 token 仍要经过完整 backbone，速度上限被 verifier 成本限制。PIPO 试图把输入压缩、输出展开和 draft 置信判断放进同一个 pair-level 接口里。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值不在于提出一个新的预训练 scaling 结论，而在于给出了一种训练目标、模型接口和推理机制耦合的设计。它把“两个输入 token 压成一个 latent”和“一个 hidden state 展开出额外 token”看成镜像操作，从而把解码单位从单 token 改成 token pair。对基座研究有两个启发：第一，MTP head 不只是 speculative decoding 的附属模块，也可以和输入侧 latent compression 一起定义新的序列建模接口；第二，on-policy distillation 中 teacher/student 分布已经包含 verifier 所需信号，可以被复用来训练轻量 confidence head，减少推理时的大模型验证成本。需要注意的是，它用 confidence head 近似替代 verifier，效率收益来自放弃严格 rejection-sampling 验证路径，分布等价性不如标准 speculative decoding 清晰。
summary.technical_approach: PIPO 把每个 decoding step 改成 pair step。输入端，compressor 接收两个连续 token embedding 的拼接，用一个 MLP 映射成一个 latent 表示 z_i。论文强调初始化时让 f([a;b]) 接近 a+b，以减小训练初期对 backbone 输入分布的扰动。输出端，backbone 在 pair-level 序列上前向，预测第一个常规 token 分布 p_b，同时由 MTP/draft head 预测第二个 token 分布 p_d。这样，一个 pair step 同时消费压缩后的双 token 输入，并尝试产生两个输出 token。关键补充是 confidence head：训练时利用 OPD 中已经计算出的 teacher 分布 p_t 和 student/draft 分布 p_s，把 speculative decoding 的接受概率 min(p_t/p_s, 1) 作为监督标签。推理时，若 confidence c_i 高于阈值 τ_c，则接受 draft token；否则拒绝 draft，并用 padding token 填入下一组 pair，使模型接口始终保持 pair-in/pair-out 的形态。与 EAGLE-2 或传统 speculative decoding 相比，PIPO 的差异是 verifier 不再是一次完整的大模型 forward，而是由轻量 confidence head 近似承担“是否可信”的判断。与单纯 latent compression 相比，它不只缩短输入序列，也提高每步输出 token 数。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3.5-4B 和 Qwen3.5-9B backbone，在 AIME 2025、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench v6 和 LongBench v2 上评估。对比对象包括 regular decoding、无验证的 MTP decoding，以及 EAGLE-2 speculative decoding。主要结果是 pass@4 在两个 backbone 上都优于最强基线：Qwen3.5-4B 上提升 +3.83 分，Qwen3.5-9B 上提升 +7.15 分。效率方面，相对 regular decoding，TTFT 最高达到 2.64× 加速，TPOT 最高达到 2.07× 加速。论文还指出，当 context budget 增大时，PIPO 的优势会扩大，原因是 pair-out 让模型在相同步数内生成更多推理 token，更容易把完整 reasoning trace 放进预算内。实验部分最需要核查的是 confidence threshold 对准确率和速度的折中、拒绝 draft 后 padding 机制对后续状态的影响，以及 compressor 初始化和 OPD 监督对稳定性的贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 中对 latent compressor、MTP head 和 verifier/teacher 角色等价性的论证；Method 中的 pair-level decoding 定义、compressor 初始化、confidence head 训练目标和拒绝时的 padding 处理是核心。Figure 1 和 Figure 3 应该先看，用来建立 pair-in/pair-out 的执行图。Figure 2 适合看 context budget 与 pass@4 的关系，因为它说明 PIPO 的收益不只是单步吞吐，还影响长推理预算下的有效搜索。实验表格需要重点比较 PIPO、MTP without verification 和 EAGLE-2：这三者的差异能看出 confidence head 是否真的替代了 verifier 的主要功能。消融部分如果包含 τ_c、compressor 初始化、OPD label、padding/reject 策略，应优先看，这些决定方法能否从工程技巧变成可复用的训练接口。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the dominant inference cost in long-chain reasoning LLMs: autoregressive decoding emits one token per full forward step. Prior work usually optimizes only one side of the interface. Latent compression shortens the input sequence, while speculative decoding and multi-token prediction increase output throughput. Output-side methods still pay a verifier cost, because draft tokens must be checked by a strong model. PIPO addresses these issues by turning decoding into a pair-level operation with compression on input, expansion on output, and a learned confidence mechanism for draft acceptance.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an architecture-and-training interface for efficient reasoning models, not a new pretraining scaling result. Its useful insight for foundation-model research is that input compression and MTP can be treated as symmetric operations: fold two tokens into one latent representation on the way in, and unfold one hidden state into an additional token on the way out. It also connects on-policy distillation with speculative verification. The teacher/student distributions computed during OPD already provide the same signal needed to estimate acceptance probability, so they can supervise a lightweight confidence head. The main caveat is that replacing a full verifier with a confidence head changes the guarantee profile. The method buys latency by approximating verification rather than preserving the exact rejection-sampling path of standard speculative decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: PIPO changes the basic decoding unit from a single token to a token pair. On the input side, a compressor MLP takes the concatenation of two consecutive token embeddings and maps them to one latent vector. The compressor is initialized so that f([a;b]) is close to a+b, which keeps the initial input distribution closer to what the backbone has seen. On the output side, the backbone predicts the first next-token distribution, while an MTP or draft head predicts the second token distribution. A confidence head predicts whether the draft token should be accepted. During training, the label for this confidence head is derived from the speculative acceptance probability min(p_t/p_s, 1), where p_t comes from the teacher and p_s from the student or draft model in OPD. At inference time, if the confidence exceeds a threshold, the draft token is accepted; otherwise it is replaced by a padding token before the next compression step, preserving the pair-level interface. Compared with EAGLE-style speculative decoding, the expensive verifier pass is replaced by a small head. Compared with pure latent reasoning, the method both halves effective input length and increases tokens emitted per step.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B on AIME 2025, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench v6, and LongBench v2. Baselines include regular decoding, unverified MTP decoding, and EAGLE-2 speculative decoding. PIPO gives the best pass@4 among the compared methods on both backbones, improving over the strongest baseline by +3.83 points on the 4B model and +7.15 points on the 9B model. On efficiency, it reports up to 2.64× improvement in time to first token and up to 2.07× improvement in time per output token over regular decoding. The paper also reports that the accuracy advantage grows with larger context budgets, because emitting two tokens per step allows more complete reasoning traces to fit under the same step or latency budget. The most important experimental details to inspect are the confidence-threshold trade-off, behavior under draft rejection, compressor initialization, and the dependence on OPD-derived supervision.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction for the symmetry argument between latent compression and MTP, and for the connection between OPD teachers and speculative verifiers. The method section is the key part: focus on pair-level state transitions, compressor initialization, confidence-head labeling, and the padding mechanism used after rejection. Figure 1 and Figure 3 should be read early to understand the data flow. Figure 2 is useful for seeing why the method helps more under larger reasoning budgets. In the experiments, compare PIPO against unverified MTP and EAGLE-2 rather than only against regular decoding; that comparison isolates the value of learned confidence. Any ablation on τ_c, compressor initialization, OPD labels, and reject handling is worth close reading.

recommendation.zh: 将 latent compression 和 MTP 统一为镜像操作的思路非常优雅，且通过置信度头干掉了推测解码的 verifier，强烈建议精读其架构设计和 OPD 训练细节。
recommendation.en: The idea of unifying latent compression and MTP as mirror operations is highly elegant. By eliminating the speculative decoding verifier via a confidence head, it's strongly recommended to closely read its architecture design and OPD training details.

paper.title: Stateful Inference for Low-Latency Multi-Agent Tool Calling
paper.abstract: Multi-agent tool calling is becoming the dominant interaction pattern for LLM-based systems, yet existing inference frameworks treat each tool call as an independent request, re-processing the entire conversation from scratch even though 85-95% of the prompt is unchanged from the previous turn.   We present a stateful inference architecture that converts the $O(n_t)$ per-turn cost of conventional serving into an $O(Δ_t)$ delta-only cost: a persistent KV cache lives across turns and advances by i

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是多轮、多 Agent 工具调用中的重复 prefill 问题。Agent 会不断在已有上下文后追加少量新 token，但常见推理框架仍把每次 API 调用当成独立请求，反复处理几乎相同的长前缀。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更偏 serving 和 agent inference system。但它对理解新型 LLM 工作负载有参考价值：Agent 场景的主要瓶颈不一定在 decode，而是在大量短增量请求反复 prefill。若基座模型未来在训练或评测中大量纳入工具调用轨迹，这类 stateful execution 也会影响数据生成、在线评测和 RL rollout 的系统成本。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案是把 stateless request 改成 stateful session。系统为每个长期会话保留 KV cache，只处理本轮新增 token，将每轮 prefill 从 O(n_t) 降到 O(Δ_t)。具体机制包括：用 sequence pool 预分配并复用命名 sequence ID，避免每次请求重建上下文；用 radix prefix cache 在统一 KV cache 上做元数据级 aliasing，使长前缀恢复接近常数时间；调度侧用 cell-budget admission 控制 KV 资源，并把共享完全相同前缀的请求做 grouped prefill；对完全相同 prompt，使用由 prompt hash 决定随机种子的 response cache；decode 侧加入 prompt-lookup speculation、流式 JSON 工具调用校验、设备端 greedy sampling，以及异常安全的 RAII session 生命周期管理。与 vLLM/SGLang 这类以请求为中心的 prefix caching 不同，它把会话状态作为一级抽象，而不是把 cache 当成可有可无的加速项。
summary.experiments: 文中给出的关键 workload 观察是：典型 5 轮 Agent 对话中，相邻轮次 85–95% prompt token 相同。示例里系统提示约 200 token，每轮约 150 token，到最后一轮 prompt 约 950 token，但新增 token 只有约 150。论文主张这类结构使传统 per-request prefill 产生接近多倍的重复 FLOPs。给出的复杂度收益是从每轮 O(n_t) 转为 O(Δ_t)，共享前缀的 N 个 slot 可由 leader-follower prefill 合并为一次 forward。提供内容中未看到可独立核验的端到端吞吐、TTFT、显存占用或多并发压测数字，因此实验部分更像系统设计论证，而不是完整 benchmark 结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 Agent traffic 的 workload 刻画，以及九个机制的边界分工。Problem Formulation 值得看，因为它把多 Agent 交错请求下的 prefix-extension 关系写清楚了。若只关心 LLM 基座训练，可跳过实现细节；若关心 RL rollout、工具调用数据生成或长上下文 serving，可以重点看 radix prefix cache、cell-budget admission 和 streaming tool-call validator。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets redundant prefill in multi-turn, multi-agent tool calling. Agent prompts grow by appending small deltas, yet common inference stacks often handle each API call as an independent request and reprocess a large repeated prefix.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in serving infrastructure rather than pretraining. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but useful: agentic workloads can be dominated by repeated prefill rather than token generation. If tool-use traces become a larger part of data generation, evaluation, or RL rollouts, stateful inference will materially affect system cost and experiment throughput.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central move is to replace stateless requests with stateful sessions. A persistent KV cache is kept across turns, so each request only ingests newly appended tokens, changing the per-turn prefill cost from O(n_t) to O(Δ_t). The design combines several mechanisms: a sequence pool with reusable named sequence IDs; a radix prefix cache that restores cached prefixes through metadata aliasing over a unified KV cache; cell-budget admission and prefix-aware grouped prefill; a prompt-deterministic response cache using prompt-hash seeding; prompt-lookup speculative decoding with concurrency caps; a streaming JSON validator for tool calls; on-device greedy sampling; and RAII-style lifecycle management for session slots. Compared with prefix caching in request-driven systems such as vLLM or SGLang, the key distinction is that session state is treated as a first-class abstraction.
summary_en.experiments: The main quantitative workload claim is that consecutive turns in typical 5-turn agent conversations share 85–95% of prompt tokens. In the paper’s example, a 200-token system prompt plus roughly 150 tokens per turn yields a final prompt of about 950 tokens, of which only about 150 are new. The claimed algorithmic gain is delta-only prefill, and shared-prefix grouped prefill can collapse N redundant forward passes into one. The provided text does not include independently checkable end-to-end numbers for throughput, TTFT, memory pressure, or high-concurrency stress tests, so the evidence should be read primarily as a system design argument.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Focus on the workload characterization in the introduction and the division of responsibilities across the nine mechanisms. The problem formulation is useful because it makes the prefix-extension structure explicit under interleaved multi-agent calls. For foundation-model training interests, most implementation details can be skipped; for RL rollout systems, tool-use data generation, or long-context serving, the radix cache, cell-budget admission, and streaming tool-call validator are the parts worth reading more carefully.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计和 workloads；若真实 agent 流量确有 85–95% prompt 复用，这类 stateful KV 会比继续卷 attention kernel 更先省钱。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and workloads; if real agent traffic indeed has 85–95% prompt reuse, stateful KV reuse will save money before another attention-kernel tweak does.

paper.title: Frontier: Towards Comprehensive and Accurate LLM Inference Simulation
paper.abstract: Modern LLM serving is no longer homogeneous or monolithic. Production systems now combine disaggregated execution, complex parallelism, runtime optimizations, and stateful workloads such as reasoning, agents, and RL rollouts. Simulation is attractive for exploring this growing design space, yet existing simulators lack the architectural completeness and decision-grade fidelity it demands. Their monolithic-replica abstractions are ill-suited to disaggregated serving, while average-case analytical

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决现代 LLM inference serving 难以准确模拟的问题。生产系统已经不再是同构、单体 replica：prefill/decode 可能解耦，attention/FFN 也可能解耦，还叠加 TP、PP、DP、EP、continuous batching、PagedAttention、prefix caching、chunked prefill、speculative decoding 等机制。已有模拟器常用平均化的单体抽象，容易在 SLA、吞吐和配置选择上给出错误结论。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在训练后阶段和系统-算法接口。长链推理、agent、多轮工具调用和 RL rollout 都会把 inference 变成训练成本的一部分，尤其是 RL post-training 中的大量采样。一个能模拟 stateful workload、decode tail、KV cache 压力和 disaggregated serving 的工具，可以帮助判断模型结构、上下文长度、MoE 路由、speculative decoding 策略对真实成本的影响。它不直接改变预训练目标，但能让 scaling 和 post-training 预算估算更接近生产约束。
summary.technical_approach: Frontier 是一个 discrete-event simulator。核心设计是把 serving 系统拆成 control plane 和 fidelity plane。control plane 将 serving specification 编译成 role-specific cluster workers，不再假设所有 replica 执行相同操作。它显式建模 co-located、Prefill-Decode Disaggregation 和 Attention-FFN Disaggregation，并把同步、KV-cache transfer、不同硬件池之间的数据移动作为事件处理。runtime optimization 不是用事后修正系数近似，而是以 feature-specific adapter 的方式嵌入 scheduler–batch-engine loop，直接改变调度器可见状态。workload 侧引入 stateful request 抽象，可表示 thinking rounds、tool-call delay、每轮 token plan 和 phase transition，用来覆盖 reasoning、agent 和 RL rollout 场景。这个设计重点不在单个 kernel 的极限优化，而在保留 serving closed loop 中的队列、内存、batch 形状和调度反馈。
summary.experiments: 论文指出平均化 proxy 会带来明显误差：token-count proxy 在 FlashAttention 上可产生 32.6% runtime error，在 MoE GroupedGEMM 上可产生 21.0% error；用“总显存减权重”估算 KV-cache budget 会最高高估 27.2%，并导致吞吐预测最高高估 32.4%。这些数字说明，在连续 batching、KV 增长和变长请求共同作用下，小的 operator 或 memory 误差会被 closed-loop 调度放大，进而改变 Pareto frontier 和配置选择。完整实验应重点检查它在真实系统 trace 或 microbenchmark 上的校准方式，以及对 PDD、AFD、speculative decoding、prefix caching 等组合配置的预测误差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 section 2.2，那里给出了已有模拟器为何会反向判断优化收益的具体误差来源。然后看系统设计中 disaggregated abstraction、stateful request abstraction 和 scheduler adapter。实验部分重点看三类内容：operator/runtime fidelity 如何校准，KV-cache memory model 如何建，配置选择是否与真实部署一致。对做 RLHF/RLVR 或 agent rollout 基础设施的人，workload model 比具体 UI 或模拟器接口更值得读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets accurate simulation of modern LLM inference serving. Production serving is no longer a set of homogeneous monolithic replicas. Systems now combine prefill/decode disaggregation, attention/FFN disaggregation, multiple forms of parallelism, continuous batching, PagedAttention, prefix caching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding, and stateful workloads. Existing simulators often use averaged monolithic abstractions, which can mispredict latency, memory pressure, throughput, and even the direction of an optimization.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining research is indirect but practical. Inference is now part of the training loop for RL post-training, synthetic data generation, reasoning rollouts, and agent evaluation. A simulator that captures long decode tails, KV-cache pressure, phase-changing requests, and disaggregated execution can improve budget estimates for RL rollouts and help evaluate architecture choices such as MoE, long context, or speculative decoding under realistic serving constraints. It is a systems paper, but the feedback signal is useful when model design and post-training cost are considered together.
summary_en.technical_approach: Frontier is a discrete-event simulator built around a disaggregated serving abstraction. A control plane compiles a serving specification into role-specific cluster workers rather than assuming identical replicas. It explicitly models co-located serving, Prefill-Decode Disaggregation, and Attention-FFN Disaggregation, including synchronization and data movement such as KV-cache transfers. Runtime optimizations are represented as feature-specific adapters inside the scheduler–batch-engine loop, so they modify scheduler-visible state instead of being added as analytical correction factors. The workload model uses stateful requests that can include thinking rounds, tool-call delays, per-round token plans, and phase transitions, which makes it suitable for reasoning, agentic, and RL-rollout traffic. The design prioritizes closed-loop fidelity: queue evolution, batch shape, memory pressure, and scheduling feedback are treated as first-class effects.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that common analytical proxies can be substantially wrong. Token-count runtime proxies can produce 32.6% error on FlashAttention and 21.0% error on MoE GroupedGEMM. A memory model based on total memory minus weights can overestimate KV-cache budget by up to 27.2% and throughput by up to 32.4%. These errors matter because continuous batching, variable sequence lengths, KV-cache growth, and memory limits interact in a closed loop. Small per-operator or memory errors can move TTFT, TPOT, and throughput across SLA boundaries and change the selected configuration. The key experimental sections to inspect are the calibration against microbenchmarks or real traces, and the prediction accuracy for combinations of PDD, AFD, prefix caching, chunked prefill, and speculative decoding.
summary_en.reading_guide: A productive skim takes around 25–35 minutes. Start with the motivation and the failure cases in section 2.2, especially the examples where average-case proxies lead to the wrong optimization conclusion. Then read the design of the disaggregated abstraction, the stateful request model, and the scheduler adapters. In the evaluation, focus on fidelity calibration, KV-cache memory modeling, and whether predicted configuration choices match real deployments. For researchers running RLHF, RLVR, or large-scale agent rollouts, the workload abstraction is more important than the simulator interface details.

recommendation.zh: 推理服务设计空间探索的实用工具，分解式抽象是关键创新，对训练推理协同设计（如RL rollout批量策略）有参考价值，建议看§3系统设计和§5评估
recommendation.en: Practical tool for inference serving design space exploration; the disaggregated abstraction is a key innovation; useful for training-inference co-design (e.g., RL rollout batching strategies); read §3 system design and §5 evaluation

paper.title: KVBuffer: IO-aware Serving for Linear Attention
paper.abstract: Linear attention has recently gained significant attention for long-context inference due to its constant decoding cost with respect to context length. However, existing serving systems typically serve linear attention by recurrently computing and updating a large linear attention state in every decoding step. Since the state is much larger than the per-token key and value, recurrent decoding incurs substantial memory access and becomes inefficient for serving linear attention. In this paper, we

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是线性注意力模型 serving 中的 IO 瓶颈。线性注意力解码算力随上下文长度近似常数，但现有系统通常每步都读写一个 d×d 的线性注意力状态。这个状态远大于单 token 的 KV，例如 Qwen3-Next 的 Gated DeltaNet 层约 2MB。结果是长上下文收益被显存带宽和状态更新的串行性吃掉， speculative decoding 和短上下文场景尤其明显。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是核心论文，但对线性注意力和混合架构能否落到真实推理系统有直接参考价值。Qwen3-Next、MiniMax 等模型已经采用 softmax attention 与 linear attention 交错的结构，训练侧看到的理论复杂度优势，只有在 serving 侧把状态 IO 处理好才会转化为吞吐优势。这篇论文的启发在于：线性注意力的系统瓶颈不只是算子 FLOPs，而是状态表示形式和更新粒度。
summary.technical_approach: KVBuffer 的做法是缓存连续生成 token 的 key/value，不在每个 decoding step 立即更新线性注意力状态，而是等 buffer 满后批量并行 flush。这样会增加一部分 KV 读写，但减少了更昂贵的线性状态读写。论文给出一个 IO trade-off 分析：在隐藏维度为 d 时，chunkwise decoding 的平均内存访问在 buffer size 约为 2√d 时较优。对 speculative decoding，它不再为每个 draft token 递推生成临时线性状态，而是先缓存 draft token 的 KV，并行完成验证，只用 accepted tokens 更新主状态。对短上下文，如果 token 数不超过 d，则直接保留全部 KV 并从 KV 计算输出，完全避免创建 d×d 状态。
summary.experiments: 实现基于 SGLang，目标模型是带 Gated DeltaNet 的 Qwen3-Next。核心结果包括：普通解码中，KVBuffer 最高降低 linear attention decoding latency 45.17%；speculative decoding 中，随着 draft token 数增加，KVBuffer 降低 verification latency，并提高可同时服务的最大 request 数，端到端 serving throughput 最高提升 1.46×；短上下文实验显示，KV-only decoding 比 recurrent decoding 和 chunkwise decoding 都更高效。这些结果说明线性注意力 serving 需要按 context length、draft length 和状态大小动态选择计算形式。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 2.2 对 recurrent serving 的瓶颈拆解，3.2 的 IO 模型和 2√d buffer size 推导，以及 speculative decoding 部分。实验部分重点看 Qwen3-Next 上 latency、throughput、max served requests 随 draft token 数变化的图表。对做预训练架构的人，最有用的是理解 linear attention state 的系统代价，这会反过来影响是否采用更大的 state、更多 linear 层，或 softmax/linear 的交错比例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an IO bottleneck in serving linear-attention LLMs. Linear attention has constant decoding compute with respect to context length, but current serving systems usually read and write a large d×d recurrent state at every decoding step. This state can be orders of magnitude larger than per-token KV; for example, a Qwen3-Next Gated DeltaNet layer has a state of about 2MB. The issue becomes worse for speculative decoding and for short-context requests.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-systems paper, not a pretraining-method paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is that the practical value of linear or hybrid attention architectures depends on serving-time state management. The paper shows that the bottleneck is often not arithmetic cost, but memory traffic caused by how the linear-attention state is represented and updated.
summary_en.technical_approach: KVBuffer stores recent keys and values and updates the linear-attention state in chunks instead of recurrently at every token. The extra KV traffic is offset by fewer reads and writes of the much larger state. The paper derives an IO trade-off and argues that a buffer size around 2√d minimizes average memory access per decoding step for hidden dimension d. For speculative decoding, KVBuffer avoids materializing temporary recurrent states for each draft token; it verifies draft tokens in parallel using buffered KV and updates the main state only with accepted tokens. For short contexts with at most d tokens, it uses KV-only decoding and never creates the d×d state.
summary_en.experiments: The implementation is in SGLang for Qwen3-Next with Gated DeltaNet layers. KVBuffer reduces linear-attention decoding latency by up to 45.17%. In speculative decoding, it lowers verification latency, allows more concurrent requests as the number of draft tokens grows, and improves end-to-end serving throughput by up to 1.46×. The short-context results show that KV-only decoding can be faster than both recurrent and chunkwise decoding.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough; budget 20 to 30 minutes. Read Section 2.2 for the recurrent-state bottleneck, Section 3.2 for the IO model and the 2√d buffer-size argument, and the speculative-decoding design. In the experiments, focus on latency, throughput, and maximum served-request curves. For architecture researchers, the useful lesson is that linear-attention state size should be treated as a serving constraint, not only a modeling detail.

recommendation.zh: 线性注意力如果是内部路线，建议看方法图和 IO 分析；它提醒不要只拿 O(1) 解码复杂度做架构判断。
recommendation.en: If linear attention is on your roadmap, read the method diagram and IO analysis; O(1) decoding is not a sufficient serving argument.

paper.title: Draft Less, Retrieve More: Hybrid Tree Construction for Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by leveraging a draft-then-verify paradigm. To maximize the acceptance rate, recent methods construct expansive draft trees, which unfortunately incur severe VRAM bandwidth and computational overheads that bottleneck end-to-end speedups. While dynamic-depth pruning can reduce this latency by removing marginal branches, it also discards potentially valid candidates, preventing the acceptance rate from reaching the upper bound of

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章解决的是 speculative decoding 里一个很具体但很实际的矛盾：树状 draft 越大，target 一次验证能接受的 token 越多，但 draft 侧搜索、显存带宽和验证开销也越大，最终 wall-clock speedup 不一定更好；而动态剪枝虽然更快，却会把原本可能正确的分支一起剪掉，导致 mean accepted tokens 被静态大树的上界卡住。作者要解决的核心问题，是如何在不增加 target 额外前向、保持 lossless 的前提下，把“剪枝省下来的预算”重新利用起来，弥补动态树的覆盖损失。
summary.importance: 这项工作属于推理效率，不是预训练方法。但它对基座研究员仍有两层启发。第一，它把 speculative decoding 的优化目标从单纯“更聪明地剪枝”改成“预算重分配”，这个视角比继续调 pruning controller 更有工程含义。第二，它说明 retrieval 不一定只能做独立 drafter，也可以作为 tree construction 的补偿机制，和 parametric drafting 形成互补。贡献量级上，更像是对 EAGLE-3 / dynamic tree 这一条技术线的结构性改进，而不是新范式。若你关心 serving、长输出场景、KV-cache 带宽瓶颈，这篇比只看 acceptance rate 的论文更接近真实部署问题。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Graft，一个 training-free、lossless 的 prune-then-graft 混合树构造框架。它的逻辑分两步。

第一步是 pruning。作者沿用动态树思路，在若干 calibrated pruning checkpoints 上根据 draft 置信度决定是否提前截断某些低置信分支。这里的关键不是单纯减少计算，而是把被剪掉的节点数视为“释放出的候选预算”。论文强调，动态树方法的问题在于它们只能返回静态树的子树，因此无论 controller 多好，误剪都会让 accepted length 低于 dense tree 的理论上界。

第二步是 grafting。Graft 不把这些空出来的 slot 留空，也不继续往更深层做不确定的 autoregressive drafting，而是用 retrieval-based continuations 填进去。这样最终送给 target 验证的总预算与原始静态树相同，但候选来源从单一 parametric draft 变成“剪枝后的 parametric subtree + retrieval branches”。作者的论点是，retrieval 分支不受“必须是原静态树子树”的拓扑约束，因此可以补回 pruning 误伤掉的一部分有效 continuation，从而打破 latency-MAT 的原有 Pareto 前沿。

实现上，作者强调 GPU 友好。检索分支根植于当前 token，与自回归 drafting 并行准备；使用 GPU-resident adjacency matrix 存储和查询局部转移；通过 warm-up 初始化，并用 target 验证信号在线更新。这样做有三个目的：1）避免 CPU lookup 和同步开销；2）不改变标准 tree attention / verification 路径；3）不引入额外 target model forward。文章还特别指出，长上下文下这个设计更有利：一方面 AR drafting 更贵，剪枝收益更大；另一方面上下文更长会提供更多局部转移模式，提升 retrieval 命中率。
summary.experiments:
给出的全文片段主要是引言和方法动机，没有完整实验表格与具体数字，因此无法像正式精读那样列出 speedup、MAT、batch size、上下文长度、模型规模等精确结果。能从全文内容确认的实验主线有三条。第一，作者会把 Graft 与 dense static tree baseline（如 EAGLE-3）以及 pruning-only 动态树方法（DDD、SVIP、ECHO、TALON 一类）比较，核心指标应包括 mean accepted tokens、端到端延迟和实际 speedup，而不是只看 acceptance rate。第二，论文强调在“最终 verification budget 与静态树相同”的条件下比较，这一点很重要，因为它把收益归因于预算重分配，而不是单纯增加候选数。第三，作者声称方法在长上下文场景更有效，说明实验大概率覆盖不同输出长度或上下文长度，并分析 retrieval hit rate 随上下文增长的变化。

从方法设计推断，最值得关注的消融应包括：是否需要 calibrated pruning checkpoints；retrieval 分支数量与位置；GPU adjacency matrix 的 warm-up 和 online update 是否必要；以及 retrieval-only、pruning-only、hybrid 三者的对比。如果正文里有这些结果，它们会比单一总表更能说明方法成立的原因。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Figure 1 和 Introduction，把作者定义的 latency-MAT frontier 看明白，再读方法部分的 prune-then-graft 设计。真正的创新不在 retrieval 本身，而在“把 pruning 释放的预算显式回收并重投到另一类候选源”。如果只看摘要，很容易误以为这是又一个 retrieval-based SD；读正文时要注意它和 SAM-Decoding 这类 routing-only 方法的区别：Graft 是把 retrieval 直接并入 draft tree，而不是只用 retrieval 质量决定是否切换 drafter。

阅读时建议重点找四类内容：1）budget 保持不变时为何还能提高 MAT；2）GPU-resident adjacency matrix 如何避免 CPU 同步瓶颈；3）长上下文下 retrieval 命中率为何会上升；4）lossless 性质是如何保证的。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若只想抓工程价值，看实验总表、消融和实现细节即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in speculative decoding. Large draft trees can improve the mean accepted tokens per verification step, but they also increase draft-side search cost, VRAM bandwidth pressure, and verification overhead, so the end-to-end speedup often falls short of what acceptance metrics suggest. Dynamic pruning reduces latency, but it can only produce subtrees of the original dense tree, which means pruning mistakes permanently remove valid continuations and cap the achievable accepted length below the dense-tree upper bound. The core problem is how to reuse the computation budget freed by pruning so that latency improves without paying the usual acceptance penalty, all while remaining lossless and without extra target-model forward passes.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant for foundation-model researchers who care about deployment constraints. The main contribution is conceptual: it reframes dynamic tree construction from a pruning problem into a budget reallocation problem. That is more useful than simply tuning a better pruning controller, because it exposes where the wasted compute goes. A second useful point is that retrieval is not treated as a standalone drafter; it is used as a compensatory source of candidates that complements parametric drafting. In scope, this looks like a structural improvement over the EAGLE-3 and dynamic-tree line of work rather than a new decoding paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, called Graft, is a training-free and lossless hybrid tree construction framework built around a prune-then-graft strategy.

Step one is pruning. Similar to prior dynamic-tree methods, Graft uses calibrated confidence checkpoints to decide when low-confidence branches should be cut early. The important shift is interpretive: the removed branches are not treated merely as deleted candidates, but as released candidate budget. The paper argues that pruning-only methods are fundamentally limited because they must remain subtrees of the original static tree. As a result, any pruning error directly lowers coverage and therefore lowers the achievable accepted length.

Step two is grafting. Instead of leaving the freed slots empty, or spending them on deeper uncertain autoregressive drafting, Graft fills them with retrieval-based continuations. The total verification budget remains identical to that of the original static tree, but the candidate pool now becomes a hybrid of a pruned parametric subtree and retrieval branches. This matters because retrieval branches are not constrained to be descendants of the retained subtree, so they can recover some of the valid continuations lost to pruning and thereby move beyond the usual latency-MAT tradeoff.

Implementation is designed to be GPU-friendly. Retrieval branches are rooted at the current token and prepared in parallel with autoregressive drafting. A GPU-resident adjacency matrix stores local transition information, is initialized during warm-up, and updated online using target-model verification signals. This avoids CPU-side lookup and synchronization, preserves the standard tree-attention verification path, and does not require extra target forward passes. The paper also argues that the design becomes more attractive with long contexts: autoregressive drafting gets more expensive, making pruning more valuable, while longer contexts provide richer local transition patterns that improve retrieval hit rate.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided full text is limited to the introduction and motivation, so the exact experimental numbers are not available here. Still, the evaluation structure is clear from the paper’s setup. First, Graft is positioned against dense static-tree baselines such as EAGLE-3 and against pruning-only dynamic-tree methods such as DDD, SVIP, ECHO, and related variants. The key metrics are expected to be mean accepted tokens, end-to-end latency, and realized speedup rather than acceptance rate alone. Second, the paper explicitly states that the final verification budget is kept identical to the original static tree, which is important because it isolates the gain as a consequence of budget reallocation rather than simply adding more candidates. Third, the authors claim stronger benefits under long-context generation, so the experiments likely vary prompt or output length and analyze how retrieval hit rate changes with context length.

The most informative ablations, if present in the main text, would be: the effect of calibrated pruning checkpoints, the number and placement of grafted retrieval branches, the necessity of warm-up and online updates for the GPU adjacency matrix, and comparisons among retrieval-only, pruning-only, and hybrid construction. Those would explain why the method works more clearly than a single aggregate speedup table.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim read, start with Figure 1 and the Introduction to understand the latency-MAT frontier the paper is trying to break. Then read the method section with one question in mind: how exactly is freed pruning budget converted into useful alternative candidates? The novelty is not retrieval by itself. It is the explicit coupling between pruning and retrieval under a fixed verification budget. That is also the main difference from routing-style methods such as SAM-Decoding, where retrieval quality is used only to decide whether to invoke a parametric drafter.

When reading, focus on four points: why MAT can improve even when the verification budget stays constant, how the GPU-resident adjacency matrix avoids CPU synchronization overhead, why retrieval becomes more effective with longer contexts, and how the lossless property is preserved. Estimated reading time: 20 to 30 minutes. If you only care about engineering value, prioritize the main experiment table, the ablations, and the implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 做推理加速的研究者重点看剪枝+检索互补的设计思路，基座研究员可了解该方向的权衡突破
recommendation.en: Inference acceleration researchers should focus on the pruning-retrieval complementary design; pretrain researchers can learn about this tradeoff breakthrough
